etaiś cānyaiś ca mahā­nāgarājanair anekaśatasahasramahā­nāgaparivāritais tanmahāparṣanmaṇḍalaṃ sannipatitāḥ sanniṣaṇṇā abhūvaṃ dharmaśravaṇāya | ye 'pi te • ṛṣayo mahā­ṛṣayaḥ | tadyathā || 1.82 ||

etaiś cānyaiś ca maharṣayo anekamaharṣiśatasahasraparivārās tatparṣanmaṇḍalam upajagmuḥ | bhagavantaṃ śākya­muniṃ vanditvā sanniṣaṇṇā abhūvan mantracaryārthabodhi­sattvapiṭakaṃ {B19r} śrotum anumodituṃ ca | ye 'pi te mahoragarājānaḥ, te 'pi tat parṣanmaṇḍalaṃ sampraviṣṭā abhūvan sanniṣaṇṇāḥ | tadyathā || 1.84 ||

bheraṇḍo bheruṇḍo bheraṇḍo bheruṇḍo] em.; bheraṇḍa bheruṇḍa B; bheruṇḍa bhūrūṇḍa S maruṇḍo marīco marīco] em.; marīca B; om. S mārīco dīptaḥ dīptaḥ] B; dīpa S sudīptaś sudīptaś] B; pradīpāś S ceti || 1.85 || {V13}
ye 'pi te garuḍarājñās te 'pi tat parṣanmaṇḍalaṃ sannipatitā anekagaruḍaśatasahasraparivārāḥ | tadyathā || 1.86 ||

suparṇaḥ śvetaparṇaḥ pannagaḥ parṇagaḥ sujātapakṣo {S19} 'jātapakṣo manojavaḥ pannaganāśano pannaganāśano] em.; pannaganāśana S; pannarāśava B dhenateyo vainateyo dhenateyo vainateyo] em.; dhenateya vainateya B; vainateya vainateya S bharadvājaḥ śakuno mahā­śakunaḥ pakṣirājaś pakṣirājaś] B; pakṣirājāś S ceti || 1.87 ||
te 'pi tat parṣanmaṇḍalaṃ sannipateyuḥ | ye 'pi te kiṃnararājñaḥ anekakiṃnaraśatasahasraparivārāsḥ te 'pi taṃ parṣanmaṇḍalaṃ saṃnipateyuḥ | tadyathā || 1.88 ||

druma upadrumaḥ sudrumo 'nantadrumo 'nantadrumo] em.; anantadruma S; antadruma B lokadrumo ledrumo ghanorasko ghanorasko] em.; ghanoraska S; dy(gh?)amāraska B mahorasko mahojasko mahojo mahorasko mahojasko mahojo] em.; mahoraska mahojaska mahoja S; mahoraska mahoraska B maharddhiko virutaḥ susvaro manojñaś Citton­mādakara Citton­mādakara] S; cittotpādakara B unmāda unmāda] em.; utmāda B; om. S unnata upekṣakaḥ karuṇo 'ruṇaś ceti || 1.89 ||
ete cānye ca mahā­kinnararājānaḥ anekakiṃnaraśatasahasraparivārāḥ sannipatitā abhūvan dharmaśravaṇāya | evam || 1.90 ||

brahmā sahāmpatir mahā­brahmā • ābhāsvaraḥ prabhāsvaraḥ śuddhābhaḥ puṇyābho 'vṛhā 'vṛhā] em.; avṛhā B; aṭṭahra S atapā akaniṣṭhāḥ sukaniṣṭhā lokaniṣṭhā ākiñcanyā naivakiñcanyā ākāśānantyā naivākāśānantyāḥ sudṛśāḥ sudṛśāḥ] em.; sudṛśā S; sudṛśaḥ B sudarśanāḥ sunirmitāḥ sunirmitāḥ] em.; sunirmitā S; anirmitā B paranirmitāś śuddhāvāsās tuṣitā {B19v} yāmās tṛdaśāś cātur­mahā­rājikāḥ sadāmattā mālādhārāḥ karoṭapāṇayo karoṭapāṇayo] em.; karoṭapāṇayaḥ S; karopāṇayar B vīṇātṛtīyakāḥ vīṇātṛtīyakāḥ] S; cīrṇṇā tṛtīyakāḥ B parvatavāsinaḥ kūṭavāsinaś śikharavāsino 'lakavāsinaḥ puravāsino vimānavāsino 'ntarikṣacarā bhūmivāsino vṛkṣavāsino gṛhavāsinaḥ gṛhavāsinaḥ] S; guhavāsina B || 1.91 ||
evaṃ dānavendrāḥ |

anekadānava­koṭī­śata­sahasra­parivārāḥ vicitragatayo vicitrārthāḥ surayodhino 'surāḥ | te 'pi tat parṣanmaṇḍalaṃ sannipateyur buddhādhiṣṭhānena bodhi­sattvavikurvaṇaṃ draṣṭuṃ vandituṃ paryupāsitum | ye 'pi te grahā mahā­grahā lokārthakarā antarikṣacarāḥ | tadyathā || 1.93 ||

ādityaḥ somo 'ṅgārako budho bṛhaspatiḥ śukraḥ śanaiścaro śanaiścaro] em.; śanaiścara B; śaniścara S rāhuḥ kampaḥ kampaḥ] em.; kampa S; om. B ketur aśanir aśanir] em.; aśani° S, B nirghātas tāro dhvajo ghoro dhūmro dhūmo vajra ṛkṣo vṛṣṭir vṛṣṭir] em.; vṛṣṭi B; vaṣṭi S upavṛṣṭir naṣṭārko naṣṭārko] em.; naṣṭārka S; naṣṭārtha B nirnaṣṭo nirnaṣṭo] em.; nirnaṣṭa S; ninnaṣṭa B hasānto yāṣṭir yāṣṭir] em.; yāṣṭi S; māṣṭi B ṛṣṭir ṛṣṭir] em.; ṛṣṭi S; om. B duṣṭir duṣṭir] em.; duṣṭi B; tuṣṭi S (supported by TMK) lokāntaḥ kṣayo vinipāta āpātas tarko mastako yugāntaḥ śmaśānaḥ piśito raudraḥ śveto 'bhijo 'bhijato 'bhijo 'bhijato] em.; abhija abhijata S; abhiji abhijeta B maitraḥ śaṅkus triśaṅkur lubdho lubdho] em.; lubdha B; lūtha S raudrako dhruvo nāśano dhruvo nāśano] em.; dhruva nāśana B (supported by the Tib.); kratunāśana S balavāṅ ghoro 'ruṇo vihasito mārṣṭiḥ mārṣṭiḥ] em.; mārṣṭi S; māriṣṭa B skandaḥ sanad upasanat sanad upasanat] em.; sanat upasanat S; śatanat upaśanat B kumāraḥ {B20r} krīḍano kumāraḥ krīḍano] em.; kumāra krīḍana B; kumārakrīḍana S hasanaḥ prahasano nartāpako nartāpako] em.; narttāpaka B; nartapaka S nartakaḥ khajo virūpaś ceti || 1.94 ||

ity ete mahā­grahāḥ te 'pi tat {S20} parṣanmaṇḍalam anekagrahaśatasahasraparivāritā buddhādhiṣṭhānena tasmiñ śuddhāvāsabhavane sannipatitā abhūvan sanniṣaṇṇāḥ | atha ye nakṣatrāḥ khagānucāriṇaḥ anekanakṣatraśatasahasraparivāritāḥ | tadyathā || 1.95 ||

aśvinī bharaṇī bharaṇī] S; bharuṇī B kṛttikā rohiṇī rohiṇī] S; rauhiṇī B mṛgaśirā • ārdrā ārdrā] em.; ādrā B; ārdra S punarvasū puṣya āśleṣā āśleṣā] S; aśleṣā B maghā • ubhe phalgunī phalgunī] S; phālguṇī B hastā citrā svātir svātir] em.; svāti S; svātī B viśākhā • anurādhā jyeṣṭhā jyeṣṭhā] S; jeṣṭhā B mūlā • ubhau • āṣaḍhau āṣaḍhau] S; āṣāḍhau B śravaṇā dhaniṣṭhā śatabhiṣā • ubhau bhadrapadau bhadrapadau] S; bhādrapadau B revatī devatī • abhijā abhijā] em.; abhija B; prabhijā S punarnavā jyotī • aṅgirasī aṅgirasī] B; aṅgirasā S nakṣatrikā • ubhau ubhau] S; u B phalguḥ phalguvatī lokapravarā lokapravarā] S; lovapravarā B pravarāṇikā pravarāṇikā] S; pradharānikā B śreyasī lokamātā • īrā • ūhā ūhā] S; jayā B vahā • arthavatī surārthā surārthā] em. (on the authority of the Tib.); susārthā B; asārthā S ceti || 1.96 ||

ity ete nakṣatrarājñaḥ tasmiñ śuddhāvāsabhavane anekanakṣatraśatasahasraparivāritās tasmin mahāparṣanmaṇḍalasannipāte buddhādhiṣṭhānena sannipatitāḥ sanniṣaṇṇā abhūvan | {V14} ṣaṭtṛṃśad rāśayaḥ |tadyathā || 1.97 ||

meṣo vṛṣabho vṛṣabho] em.; vṛṣabha S; vṛṣa B mithunaḥ karkaṭakaḥ siṃhaḥ kanyā kanyā] em.; kanya S, B tulo vṛściko {B20v} dhanur makaraḥ kumbho mīno vānara upakumbho bhṛṅgāraḥ bhṛṅgāraḥ] em.; bhṛṅgāra B; bhṛñjāra S khaḍgaḥ kuñjaro mahiṣo devo manuṣyaḥ śakuno gandharvo lokaḥ sarvajita lokaḥ sarvajita] em.; loka sarvvajita B; lokasatvajita S ugratejo jyotsnaś chāyaḥ pṛthivī tamo raja uparajo duḥkhaḥ sukho sukho] em.; sukha S; mukha B mokṣo bodhiḥ pratyekaḥ śrāvako narakavidyādharo mahojo mahojaskas tiryak preta asuraḥ piśitaḥ piśāco yakṣo rākṣasaḥ sarvabhūtiko sarvabhūtiko] em.; sarvabhūtika B; sarvabhūmita S bhūtiko bhūtiko] em.; bhūtika S; om. B (supported by TMK) nimnaga ūrdhvagas tiryago vikasito dhyānago dhyānago] em.; dhyānaga S; dhyāna B yogapratiṣṭha uttamo madhyamo 'dhamaś ceti || 1.98 ||

ity ete mahā­rāśyaḥ anekarāśiśatasahasraparivāritāḥ, yena śuddhāvāsabhavanaṃ, yena ca mahāparṣatsannipātamaṇḍalaṃ, tenopajagmuḥ | upetya bhagavataś caraṇayor nipatya svakasvakeṣu ca sthāneṣu sanniṣaṇṇā abhūvan | ye 'pi te mahā­yakṣiṇyaḥ, anekayakṣiṇīśatasahasraparivāritāḥ | tadyathā || 1.99 ||

sulocanā subhrū sukeśā susvarā sumatī vasumatī citrākṣī pūrāṃśā guhyakā suguhyakā suguhyakā] S; suguhyā B mekhalā sumekhalā padmoccā • abhayā • abhayadā abhayadā] B; om. S jayā vijayā revatikā keśinī keśāntā • anilā anilā] S; anīlā B manoharā manovatī kusumāvatī kusumāvatī] S; kusumā B kusuma­pura­vāsinī piṅgalā hārītī vīramatī vīrā suvīrā sughorā ghoravatī sughorā ghoravatī] S; sughoṇā ghoṇavatī B surasundarī {B21r} surasā guhyottarī guhyottarī] em. (supported by the Tib); guhottarī B; guhyottamārī S vaṭavāsinī vaṭavāsinī] S; paṭavāsinī B • aśokā • andhārasundarī andhārasundarī] S (supported by the Tib.); ambāla B • ālokasundarī prabhāvatī • atiśayavatī rūpavatī surūpā {S21} • asitā saumyā kāṇā kāṇā] S; kānā B menā nandinī • upanandinī lokottarā lokottarā] B; lokāntarā S ceti || 1.100 ||

ity ete mahā­yakṣiṇyo anekayakṣiṇīśatasahasraparivārāḥ tanmahāparṣanmaṇḍalaṃ dūrata eva bhagavantaṃ śākya­muniṃ namasyantyaḥ sthitā abhūvan | ye 'pi te mahā­piśācyo 'nekapiśācinīśatasahasraparivāritās te 'pi taṃ bhagavantaṃ śākya­muniṃ namasyantyaḥ sannipateyuḥ | tadyathā || 1.101 ||

maṇḍitikā pāṃsupiśācī pāṃsupiśācī] S; yānasupiśācī B raudrapiśācī raudrapiśācī] B; om. S • ulkāpiśācī jvālāpiśācī bhasmodgirā bhasmodgirā] S; bhasmādgirā B piśitāśinī durdharā piśitāśinī durdharā] S; piśīmī duvarā B bhrāmarī mohanī tarjanī tarjanī] S; garjanī B rohiṇikā govāhiṇikā rohiṇikā govāhiṇikā] S; rohaṇīka soṁṇīkā(?) B lokāntikā lokāntikā] S; rokāntikā B bhasmāntikā pīluvatī bahulavatī bahulā durdāntā • elā elā] B; dhaṇā S cihnitikā dhūmāntikā dhūmāntikā] S; dhūmātt(?)ikā B dhūmā dhūmā] S; pūmā B sudhūmā ceti || 1.102 ||

ity etā mahā­piśācyo 'nekapiśācīśatasahasraparivāritās te 'pi tanmahāparṣatsannipātamaṇḍalaṃ sampraviṣṭā abhūvan | ye 'pi te mātarā mahā­mātarāḥ lokam anucaranti satvaviheṭhikā balimālyopahārikāś °opahārikāś] em.; °opahārikaś B; °opahāriś S ca | tadyathā || 1.103 ||

brahmāṇī māheśvarī vaiṣṇavī {B21v} kaumārī cāmuṇḍā vārāhī • aindrī yāmyā • āgneyā vaivasvatī lokāntakarī vāruṇī • aiśānī vāyavyā paraprāṇaharā mukhamaṇḍitikā mukhamaṇḍitikā] B; sukhamaṇḍitikā S śakunī mahā­śakunī pūtanā kaṭapūtanā skandā skandā] S; skandha B ceti || 1.104 ||
ity etā mahā­mātarā anekamātaraśatasahasraparivārās te 'pi taṃ mahāparṣanmaṇḍalaṃ namo buddhāyeti vācam udīrayantyaḥ sthitā abhūvan || 1.105 ||

evam aneka­sattva­śata­sahasra­manuṣyāmanuṣya­sattvāsattva yāvad avīcimahā­narakaṃ avīcimahā­narakaṃ] em.; avīcirmahā­narakaṃ S, B yāvac ca bhavāgram atrāntare sarvaṃ gaganatalaṃ sphuṭam abhūt | sattvanikāye na ca kasyacit prāṇino virodho 'bhūt | buddhādhiṣṭhānena bodhi­sattvarddhyālaṅkāreṇa ca sarva eva sattvā mūrdhāvasthitaṃ buddhaṃ bhagavantaṃ mañjuśriyaṃ ca ca] conj.; om. S, B kumara­bhūtaṃ sampaśyante sma || 1.106 ||
{V15} atha bhaga­vāñ śākya­muniḥ sarvāvantaṃ loka­dhātuṃ buddhacakṣuṣā samavalokya mañjuśriyaṃ kumara­bhūtam āmantrayate sma |
bhāṣa bhāṣa tvaṃ śuddhasattva mantra­caryārthaviniścaya­samādhi­paṭala­visaraṃ {B22r} bodhi­sattvapiṭakaṃ yasyedānīṃ kālaṃ manyase || 1.107 || {S22}

atha mañjuśrīḥ kumara­bhūto bhagavatā śākya­muninā kṛtābhyanujño kṛtābhyanujño] em. kṛtābhyanujñār B; kṛtābhyanujñātaḥ gagana­svabhāva­vyūhālaṅkāraṃ vajrasaṃhatakaṭhinasantānavyūhālaṅkāraṃ nāma samādhiṃ samāpadyate | samanantarasamāpannasya mañjuśriyaḥ kumara­bhūtasya taṃ śuddhāvāsabhavanaṃ anekayojanaśatasahasravistīrṇaṃ vajramayam adhitiṣṭhate sma | yatra te anekayakṣarākṣasagandharvamarutapiśācaḥ saṃkṣepataḥ sarvasattvadhātur °dhātur] em.; °dhātu S, B bodhisattvādhiṣṭhānena tasmin vimāne vajramaṇiratnaprakhye sampratiṣṭhitāḥ sanniṣaṇṇā bhūvan anyonyam aviheṭhakāḥ || 1.108 ||
atha mañjuśrīḥ kumara­bhūtas tan mahā­parṣannipātaṃ viditvā yamāntakaṃ krodharājam āmantrayate sma |

evam uktas tu mahā­krodharājā • ājñāṃ pratīkṣya mahā­vikṛtarūpī niryayuḥ sarvasattvān rakṣaṇāya śāsanāya samantāt parṣanmaṇḍalaṃ yamāntakaḥ krodharājā anekakrodhaśatasahasraparivārito samantāt taṃ caturdikṣu ity ūrdhvamadhastiryag ghoraṃ ca nādaṃ pramuñcamānaḥ sthito 'bhūt | atha te sarvāḥ saumyāḥ sumanaskāḥ saṃvṛttāḥ ājñāṃ nollaṅghayanti | evaṃ ca śabdaṃ śṛṇvanti yo hy etaṃ samayam atikramet, śatadhāsya śatadhāsya] em. (based on the Tib.); sa tavāsya S; saptadhāsya B sphuṭo mūrdhnā • arjakasyeva arjakasyeva] em.; 'rjjakasyeva B; ajakasyeva S mañjarīti | bodhisattvādhiṣṭhānaṃ ca tat || 1.110 ||
atha mañjuśrīḥ kumara­bhūtaḥ svamantracaryārthadharmapadaṃ bhāṣate sma |
ekena dharmeṇa samanvāgatasya bodhi­sattvasya mahā­sattvasya mantrāḥ siddhiṃ gaccheyuḥ | katamenaikena | yaduta sarva­dharmāṇāṃ niḥprapañcākārataḥ samanupaśyatā || 1.111 ||
dvābhyāṃ dharmābhyāṃ pratiṣṭhitasya bodhi­sattvasya mantrāḥ siddhiṃ gaccheyuḥ | katamābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ | bodhicittāparityāgitā sarvasattvasamatā ca || 1.112 ||
trayābhyāṃ dharmābhyāṃ svamantracaryārthanirdeśa pāripūriṃ gacchanti | katamābhyāṃ trayābhyāṃ | sarvasattvāparityāgitā bodhi­sattvaśīlasaṃvarārakṣaṇatayā svamantrāparityāgitā ca || 1.113 ||

caturbhiḥ dharmaiḥ samanvāgatasya {B23r} prathamacittotpādikasya {S23} bodhi­sattvasya mantrāḥ siddhiṃ gaccheyuḥ | katamaiś caturbhiḥ | svamantrāparityāgitā | paramantrānupacchedanatā | sarvasattvamaitryopasaṃharaṇatā | mahā­karuṇābhāvitacetanatā ca | imaiś caturbhiḥ dharmaiḥ samanvāgatasya prathamacittotpādikasya bodhi­sattvasya mantrāḥ siddhiṃ gaccheyuḥ || 1.114 ||

pañcadharmā pañcadharmā] em.; pañcadharma B; yaṃdharmā S bodhi­sattvasya piṭakasamavasaraṇatā mantracaryābhinirhāraṃ pāripūriṃ pāripūriṃ] B; bodhipūriṃ S gaccheyuḥ | katame pañca | viviktadeśasevanatā | prāntāraṇāsevanatā | parasattvādveṣaṇatā | laukikamantrānirīkṣaṇatā | śīlaśrutacāritrasthāpanatā ca | ime pañca dharmāḥ mantracaryārthasiddhiṃ pāripūriṃ gaccheyuḥ || 1.115 ||

ṣaḍdharmā mantracaryārthasiddhipāripūriṃ gaccheyuḥ | katame ṣaṭ | tri­ratnaprasādānupacchedanatā °prasādānupacchedanatā] S; °padānupacchedanatā B | bodhi­sattvaprasādānupacchedanatā | laukikalokottaramantrābhinandanatā °mantrābhinandanatā] B (supported by the Tib.); °mantrānindanatā S | {V16} niḥprapañcadharmadhātudarśanatā | gambhīrapadārthamahā­yānasūtrānta•apratikṣepaṇatā | akhinnamānasatā | mantracaryāparyeṣṭiḥ | kuśalapakṣe aparihāṇatā | ime ṣaṭ dharmā vidyācaryāmantrasiddhiṃ samavasaraṇatāṃ gacchanti || 1.116 ||

sapta dharmā vidyāsādhanakālaupayika mantracaryāparyeṣṭiḥ … vidyāsādhanakālaupayika] S; om. Bmantracaryānupraveśanatāṃ gacchanti | katame sapta | gambhīranayaḥ prajñāpāramitābhāvanā | paṭhanadeśanasvādhyāyanalikhanabodhi­sattvacaryādhimuktiḥ | kāladeśaniyamajapa­homa­mauna­tapa•avilambita­gati­mati­smṛti­prajñā­dhṛti•adhivāsanataḥ {B23v} | bodhi­sattvasambhāramahā­yānagambhīradharmanayasampraveśanataḥ | svatantramantrākarṣaṇa­rakṣaṇasādhanakriyākauśalataḥ | mahā­karuṇā mahā­maitrī mahopekṣā mahā­muditā pāramitābhāvavanataḥ | niḥprapañca­sattva­dhātu­dharma­dhātu­tathatāsamavasaraṇato dvayākārasarvajñajñānaparigaveṣaṇataḥ | sarvasattvāparityāgaḥ | hīnayānāspṛhaṇataś ca | ime sapta dharmā vidyāmantrasiddhiṃ pāripūritāṃ gacchanti || 1.117 ||

aṣṭadharmā vidyāmantracaryārthasiddhiṃ samanavasaraṇatāṃ gacchanti | katameaṣṭadharmā … katame] B; om. S aṣṭa aṣṭa] B; adṛṣṭa° S | dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalaśraddhā | kautukajijñāsanata•avicikitsā The S adds at this point aṣṭa­dharmāvidyā­mantra­caryārtha­siddhiṃ samavasaraṇatāṃ gacchanti. | bodhi­sattvaprasādasaphala•ṛddhi °ṛddhi°] B; °śuddhi° Svikurvaṇataḥ | aviparītamantragrahaṇagurugauravataḥ | buddhabodhi­sattvasva­mantra­tantra•ācāryopadeśa­grahaṇa | avisaṃvādana | sarvasvaparityāganataḥ | siddha­kṣetra­sthānāsthānasvapna­darśana­kauśalaprakāśanataḥ | vigatamātsaryamala-m-akhila­styāna­middha­vīryārambha | satatabuddhabodhisattvātmānaṃ °ātmānaṃ] em.; °ātmāna° S; °āmana° B niryātanataḥ | saṃkṣepato 'tṛptakuśalamūlamahā­sannāhasaṃnaddhaḥ sarvavighnān prahartukāmataḥ {S24} {B24r} bodhimaṇḍākramaṇamahā­bhoga­pratikāṃkṣaṇa­maheśākhyayātma­bhāvanataḥ maheśākhyapudgala °pudgala°] B; lac. Ssamavadhānāvirahita­kalyāṇamitra­mañjuśrīkumara­bhūtabodhi­sattvasamavadhānataś ca | ime aṣṭadharmā mantracaryārthasiddhiṃ samavasaraṇatāṃ The S adds ca at this point. gacchanti || 1.118 ||

saṃkṣepato mārṣā avirahitabodhicittasya ratnatrayādhimuktasya paramaduḥśīlasyāpi akhinna akhinna°] S; khinna° Bmānamānasaḥ satatābhiyuktasya madīyamantra­paṭala­visaraanantādbhuta­bodhi­sattva­caryāniḥṣyandita­mānasodbhavaṃ sidhyate ti | nānyathā ca gantavyam | avikalpamānaso bhūtvā jijñāsanahetor api sādhanīyam | iti || 1.119 ||
atha sā sarvāvatī parṣat sabuddhabodhi­sattvapratyeka­buddhārya­śrāvakādhiṣṭhitā evaṃ vācam udīrayantaḥ || 1.120 ||

sādhu sādhu bho jinaputra vicitra­mantra­caryārtha­kriyā­dharma­nayapraveśānuvartinī dharmadeśanā sudeśitā sarvasattvānām arthāya | aho kumara­bhūta mañjuśrīḥ vicitradharmadeśanānuvartinī mantracaryānukūlā subhāṣitā | yo hi kaścit mahā­rāja imaṃ sannipātaparivartaṃ vācayiṣyati, dhārayiṣyati, manasi kariṣyati, saṅgrāme vāgrato hastim āropya sthāpayiṣyati, vividhair vā puṣpadhūpagandhavilepanaiḥ {B24v} pūjayiṣyati tatra vayaṃ saṃnidhānaṃ kalpayiṣyāmaḥ tatra vayaṃ saṃnidhānaṃ kalpayiṣyāmaḥ] B; om. S | pratyarthikānāṃ pratyamitrāṇāṃ vaśam ānayiṣyāmaḥ | parabalasenābhaṅgaṃ ca kariṣyāmaḥ | pustakalikhitaṃ vā kṛtvā svagṛhe sthāpayiṣyati, tasya kulaputrasya vā kuladuhitur vā mahā­rājñasya vā mahā­rājñīya vā bhikṣor vā bhikṣaṇyā vā, upāsakasya vā upāsikāyā vā, mahā­rakṣāṃ mahā­bhogatāṃ, dīrghāyuṣkatāṃ, āyurārogyatāṃ, satatabhogābhivardhanatāṃ ca kariṣyāma iti || 1.121 ||
evam uktās tu sā sarvāvatī parṣat tūṣṇīm abhūt || 1.122 ||
mahā­yānamantracaryānirdeśāt mahā­kalpān mañjuśrīkumara­bhūtabodhi­sattvavikurvaṇapaṭalavisarāt mūlakalpāt prathamaḥ sannipātaparivartaḥ ||

tei:div.head: Chapter A2
tei:div.p: atha khalu mañjuśrīḥ kumara­bhūtaḥ sarvāvantaṃ parṣanmaṇḍalam avalokya sarvasattvasamayānupraveśāvalokinīṃ nāma samādhiṃ samāpadyate sma | samanantarasamāpannasya ca mañjuśriyaḥ kumara­bhūtasya nābhimaṇḍalapradeśād raśmir niścaranti sma | {B25r} anekaraśmi­koṭī­niyuta­śatasahasra­parivāritā samantāt sarvasattvadhātum avabhāsya punar eva taṃ śuddhāvāsabhavanaṃ avabhāsya sthitābhūt || 2.1 ||
atha khalu vajrapāṇir bodhisattvo mahā­sattvo mañjuśriyaṃ kumara­bhūtam āmantrayate sma |

bhāṣa bhāṣa tvaṃ bho jinaputra jinaputra ] S; sems dpa’ chen po D109a.4 sarvasattvasamayānupraveśanaṃ nāma maṇḍalapaṭalavisaraṃ °paṭalavisaraṃ] em.; °paṭala visara° S caryānirhāraṃ sarvasattvasādhāraṇabhūtaṃ °sādhāraṇabhūtaṃ] em.; °sādhāṇarabhūtaṃ B; om. S yatra sattvāḥ maṇḍalapaṭala[ṃ] visaracaryānirhāraṃ sarvasattvasādhāraṇabhūtaṃ yatra sattvāḥ] B; om. S samanupraviśya tvadīyaṃ mantragaṇaṃ sarvalaukikalokottaraṃ ca mantrasiddhiṃ samanuprāpnuvanti || 2.2 ||

evam uktas tu guhyakādhipatinā yakṣendreṇa mañjuśrīḥ kumara­bhūtaḥ paramaguhyamaṇḍalatantraṃ bhāṣate sma | sarvavidyāsañcodanaṃ nāma ṛddhivikurvaṇaṃ nidarśayati ca | dakṣiṇaṃ ca pāṇim udyamya aṅgulyāgreṇa parṣanmaṇḍalam ākārayati ākārayati] S; ston par byed pa D109a.5 sma | tasminn aṅgulyagre anekavidyādhararāja °vidyādhararāja°] S; rig pa’i rgyal po D109a.6–7 koṭīnayutaśatasahasrāṇi niśceruḥ | niścaritvā sarvāvantaṃ śuddhāvāsabhavanaṃ mahatāvabhāsenāvabhāsya {B25v} sthitā abhūvan || 2.3 ||

p.note: Here starts the correspondence with manuscript A.

tei:div.p: atha mañjuśrīḥ kumara­bhūto yamāntakasya krodharājasya hṛdayaṃ sarvakarmikaṃ ekavīraṃ āvāhana­visarjana­śāntika­pauṣṭikābhicārukaantardhānākāśa­gamana­pātāla­praveśana­pāda­pracārikākarṣaṇa­vidveṣaṇavaśīkaraṇa­sarva­gandha­mālya­vilepana­pradīpasvatantra­mantreṣu pradhānaḥ pradhānaḥ] em.; pradānaḥ S saṃkṣepataḥ yathā yathā prayujyate, tathā tathā sādhyamānaḥ | tryakṣaraṃ nāma mahā­vīryaṃ sarvārthasādhanaṃ mahā­krodharājam mahā­krodharājam] S; khro bo’i rgyal po’i sngags smras pa D109b.1 | katamaṃ ca tat || 2.4 ||
oṁ āḥ hrūṃ oṁ āḥ hrūṃ] S; oṁ āḥ hūṁ B, A; oṁ āḥ huṃ D109b.2 |
idaṃ tanmahā­krodhasya hṛdayaṃ sarvakarmikaṃ sarvamaṇḍaleṣu sarvamantracaryāsu ca nirdiṣṭaṃ mahā­sattvena mañjughoṣeṇa sarvavighnavināśanam || 2.5 ||
atha mañjuśrīḥ kumara­bhūtaḥ dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇim udyamya krodhasya mūrdhni sthāpayām āsa | evaṃ cāha |
namaste sarvabuddhānām | samanvāharantu {S26} buddhā bhagavanto ye kecid daśadigloka­dhātuvyavasthitā anantāparyāntāś ca bodhisattvā maharddhikāḥ samayam adhitiṣṭhanta || 2.6 ||

ity evam uktvā taṃ krodharājānaṃ {B26r} bhrāmayitvā kṣipati sma | samanantaranikṣipto mahā­krodharājo sarvāvantaṃ loka­dhātuṃ gatvā kṣaṇamātreṇa ye duṣṭāśayāḥ sattvā maharddhikāḥ tān nigṛhyānayati sma | taṃ mahā­parṣanmaṇḍalaṃ śuddhāvāsabhavanaṃ praveśayati sma | vyavasthāyāṃ ca sthāpayitvā samanta­jvālāmālākulo bhūtvā duṣṭasattveṣu ca mūrdhni tiṣṭhate sma atha mañjuśrīḥ kumara­bhūtaḥ dakṣiṇaṃ … tiṣṭhate sma] B, S; om. A || 2.7 ||
atha mañjuśrīḥ kumara­bhūtaḥ punar api taṃ parṣanmaṇḍalam avalokya |

śṛṇvantu bhavantaḥ sarvasattvāḥ yo hy enaṃ madīyaṃ samayam atikramet tasyāyaṃ krodharājā nigraham āpādayiṣyati | yat kāraṇam anatikramaṇīyā buddhānāṃ bhagavatāṃ samayarahasyamantrārthavacanapathāḥ bodhisattvānāṃ ca maharddhikānāṃ samāsanirdeśataḥ kathayiṣyāmi | taṃ śruṇuta sādhu ca suṣṭhu ca manasi kuruta | bhāṣiṣye 'ham || 2.8 ||

namaḥ samanta­buddhānām samanta­buddhānām] S; sarva bud dhā nāṃ D110a.1 | oṁ ra ra smara apratihataśāsana kumārarūpadhāriṇa °dhāriṇa] S; °dhā ri ne D110a.2. The Peking and Yongle recensions of the Kangyur read dhā ra ṇi; the Lithang and Choné recensions accord with the Sanskrit: dha ri ṇa. hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ] S; om. D; both the Narthang and Zhol recensions attest to two instances of phaṭ. svāhā || 2.9 ||

ayaṃ sa mārṣā madīyamūlamantraḥ {B26v} ārya­mañjuśriyaṃ nāma | mudrā pañcaśikhā mahā mahā°] S; om. Dmudreti vikhyātā taṃ prayojayed asmin mūlamantre mūlamantre] S; rtsa ba’i sngags ’di ni las thams cad pa zhes bya’o D110a.2 || 2.10 ||
sarvakarmikaṃ bhavati hṛdayam | {V18} vakṣye sarvakarmakaraṃ śivam vakṣye sarvakarmakaraṃ śivam] S; om. D110a.3 |
oṁ vākye da namaḥ vākyeda] S; vā kye daṃ D110a.3. This form is perhaps a BHS for vākye • idaṃ. || 2.11 ||
mudrā cātra bhavati triśikheti vikhyātā sarvabhogābhivarddhanī || 2.12 ||
upahṛdayaṃ cātra bhavati |
vākye hūṃ || 2.13 ||
mudrā cātra bhavati triśikheti vikhyātā sarvasattvākarṣaṇī || 2.14 ||
ekākṣaraṃ paramahṛdayaṃ cātra bhavati |
oṁ muṁ] em.; muṃ S; maṃ D; oṁ +ḥ A; om. B; || 2.15 ||

mudrā bhavati cātra mayūrāsaneti vikhyātā sarva­sattva­vaśaṅkarī Manuscript A breaks off at this point (A1v6); it will resume again at MMK 2.19 below. sarvabuddhānāṃ hṛdayam sarvabuddhānāṃ hṛdayam] S; om. D || 2.16 ||

aparam api mahā­vīraṃ nāma aṣṭākṣaraṃ aparaṃ … aṣṭākṣaraṃ] S; gzhan yang phyag rgya thams cad kyi snying po dpa’ bo chen po zhes bya ba yi ge brgyas yod de D110a.5 paramaśreyasaṃ mahāpavitraṃ tribhavavartmo °vartmo°] S; chos D110a.5 pacchedanaṃ sarvadurgatinivāraṇaṃ sarvaśāntikaraṃ sarvakarmakaraṃ kṣemaṃ kṣemam] S; om. D nirvāṇaprāpaṇaṃ buddham iva saṃmukhadarśanopasthitam | svayam eva eva] S; bzhin du D110a.6 mañjuśrīr ayaṃ bodhi­sattvaḥ svayam … bodhi­sattvaḥ] S; byang chub sems dpa’ ’jam dpal gzhon nu ’gyur pa nyid bzhin du nye bar gnas pa D110a.6 sarvasattvānām arthāya paramaguhyamantrarūpiṇopasthitaḥ paramaguhyamantrarūpiṇopasthitaḥ] B; paramahṛdayaṃ mantrarūpeṇopasthitaḥ S; mchog tu gsang ba’i ngo bos nye bar gnas pa D110a.6–7 sarvāśāpāripūrakaṃ yatra smaritamātreṇa pañcānantaryāṇi pariśodhayati | kaḥ punarvādo jāpena jāpena] B (supported by the Tib.); jāyate S | {B27r} katamaṃ ca tat || 2.17 ||
oṁ āḥ dhīra dhīra] S; vīra D110a.7 hūṃ khecaraḥ khecara] D; khacara MSS ||

eṣa saḥ mārṣāḥ svayam svayam] B; yūyam S evāham aṣṭākṣaraṃ mahā­vīraṃ paramaguhyahṛdayaṃ buddhatvam iva | pratyupasthitam pratyupasthitam] B (confirmed by D110b.1); pratyayasthitam S sarvakāryeṣu {S27} saṃkṣepataḥ | mahā­guṇavistaro na na] conj.; nu B; om. S śakyate sma anekakālakalpakoṭinayutaśatasahasrair api guṇāparyantaniṣṭhaṃ guṇāparyantaniṣṭhaṃ] seemingly om. in D110b.1. The line includes yon tan gyi mtha’ rgya chen po, but this is closer to mahā­guṇa­vistara, which appears earlier in the Sanskrit line. It is possible the Tibetan translator assimilated these two compounds. vaktum iti | mudrā cātra bhavati mahā­vīryeti vikhyātā sarvāśāpāripūrakī || 2.18 ||
Manuscript A resumes at this point (A1v6). āhvānanamantraś cātra bhavati |

oṁ he he kumāra viśvarūpiṇe {A2r} sarvabālabhāṣitaprabodhane | āyāhi bhagavann āyāhi | kumāra kumāra°] S; om. Dkrīḍotpaladhāriṇe maṇḍalamadhye maṇḍalamadhye] B, S; paṭamadhye A tiṣṭha tiṣṭha | samayam anusmara | apratihataśāsana hūṁ | mā vilamba | kuru kuru] B, D110b.3; ru ru S; ** A | phaṭ svāhā || 2.19 ||

eṣa bhagavanmañjuśriyaḥ āhvānanamantrā sarvasattvānāṃ sarvabuddhānāṃ] em. (on the authority of D110b.3); sarvasattvānāṃ S sarvabodhisattvānāṃ sarvapratyeka­buddhārya­śrāvakadeva­nāga­yakṣa­gandharva­garuḍa­kinnara­mahoraga­piśācarākṣasa­sarva­bhūtānāṃ ceti || 2.20 ||

saptābhimantritaṃ candanodakaṃ kṛtvā caturdiśam ity ūrdhvam adhas tiryak sarvataḥ kṣipet | sarvabuddhabodhisattvāḥ mañjuśriyaś ca svayaṃ saparivāraḥ sarvalaukikalokottarāś ca mantrāḥ sarve ca bhūtagaṇāḥ sarvasattvāś ca {B27v} āgatā bhaveyuḥ || 2.21 ||

namaḥ sarvabuddhānām sarvabuddhānām] B, S; samanta­buddhānām A apratihataśāsanānām | oṁ dhu dhura dhura dhūpavāsini dhūpārciṣi dhūpavāsini dhūpārciṣi] S; dhūmavāsini dhūmārciṣi B hūṃ tiṣṭha samayam anusmara svāhā | dhūpamantraḥ || 2.22 ||

candanaṃ karpūraṃ kuṅkumaṃ caikīkṛtya dhūpaṃ dāpayet tatas tatas] conj. (on the authority of the Tib.); tata āgatānāṃ S tathāgatānāṃ sarvabodhisattvānāṃ sarvasattvānāṃ sarvasattvānāṃ] B; om. S ca | dhūpāpyāyitamanasaḥ ākṛṣṭā ākṛṣṭā] S; om. D bhavanti | bhavati cātra mudrā yasya padmamāleti vikhyātā sarvasattvākarṣaṇī śivā | āhvānanamantrāś ca • ayam āhvānanamantrāś ca • ayam] S; bya ba’i phyag rgya ’di nyid do D111a.1 eva mudrā padmamālā śubhā || 2.23 ||

āgatānāṃ ca sarvabuddhabodhisattvānāṃ sarvasattvānāṃ cāgatānāṃ arghyo deyaḥ | karpūracandanakuṅkumair udakam āloḍya jātī­kusuma­nava­mālika­vārṣika­puṃnāganāga­bakula­piṇḍīta­garair eteṣām anyatamena puṣpeṇa yathartukena vā sugandhapuṣpeṇa miśrīkṛtya anena mantreṇa argho deyaḥ || 2.24 ||

namaḥ sarvabuddhānām sarvabuddhānām] MSS; samanta­buddhānām A apratihataśāsanānām | tadyathā | he he mahā­kāruṇika viśvarūpadhāriṇe °dhāriṇe] S; dhā ra ni D111a.3 arghaṃ pratīccha pratīccha] S; om. D pratīcchāpaya samayam anusmara tiṣṭha tiṣṭha maṇḍalamadhye maṇḍalamadhye] MSS; paṭamadhye A praveśaya praviśa {A2v} sarvabhūtānukampaka gṛhṇa gṛhṇa hūṃ | ambaravicāriṇe svāhā || 2.25 ||

mudrā cātra pūrṇeti vikhyātā sarvasattvānuvartinī sarvasattvānuvartinī] em.; sarvasatvānuvartinī B; sarvabuddhānuvartinī S dhruvā sarvabuddhānuvartinī dhruvā] S; sarvasattvānuvartinī dharmmān B | gandhamantraś {B28r} cātra bhavati || 2.26 ||

namaḥ sarvabuddhānāṃ sarvabuddhānāṃ] B, S; samanta­buddhānāṃ A, D namaḥ samanta­gandhāvabhāsaśriyāya °śriyāya] S; śri ye D111a.4 tathāgatāya | tadyathā | gandhe gandhe gandhāḍhye gandhamanorame °manorame] S; ma no ra the D111a.4 pratīccha pratīccheyaṃ pratīccheyaṃ] S; pra tī ccha maṃ D111a.4 gandhaṃ samatānucāriṇe °anucāriṇe] S; anu cā ri ṇi D111a.4 svāhā || 2.27 ||
bhavati {S28} cātra mudrā pallavā nāma sarvāśāpāripūrikā | puṣpamantraś cātra bhavati || 2.28 ||

namaḥ sarvabuddhānām sarvabuddhānāṃ] B, S; samanta­buddhānāṃ A, D apratihataśāsanānām | namaḥ saṃkusumita­rājasya tathāgatasya | tadyathā | kusume kusume kusumāḍhye kusuma­pura­vāsini kusumāvati svāhā ||
tenaiva dhūpa­mantreṇa pūrvoktenaiva dhūpena dhūpayet || 2.29 || {V19}

sarva­buddhān namaskṛtya acintyādbhutarūpiṇām |
balimantraṃ pravakṣyāmi samyak sambuddha­bhāṣitam || 2.30 ||

namaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisattvānām sarvabuddhabodhisattvānām] B, S; samanta­buddhānām A; sarva bud dha nāṃ D111a.7 apratihataśāsanānāṃ | tadyathā | he he bhagavan mahā­sattva buddhāvalokita buddhāvalokita mā vilamba] S; sarvā lo ki te D111a.7 mā vilamba mā vilamba] S; om. D | idaṃ baliṃ gṛhṇāpaya gṛhṇa hūṃ hūṃ sarvaviśva ra ra ṭa ṭa phaṭ phaṭ] S; sphaṭ D111a.7 svāhā || 2.31 ||
nivedyaṃ cānena dāpayed baliṃ ca sarvabhautikam | bhavati cātra mudrā śaktiḥ sarvaduṣṭanivāriṇī || 2.32 ||

namaḥ sarvabuddhānām sarvabuddhānām] B, S; samanta­buddhānām A, D111b.1 apratihataśāsanānāṃ sarvatamo'ndhakāravidhvaṃsināṃ | namaḥ samanta­jyotigandhāvabhāsaśriyāya °śriyāya] S; śri ye D111b.1 tathāgatāya | tadyathā | he he bhagavan jyotiraśmiśatasahasrapratimaṇḍitaśarīra {B28v} vikurva vikurva | mahā­bodhi­sattvasamanta­jvāloddyotitamūrti khurda khurda | avalokaya avalokaya sarvasattvānāṃ svāhā avalokaya … svāhā] S; a va lo ka ya mān | laṃ sarva | sattvānāṃ ca svā hā D111b.2 || 2.33 ||
pradīpamantrā | pradīpaṃ cānena dāpayet Manuscript A breaks off at this point (A2v5). The correspondence will resume again in chapter 7. | mudrā vikāsinī nāma sarvasattvāvalokinī || 2.34 ||

durdāntadamako śreṣṭhaḥ bhogināṃ viṣanāśanam °nāśanam] S; °nāsinaḥ B || 2.96 ||
mahā­mudrāyā samāyuktaḥ hanty anarthā anarthā] B; anartha S sudāruṇām |
vicikitsayati na saṃdeho viṣā sthāvarajaṅgamām viṣā sthāvarajaṅgamām] B; viṣaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam S || 2.97 ||
sattvān upāyavaineyāṃ °vaineyāṃ] B; °vaineyā S bodhi­sattvasamājñayā |
vicerur garuḍarūpeṇa pākṣirāṭ sa mahādyutiḥ || 2.98 ||
yāvanto gāruḍe tantre kathitāḥ kalpavistarāḥ |
te mayaivoditāḥ sarve sattvānāṃ hitakāraṇāt || 2.99 || {B33r}
garutmā bodhi­sattvas tu vainateyārtham ihāgataḥ |
bhogināṃ viṣanāśāya viceruḥ pakṣirūpiṇaḥ || 2.100 || {S35}
yāvanto laukikā mantrāḥ te 'smin 'smin] em.; 'smi S; tasmin B kalpa udāhṛtāḥ |
vaineyārthaṃ hi sattvānāṃ vicarāmi tathā tathā || 2.101 ||
ye tu tāthāgatā tāthāgatā] B; tāthāgatī S mantrāḥ kuliśābja kuliśābja°] B; kuliśāṅku° Skulayor api |
te 'smin kalpavistare bhāṣitāḥ pūrvam eva tu || 2.102 ||
yathā hi dhātrī bahudhā bālaṃ lālayati bālaṃ lālayati] B; bālānāṃ lālati S yatnataḥ |
tathā bāliśabuddhīnāṃ mantrarūpī carāmy aham || 2.103 ||
daśabalaiḥ daśabalaiḥ] B; daśabalai S kathitaṃ pūrvam pūrvam] B; pūrve S adhunā ca mayoditam |
sakalaṃ mantratantrārthaṃ kumāro 'pyāha 'pyāha] S; prāha B mahādyutiḥ || 2.104 ||
jinavaraiś ca ye gītā gītā daśabalātmajaiḥ |
mañjusvareṇa te gītā acintyādbhutarūpiṇām || 2.105 ||

tei:div.p: atha khalu mañjuśrīḥ kumara­bhūtaḥ sarvāvantaṃ śuddhāvāsabhavanaṃ taṃ ca mahā­parṣanmaṇḍalam avalokya sarvasamayasañcodanī °sañcodanī] B; °sañcodanīṃ S nāma samādhiṃ samāpadyate sma | yatra samādheḥ pratiṣṭhitasya • aśeṣasattvanirhāra °nirhāra°] S; °nirahāra° Bcaryāmanasaḥ sarvasattvāḥ sarvasattvāḥ] em.; sarvasattvā S; sarvasattvāṃ B; om. D pratiṣṭhitā bhaveyuḥ || 2.106 ||

taṃ taṃ] B; ta S divyam ārya­maṇḍalasamayanirhārā °nirhārā° B; °nirhāra° Svasthānāvasthitaṃ mañjuśriyaṃ kumara­bhūtaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve buddhā bhagavantaḥ sarvapratyeka­buddhāḥ sarve • ārya­śrāvakāḥ sarve bodhisattvā daśabhūmipratiṣṭhitā yauvarājyābhiṣekasamanuprāptāś caryā °prāptāś caryā°] em.; °prāptacaryā° B; °prāptā āryā° Spratipannāś ca sarve sattvāḥ sattvāḥ] em.; sattvā S, B sāsravā anāsravāś ca mañjuśriyaḥ kumara­bhūtasyādhiṣṭhānenācintyaṃ buddhabodhisattvācaryā °caryā°] B; °cāryā° Sniṣyanditaṃ samādhiviśeṣamānasodbhavaṃ maṇḍalaṃ praviṣṭam ātmānaṃ saṃjānante sma | na śakyate tat pṛthagjanaiḥ sattvaiḥ manasāpy manasāpy] B; samanasāpy S ālambayituṃ ālambayituṃ] S; avalambayituṃ B kaḥ punarvādo likhituṃ lekhayituṃ lekhayituṃ] S; om. B vā || 2.108 || {V25}

atha mañjuśrīḥ kumara­bhūtaḥ, tān tān] em.; tāṃ S, B mahā­parṣanmaṇḍalasamayam anupraviṣṭān anupraviṣṭān] B; anupraviṣṭaḥ S sattvān āmantrayate sma | śṛṇvantu mārṣāḥ | anatikramaṇīyam etat The phrase anatikramaṇīyam etat should perhaps be regarded as a (BHS) masculine, as it is in apposition to samayaḥ. tathāgatānāṃ {S36} bodhisattvānāṃ ca samayaḥ kaḥ punarvādo 'nyeṣāṃ sattvānām āryānāryāṇām || 2.109 ||

atha atha] S; atha khalu B mañjuśrīḥ kumara­bhūto vajrapāṇiṃ guhyakādhipatim āmantrayate sma | nirdiṣṭaṃ bho jinaputrātikrānta °tikrānta° S; °vikrānta° Bmānuṣyakaṃ {B34r} samayaṃ mānasodbhavam | mānuṣyakaṃ tu vakṣye parinirvṛtānāṃ ca tathāgatānāṃ yatra sattvāḥ sattvāḥ] em.; sattvā S; sattvānām B samanupraviśya sarvamantrā °mantrā] B; °mahā° S laukikalokottarā siddhiṃ gaccheyuḥ || 2.110 ||
atha khalu vajrapāṇir guhyakā guhyakā° B; guhyā° Sdhipatiḥ mañjuśriyaṃ kumara­bhūtam āmantrayate sma | bhāṣa bhāṣa bhāṣa bhāṣa] S; bhāṣa B tvaṃ bho jinaputra yasyedānīṃ kālaṃ manyase || 2.111 ||

lg.l: parinirvṛte lokanāthe śākyasiṃhe anuttare |
buddhatva iva sattvānāṃ tvadīyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ bhuvi || 2.112 ||
dṛṣṭimātre °mātre] B; °mātro S hi loke 'smin mantrā siddhiṃ prajagmire |
ajñānavidhihīnāṃ °hīnāṃ] B; °hīnaṃ S tu samayo 'nadhikṛtena śayānavikṛtena] S; samayo 'nadhikṛtena B vā || 2.113 ||
mantrā siddhiṃ na gaccheyur brahmasyāpi mahātmanaḥ |
anabhiyuktā anabhiyuktā] S; anabhiyukto 'tra (unmetrical) B tantre 'smin adṛṣṭasamayodite || 2.114 ||
mantrā mantrā] S; tantrā B siddhiṃ na gacchanti yatnenāpy anekadā anekadā] S; anekadhā B |
samayaprayogahīnaṃ śakrasyāpi prayatnataḥ || 2.115 ||
mantrasiddhiṃ mantrasiddhiṃ] B; mantrāḥ siddhiṃ S na gacchanti kiṃ punar bhuvi mānuṣe |
samayaśāstratattvajñe caryākarmasu sādhane °jñe caryākarmasu sādhane S; °jño yā ca karmā subodhane B |
paṭhitamātrā hi sidhyante māntrā māntrā] B; mātrā S āryā ca laukikāḥ || 2.116 ||
maṇḍalaṃ mañjughoṣasya praviṣṭaḥ sarvakarmakṛt |
mantrasiddhir dhruvaṃ tasya kumārasyeva kumārasyeva] em. (on the authority of the Tib.); kumārasyaiva S, B śāsane || 2.117 ||

tei:div.p: atha khalu vajrapāṇir guhyakādhipatis taṃ guhyakādhipatis taṃ] em.; guhyakādhipatiṣṭha B; guhyādhipatiḥ taṃ S mahā­sattvam adhyeṣate adhyeṣate] B (supported by the Tib.); °adhye bhāṣate S sma | saṃkṣepato bho bho mahā­bodhi­sattva sattvānām sattvānām] S; mahātmā B arthāya maṇḍalavidhānaṃ bhāṣasveti || 2.118 ||
evam {B34v} uktas tu guhyakādhipatinā mañjuśrīḥ kumara­bhūtaḥ sarvasattvānām arthāya maṇḍalavidhānaṃ bhāṣate sma || 2.119 ||

ādau tāvat pratihārakapakṣe caitravaiśākhe ca māse sitapakṣe praśastadivase śuddhagrahanirīkṣite śubhanakṣatrasaṃyukte śuklapratipadi pūrṇamāsyāṃ vā anyasmin anyasmin] B; anye S vā kāle prāvṛṇmāsavivarjite pūrvāhṇe bhūmim adhiṣṭhātavyam || 2.120 ||

mahānagaram āsṛtya āsṛtya] S; samāsṛtya B yatra vā svayaṃ tiṣṭhen {S37} maṇḍalācāryaś ca maṇḍalācāryaś ca] B; maṇḍalācāryaḥ śva samudrāgāminīṃ vā nadīm āśrityaḥ samudrā samudrā] S; om. Btaṭasamīpaṃ vā mahānagarasya pūrvottare digbhāge nātidūre nātyāsanne maṇḍalācāryeṇa †sattvānā sattvānā S; gandhā B† saptāhaṃ pakṣamātraṃ vā • ekānte • uṭajaṃ kṛtvā uṭajaṃ kṛtvā] em.; uḍayaṃ kṛttvā S; kṣutrayaṃ kṛtvā B prativastavyam || 2.121 ||

yas tasmin sthāne sucaukṣaṃ pṛthivīpradeśaṃ samantāc caturasraṃ ṣoḍaśahastaṃ dvādaśahastaṃ vā samantāc caturasraṃ ṣoḍaśahastaṃ dvādaśahastaṃ vā] S; om. B apagatapāṣāṇakaṭhalla kaṭhalla] V; kaṭhaṇṇa S; kaṃṭhaka Bbhasmāṅgāratuṣakapālāsthivarjitaṃ sucaukṣaṃ sucaukṣaṃ] S; sucauktaṃ B suparikarmitaṃ suparikarmitaṃ] em.; supasuparikarmitaṃ S; saparikaritiṃ B pṛthivīpradeśaṃ niḥprāṇakeno niḥprāṇakeno°] B; nighrātmakeno° Sdakena pañcagavyasaṃmiśritena candanakarpūrakuṅkumodakena vā yamāntakena krodha­rājenāṣṭa­sahasrābhimantritena {V26} pañca­śikha­mahā­mudrā­saṃyuktena taṃ pṛthivīpradeśaṃ abhyukṣayec caturdikṣu ity ūrdhvamadhastiryag {B35r} vidikṣu ca sarvataḥ kṣipet || 2.122 ||

tato taṃ pṛthivīpradeśaṃ samantāc caturasraṃ ṣoḍaśahastaṃ dvādaśahastaṃ dvādaśahastaṃ] S; vā daśahastaṃ B vā • aṣṭahastaṃ vā | tatra ṣoḍaśahastaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ madhyaṃ dvādaśahastaṃ kanyasaṃ aṣṭahastam | etat trividhaṃ proktaṃ maṇḍalaṃ sarvadarśibhiḥ | rājyakāmāya tato jyeṣṭhaṃ madhyamaṃ sambhoga­vardhanaṃ kanyasaṃ samayamātraṃ tu sarvakarmakaraṃ śivam || 2.123 ||

tato 'nyatamaṃ manasepsitaṃ maṇḍalam ālikhet | tatra taṃ pṛthivīpradeśaṃ dvihastamātraṃ khanet | tatra pāṣāṇāṅgārabhasmāsthikeśādayo vividhā vā prāṇakajātayo yadi dṛśyante • anyaṃ pṛthivīpradeśaṃ khanet | nirupahatyaṃ nirupadravaṃ bhavet | na cet parvatāgranadīpulina °pulina°] S; °pulinasamudrāir saṃgamahā­nadīpulina° Bsamudrotsaṅgamahā­nadīpulinasikatādicayaṃ mahatā prayatnena prayatnena] B; prayatnataḥ S sa sa] S; su° B pratyavekṣitaṃ sucaukṣaṃ niḥprāṇakaṃ kṛtvā likhet || 2.124 ||

taṃ pṛthivīpradeśaṃ bhūyo niḥprāṇakeno niḥprāṇakeno°] B; niḥprāṇeno° Sdakena pañcagavyasaṃmiśreṇa nadīkūlamṛttikayā medhyayā valmīkamṛttikayā vā yatra prāṇakā na santi tayā mṛttikayā pūrayitavyam | pūrayitvā ca svākoṭitaṃ samatalaṃ samantāt trividhaṃ maṇḍalaṃ yathepsitaṃ kārayet | caturdikṣu catvāraḥ khadirakīlakān nikhanet krodharājenaiva {B35v} saptābhimantritaṃ kṛtvā | pañcaraṅgikeṇa sūtreṇa saptābhimantritena krodhahṛdayena kṛtvā samantāt samantāt] B; samantā S tan maṇḍalaṃ caturasrākāreṇa veṣṭayet || 2.125 ||

evaṃ madhyame sthāne evam abhyantare caturasrākāraṃ kārayet | madhyasthānasthitena °sthitena] S; °sthite B maṇḍalācāryeṇa vidyā • aṣṭasahasraṃ mūlamantrā uccārayitavyā | mahā­mudrāṃ mahā­mudrāṃ] B; mahā­mudrā S pañcaśikhāṃ baddhvā mūlamantreṇa sahāya sahāya°] B; sasakhāya° Srakṣā • ātmarakṣā ca kāryā | japataś ca bahir niṣkramet bahir niṣkramet] em.; bahi niṣkaset B; niṣkasarvahi° S | tan tan] em.; tat B; om. S maṇḍalaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya prāṅmukhaḥ kuśaviṇḍakopaviṣṭaḥ {S38} sarvabuddhabodhisattvānāṃ °sattvānāṃ] S; °sattvāt° B manasi kurvāṇaḥ | samantāc ca tan maṇḍalaṃ caturasrākāreṇa veṣṭayet | tatraiva ca tatraiva ca] B; om. S bahir†gār dve† °gārddhe(?)] B; °nādhaḥ S • ekarātroṣitān °oṣitān] em.; °oṣitāṃ S, B kṛtvā pravāsayet || 2.126 ||

tatra maṇḍalācāryeṇa kṛtapuraścaraṇena svatantramantrakuśalena • upāyasattvārthamahā­yānādhimuktena ekarātroṣitena susakhāyasametena °sametena] S; °satena B vidhinā vidhinā] B; vidhi° S śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā pañcaraṅgikena cūrṇena ślakṣṇojjvālena suparikarmakṛtena ṣaḍakṣarābhimantrite °ābhimantrite] S; °ābhimantrita° B hṛdayenābhimantrya °ābhimantrya] B; °ābhimantyaṃ S taṃ cūrṇaṃ maṇḍalamadhye sthāpayet || 2.127 ||

bahiś cocchrita bahiś cocchrita°] S; bahisvocchrita° Bdhvajapatākatoraṇacatuṣṭayālaṅkṛtaṃ °toraṇacatuṣṭayālaṅkṛtaṃ] B; °toraṇe catuṣpathālaṅkṛtaṃ S kadalīstambharopita­phala­bharita­piṇḍībhiḥ {B36r} pralambamānam āhatabherīmṛdaṅgaśaṅkhatantrī °tantrī°] S; °nadī° Bnirghoṣanināditaṃ taṃ °taṃ taṃ] em.; °ta taṃ B; °taṃ S pṛthivīpradeśaṃ kuryāt | praśastaśabdair °śabdair] em.; °śabdai B; °śabda° S dharmaśravaṇacatuḥparṣānukūlamahā­yānasūtrān °sūtrān] em.; °sūtrāṃ S; °sūtrānta B caturdikṣu pustakān pustakān] em.; pustakāṃ S; pustakam B vācayan | tadyathā || 2.128 ||

bhagavatī prajñāpāramitā dakṣiṇāyāṃ dakṣiṇāyāṃ] B; dakṣiṇāṃ S diśi vācayet | ārya­candrapradīpasamādhiṃ °samādhiṃ] B; °samādhiḥ S paścimāyāṃ diśi | ārya­gaṇḍavyūham °vyūham] B; °vyūha S uttarāyāṃ diśi | ārya­suvarṇaprabhāsottamasūtraṃ pūrvāyāṃ diśi | evam adhītacatuḥsūtrāntikān pudgalān dharmabhāṇakān °sūtrāntikān pudgalān dharmabhāṇakān] em.; °sūtrāntikāṃ pudgalāṃ dharmabhāṇakāṃ B; °sūtrāntikaṃ pudgalāṃ dharmabhāṇakaṃ S pustakābhāvād pustakābhāvād] S; pustakavācakād B adhyeṣayet adhyeṣayet] B; addhyeṣayet S | dharmaśravaṇāya tato maṇḍalācāryeṇotthāya candanakarpūrakuṅkumavyāmiśrakeṇa śvetasugandhapuṣpair mūlamantraṃ japatā sarvatas taṃ sarvatas taṃ] S; parvataḥ staṃ B maṇḍalam abhikiret | abhikīrya ca bahir nirgacchet || 2.129 ||

lg.l: maṇḍalaṃ darśanād eva eva] B; evaṃ S kiṃ punar mantrasādhane |
sattvānām alpapuṇyānāṃ nirvṛte śākyapuṅgave |
kuta evaṃvidhā bhogā vidhir eṣā tu kathyate kathyate] B; kalpyate S || 2.131 ||
daridrajanatāṃ dṛṣṭvā mañjughoṣo mahā­dyutiḥ |
udīrayet kalpa kalpa°] S; alpa° Bsaṃkṣepaṃ maṇḍalaṃ tu samāsataḥ || 2.132 ||
śālitaṇḍulacūrṇais tu sūkṣmaiḥ pañcaraṅgojjvalaiḥ | {S39}
śuklapītaraktakṛṣṇaharitavarṇair varṇayet || 2.133 ||

tei:div.p: pūrvasthāpitakaṃ cūrṇaṃ cūrṇaṃ] S; pūrṇaṃ B maṇḍalācāryeṇa svayaṃ gṛhya mahā­mudrāṃ pañcaśikhāṃ baddhvā mūlamantraṃ japatā japatā] S; japatāṃ B taṃ cūrṇaṃ mudrāyet | apareṇa tu sādhakācāryeṇa maṇḍala maṇḍala°] S; maṇḍale Bbahirdakṣiṇapūrvāyāṃ diśi vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā • agnikuṇḍaṃ kārayet | dvihastapramāṇaṃ hastamātranimnaṃ samantāt padmapuṣkarākāram || 2.134 ||

bahiḥ padmapuṣkarākāra bahiḥ padmapuṣkarākāra°] em.; bahiḥ padmapuṣkarākārā S; om. Bpalāśakāṣṭhasamidbhir agniṃ prajvālya śrīphala śrīphala°] S; śrīphalā° Bkāṣṭhasamidhānāṃ vitastimātrapramāṇānāṃ sārdrāṇāṃ sārdrāṇāṃ] em.; sāṃdrāṇāṃ B; sādrāṃ S dadhimadhughṛtāktānāṃ °ghṛtāktānāṃ] B; ghṛtāktā S mūlamantra mūlamantra°] B; mūlamantraṃ Sṣaḍakṣarahṛdayena vā mudrāmuṣṭiṃ mudrāmuṣṭiṃ] S; mudrāyaṣṭiṃ B baddhvā • āhvayet | āhūya ca pūrvoktainaiva • {B37r} ekākṣaramūlamantrahṛdayena bhūyo 'ṣṭaśataṃ juhuyāt || 2.135 ||

tato maṇḍalācāryeṇa baddhoṣṇīṣakṛtaparikarātmanā °parikarātmanā] em.; °parikaraātmanā B; °parikaraḥ ātmanā S citrakarāṃś ca nipuṇatarān nipuṇatarān] B (supported by D); nipuṇatarān ātmanā S kārayet | tato maṇḍalācāryeṇa buddhabodhisattvān °bodhisattvān] B; bodhisattvāṃ S manasi kurvatā pūrvoktenaiva dhūpamantreṇa dhūpaṃ dahatā • añjaliṃ kṛtvā sarvabuddhabodhisattvān °bodhisattvān] em.; °bodhisattvāṃ S; °sasāyogānāṃ B praṇamya mañjuśriyaṃ kumara­bhūtaṃ namaskṛtya cūrṇaṃ gṛhītvā • ākārayet | rūpaṃ rūpaṃ rūpaṃ rūpaṃ] B; rūpaṃ S citrakaraiś ca pūrayitavyam | etena vidhinā prathamata eva tāvad tāvad] B; om. S buddhaṃ bhagavantaṃ śākya­muniṃ sarvākāravaropetaṃ ratnasiṃhāsanopaviṣṭaṃ śuddhāvāsabhavanasthaṃ °bhavanasthaṃ] B; °vabhanasthaṃ S dharmaṃ deśayamānam ālikhet | ālikhitaś ālikhitaś] B; likhitaś S ca maṇḍalācāryasyānusādhakena • ātmarakṣāvidhānaṃ mūlamantreṇa kṛtvā sarvabhautikā °bhautikā] B; °bhūtikā S balir deyā | caturdikṣūrdhvam adho bahir maṇḍalasya kṣipet || 2.136 ||

tataḥ snātvā agnikuṇḍasamīpaṃ gatvā śucivastraprāvṛtena śucinā kṛtarakṣā kṛtarakṣā°] B; kṛtā rakṣā° Svidhānena ghṛtāhutīnāṃ kuṅkumamiśrāṇām aṣṭasahasraṃ juhuyān mūlamantreṇa | tataḥ kuśaviṇḍakopaviṣṭena jāpaṃ jāpaṃ] B; japaṃ S kurvatā kurvatā B; kurvataḥ S tatraiva sthātavyam || 2.137 ||

dvitīyamaṇḍalād bahis tṛtīyamaṇḍalaṃ bhavati | caturdiśaṃ caturdiśaṃ] S; caturdiśaś B catvāro mahā­rājānaḥ anupūrvata ālekhyāḥ | uttarāyāṃ diśi praveṣato praveṣato] em.; praviṣato B; praviśato S dakṣiṇato dakṣiṇato] em.; dakṣiṇata B; dakṣiṇaḥ S dhanado dhanado] em.; dhanadaḥ S; dhanadā B nidhisamīpasthaḥ sarvālaṅkārabhūṣita īṣadbhagnakirīṭo yakṣarūpī | tasya dakṣiṇato maṇibhadra maṇibhadra°] S; māṇibhadra° Bpūrṇabhadrau yakṣasenāpatī ālekhyau || 2.158 || {S44}

evam anupūrvataḥ hārītī mahā­yakṣiṇī • ālekhyā | priyaṅkaraḥ kumāra utsaṅgopaviṣṭo maṇḍalaṃ nirīkṣamāṇa ālekhyaḥ ālekhyaḥ] B; ālekhyāḥ S | pañcikaḥ piṅgalaḥ vibhīṣaṇaś vibhīṣaṇaś] B; bhīṣaṇaś S ca ālekhyaḥ | teṣāṃ ca samīpe yakṣāṇāṃ mudrā ālekhyāḥ || 2.159 ||
evam anupūrvato varuṇaḥ pāśahastaḥ paścimāyāṃ {B41v} diśi ālekhyaḥ | nāgau nandopanandau takṣakavāsukiprabhṛtayo 'ṣṭau mahā­nāgarājāna ālekhyāḥ || 2.160 ||

evaṃ dvipaṅktyāśritā anupūrvato yakṣarākṣasagandharva °gandharva°] B; om. Skiṃnaramahoragaṛṣayaḥ siddha­preta­piśāca­garuḍa­kinnara­manuṣyāmanuṣyādyā oṣadhayaś ca maṇiratnaviśeṣāḥ parvatāḥ sarito dvīpāś ca • anupūrvataḥ sarve pradhānākhyā mukhyatamāś cābhilekhyāḥ pradhānākhyā mukhyatamāś cābhilekhyāḥ] B; pradhānā lekhyā S || 2.161 ||

dakṣiṇāyāṃ diśi yama ālekhyaḥ saparivāro mātarāḥ sapta | pūrvadakṣiṇāyāṃ diśi • agniḥ samanta­jvālamālākulo daṇḍakamaṇḍalu•akṣasūtravyagrapāṇir jaṭāmakuṭadhārī śvetavastranivastaḥ paṭṭāṃśukottarāsaṅgikaḥ śvetayajñopavītaḥ kanakavarṇo bhasmatripuṇḍrīkṛtaḥ °puṇḍrīkṛtaḥ] B; °puṇḍarīkṛtaḥ S | {V31} evaṃ nānābharaṇa nānābharaṇa° B; nānākaraṇa Spraharaṇaveṣasaṃsthānavarṇataś ca °varṇataś ca] B; °varṇatattva° S dvipaṅktyāśritā ālekhyāḥ || 2.162 ||

sarvataḥ praviśato bahirmaṇḍale umāpatir vṛṣavāhanas triśūlapāṇir umā ca devī kanakavarṇā sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitā | kārttikeyaś ca mayūrāsanaḥ śaktyudyatahastaḥ kumārarūpī ṣaṇmukhaḥ ṣaṇmukhaḥ] S; ṣaḍmuṣa B raktābhāsamūrtiḥ raktābhāsamūrtiḥ] S; raktanāmamūrtti B pītavastranivastaḥ pītavastrottarāsaṅgo vāmahastena {B42r} ghaṇṭāṃ ghaṇṭāṃ] S; paṭaṃ B gṛhītvā raktapatākāṃ ca | anupūrvato bhṛṅgiriṭir bhṛṅgiriṭir] em.; bhṛṅgiriṭi S; bhṛṅgirīṭir B; atyantakṛśākāro mahā­gaṇapatiś ca mahā­gaṇapatiś ca] B; mahā­gaṇapati S nandikeśvaramahā­kālau mātarāḥ sapta yathābharaṇa yathābharaṇa° S; yathākaraṇa° Bpraharaṇaveṣasaṃsthānābhilekhyāḥ || 2.163 ||

aṣṭau vasavaḥ saptarṣayo viṣṇuś cakrapāṇiś caturbhujo gadāśaṅkhāsihasto garuḍāsanaḥ sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitaś ca | aṣṭau grahāḥ saptaviṃśatinakṣatrā ye pracaranti ye pracaranti] em.; ya pracaranti B; yeṣu caranti S bhuvi maṇḍale • upagrahāś cāṣṭā devā cāṣṭā devā] S; cāṣṭauś ca vedhāpa(?) B lekhyāḥ | anupūrvataḥ anupūrvataḥ] B; anupūrvaśaḥ S pañcadaśa tithayaḥ sitakṛṣṇā dvādaśa rāśayo ṣaḍ ṛtavo dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvatsaraś ca | caturbhaginyaḥ nāvābhirūḍhāḥ nāvābhirūḍhāḥ] S; nauyānābhirūḍha B bhrātṛpañcamāḥ salilavāsinaś ceti | saṃkṣepato mudrāsu vyavasthāpyā hi devatā | anupūrvataś ca dvipaṅktyāśritāś ca kāryāḥ || 2.164 ||

saṃkṣepato buddho bhagavān {S45} sarvasattvānām agro 'vaśyam abhilekhyaḥ | {B42v} abjakule āryāvalokiteśvaro dakṣiṇato 'vaśyam abhilekhyaḥ | vāmato vajrakule ārya­vajrapāṇir ārya­vajrapāṇir] B; vajrapāṇir S avaśyam abhilekhyaḥ | bodhisattvānām agra ārya­samanta­bhadro 'vaśyam abhilekhyaḥ | mañjuśrīḥ kumara­bhūto 'vaśyam abhilekhyaḥ | śaiṣā śaiṣā] em.; saiṣā S; śeṣā B mudrāsu yathāvyavasthāyām abhilekhyāḥ | etad abhyantaramaṇḍalam || 2.166 ||

madhyamaṇḍale 'pi brahmā sahāmpatiḥ pūrvāyāṃ diśy avaśyam abhilikhitavyaḥ | evam ābhāsvaro dakṣiṇāyāṃ diśy akaniṣṭho rūpinaś rūpinaś] B; arūpinaś S ca devā maṇḍalākārā•avyaktā naivasaṃjñānāsaṃjñāyatanā devāḥ devāḥ] S; vā B | uttarāyāṃ diśi śakro deva­rājā suyāmaḥ suyāmaḥ] em.; sayāmaḥ S; sujāmāḥ B saṃtuṣitaḥ sunirmitaḥ paranirmitaḥ parīttābha parīttābha°] S; parītta° Bprabhṛtayo deva­putrā avaśyam ekaikaḥ deva­rājo 'bhilikhitavyaḥ | śaiṣā śaiṣā] em.; saiṣā S; śeṣa B mudrāsu vyavasthāpyāḥ || 2.167 ||

evaṃ tṛtīyamaṇḍale 'py uttarāyāṃ diśi • īśāno bhūtādhipatiḥ sahomayāvaśyam abhilikhitavyaḥ | dvitīyadvārasamīpe kārttikeyamañjuśrīr mayūrāsanaḥ śaktipāṇiḥ raktāvabhāsamūrtiḥ pītavastranivastottarāsaṅgino dakṣiṇahaste ghaṇṭārakta °rakta°] B; om. Spatākāvasaktaḥ kumārarūpī maṇḍalaṃ nirīkṣamāṇaḥ | pūrvāyāṃ diśi vainateyaḥ {B43r} pakṣirūpī | ṛṣir mārkaṇḍo 'vaśyam abhilikhitavyaḥ | śaiṣā śaiṣā] em.; saiṣā S; śeṣā B mudrāsu ca vyavasthāpyāḥ || 2.168 ||

dakṣiṇapūrvataś catuḥkumāryaḥ kumāryaḥ] em.; kumāryāḥ S, B kumārabhrātṛsahitā nauyānasaṃsthitā mahodadheḥ paribhramantyaḥ | agniś ca devarāṭ avaśyaṃ avaśyaṃ] em.; avaśyam B; avaśya S likhitavyaḥ | evaṃ dakṣiṇāyāṃ dakṣiṇāyāṃ] B; dakṣiṇasyāṃ S diśi laṅkāpurī vibhīṣaṇaś ca rākṣasādhipatiḥ | tatrasthitaḥ picumarda picumarda°] B; picumanda° Svṛkṣāśrito jambhalajalendranāmā yakṣarūpī bodhisattvo 'vaśyam abhilikhitavyaḥ | evam anupūrvato yamo rājā pretamaharddhiko 'vaśyam abhilikhitavyaḥ | evaṃ piśācarājā vikarālo nāmāvaśyam abhilikhitavyaḥ | śaiṣā śaiṣā] em.; saiṣā S; śeṣā B mudrāsu vyavasthāpyā || 2.169 ||

evaṃ dakṣiṇapaścimāyāṃ dakṣiṇapaścimāyāṃ] S; paścimadakṣiṇāyāṃ B diśi nandopanandau nāgamukhyau • avaśyam abhilikhitavyau grahamukhyaś cādityaḥ cādityaḥ] S; ca āryya B | paścimāyāṃ diśi kapilamunir nāma • ṛṣivaro nirgrantha nirgrantha°] B; nirgrandha° Stīrthaṃkara °tīrthaṃkara°] em.; tīrthakara S, Bṛṣabho {V32} nirgrantha nirgrantha°] B; nirgrandha° Srūpī | anupūrvataḥ śaiṣā śaiṣā] em.; saiṣā S; śeṣā B mudrāsu vyavasthāpyāḥ || 2.170 ||

caturthamaṇḍalaṃ bahiḥ pañcarekhācitaṃ pañcarekhācitaṃ] B; pañca rekhāḥ cittaṃ S mudrāmālābhiś copaśobhitaṃ caturasraṃ catustoraṇākāraṃ catur­mahā­rāja­vibhūṣitam | yathānupūrva­sthitās tadyathā mudrā bhavanti || 2.172 ||

dvārapradeśe dvārapradeśe] B (supported by the Tib.); puraḥpradeśe S nīlotpalam abhilekhyam | dakṣiṇato vāmataḥ padmaṃ vajraṃ paraśukhaḍga °khaḍga°] B; °khaḍgaśūla° Striśūla­gadācakra­svastika­kalaśamīna­śaṅkha­kuṇḍala °kuṇḍala°] S; kuṇḍalaḥ kamaṇḍalu° Bdhvaja­patāka­pāśa­ghaṇṭākaṭṭāraka °kaṭṭāraka°] B; °kadvāraka° Sdhanurnārācamudgaraḥ | etair vividhākārapraharaṇamudraiḥ samantāc caturasramālākulaṃ kuryāt | ityato bahiś caturdiśaṃ catvāro mahā­samudrāḥ sthāpanīyāḥ || 2.173 ||

uttarāyāṃ diśi caturasrākāraṃ maṇḍalakaṃ kṛtvā ubhayavajraṃ trisūcyākāraṃ samanta­jvālam | pūrvāyāṃ diśi padmaṃ samanta­jvālaṃ pūrvāyāṃ diśi padmaṃ samanta­jvālaṃ] B; om. S trikoṇākāraṃ maṇḍalakaṃ kṛtvā sthāpayet | {B44r} Although this page is recto, it has the page number written on it. dakṣiṇāyāṃ diśi dhanvākāraṃ dhanvākāraṃ] S; sarvākāraṃ B maṇḍalakaṃ kṛtvā pātraṃ samanta­jvālaṃ sthāpayet | paścimāyāṃ diśi samanta­prabhākāraṃ maṇḍalakaṃ kṛtvā nīlotpalaṃ sanālapattropetaṃ samanta­jvālam || 2.174 ||

vidikṣu ca catvāro mudrā bhavanti | uttarapaścimāyāṃ diśi pāśaṃ vartulākāraṃ maṇḍalaṃ kṛtvā samanta­jvālam | dakṣiṇapaścimāyāṃ diśi dīrghākāramaṇḍalakaṃ kṛtvā daṇḍaṃ samanta­jvālam | dakṣiṇapūrvāyāṃ dakṣiṇapūrvāyāṃ] em.; dakṣiṇapūrvāṃ B; dakṣiṇapaścimāyāṃ S diśi paraśuṃ samanta­jvālaṃ trikoṇākāraṃ maṇḍalakaṃ kṛtvā | pūrvottarāyāṃ diśi khaḍgaṃ samanta­jvālaṃ sthāpayet || 2.175 ||

ālikhya sarvata ity ūrdhvam adhas tiryak trīṇi mudrā dvārasamīpe °samīpe] B; °samaye S bahir maṇḍalasyālekhyāś cūrṇair eva | tadyathā vastraṃ vyajanam upānahau vastraṃ vyajanam upānahau] em.; vastravyaṃjana•upānahau B; vajravyajanopānahau S ca samanta­jvālinas tv ete • abhilekhyā iti || 2.176 ||

lg.l: etan maṇḍalavidhānaṃ kathitaṃ tv iha samāsataḥ |
sattvānāṃ hitakāmyārthaṃ mañjughoṣeṇa dhīmatā || 2.177 ||

tei:div.p: tato maṇḍalācāryeṇa śiṣyāḥ pūrvam evānugṛhītavyā • avikalendriyāḥ sarvāṅgaśobhanā śobhanā] em.; śobhanāḥ S; śobhananaṃ bhavati B Here (Degé folio 123.b.3) ends the correspondence with manuscript B. brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviṭśūdrāḥ utpāditabodhicittā mahā­yānayāyina itarayānāspṛhaṇaśīlā mahā­sattvāḥ śraddhāḥ kalyāṇadharmiṇo mahā­rājyābhikāṃkṣiṇo 'lpabhogajugupsanā mahā­bhogābhirucitavanto {S47} bhadrā vinītāḥ śīlavanto bhikṣubhikṣuṇyupāsakopāsikā niyamasthā upoṣadhopavāsasaṃvarasthā mahā­bodhisattvādveṣiṇo mahā­pakṣa mahā­pakṣa°] em. (on the authority of the Tib.); mahā­yakṣaḥ° Skulīnāḥ prakṛtyaiva dharmacāriṇaḥ || 2.178 ||

ahorātroṣitāḥ śucivastraprāvṛtāḥ sugandhakeśās triḥsnāyino mauninaś ca | tadaho karpūra­kuṅkuma­lavaṃga­sugandha­mukhagandhino nityaṃ copaspṛśitavantaḥ kuśapiṇḍakopaviṣṭāḥ kṛtarakṣāvidhānā brahmacāriṇaḥ satyavantaḥ saṃdhyājina saṃdhyājina°] (reconstructed from the Tib.); + + + + + + n Smaṇḍalād bahir nātidūre maṇḍalād bahir nātidūre] conj.; °maṇḍala° + + + + + + S nātyāsanne sthāpanīyāḥ | śucinaḥ sucaukṣā aṣṭānāṃ prabhṛti yāvad ekaṃ nānyeṣām | te ca parasparāsaṃsaktinaḥ | kṣatriyā mūrdhābhiṣiktāś ca mahā­rājānas teṣāṃ ca sutāḥ kumārakumārikāś ca • aviditagrāmyadharmāṇaḥ | kāraṇaṃ bhagavān kumārarūpī mahā­bodhisattvo mañjuśrīr bālajanaprabodhakaḥ kumārakrīḍanaparaś ca || 2.179 ||

ataḥ prathamatara {V33} eva kumāraḥ praveśayitavyaḥ | mahā­rājñābhivardhana āyurārojyaiśvaryakāma kāma°] em.; kāmaḥ Sbhogābhivardhanaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ bālānāṃ mantrasiddhiḥ dhruvaṃ sthitā | iti || 2.180 ||

etān pūrvasthāpitān kṛtvā susakhāyopetā apramattās tato maṇḍalācāryeṇa karpūradhūpaṃ dahatā pṛṣṭhato bahir nirgantavyam nirgantavyam] em.; nigantavyam S | nirgatya ca yathāsukha °sukha°] em.; °mukha° Srtukodakenāṣṭaśatābhimantritena mūlamantreṇa mahā­mudrāpañcaśikhamudritenodakena snātvā upaspṛśya ca śuci śuci°] em.; śucir° Svastraprāvṛtena śucinā agnikuṇḍaṃ gatvā || 2.181 ||

lg.l: kuśaviṇḍakopaviṣṭa uttarapūrvābhimukha āhutīnām
karpūrakuṅkumacandanamiśrāṇām aṣṭasahasraṃ juhuyāt || 2.182 ||

tei:div.p: pūrvoktena vidhinā āhūya visṛjya ca bhūyo maṇḍalaṃ praveṣṭavyam | praviśya cāṣṭau pūrṇakalaśāḥ śucivastropetāḥ sahakārapallavavibhūṣitāḥ suvarṇa­rajata­ratna­dhānyavrīhi­prakṣipta­garbha ekaṃ bhagavataḥ śākyamuneḥ pratipādayet | dvitīyaḥ sarvabuddhānām | tṛtīyaḥ sarvapratyeka­buddhāryaśrāvakasaṅghasya | caturthaḥ sarvamahā­bodhisattvānām | pañcamo mahā­bodhi­sattvasya ārya­mañjuśriyasya | ṣaṣṭhaḥ sarvadevānām | saptamāṣṭamau dvitīyamaṇḍale dvārakoṣṭhake sthāpayitavyau | śucivastropetāḥ | ekaḥ sarvabhūtānām | dvitīyaḥ sarvasattvapariṇāmitaḥ sādhāraṇabhūtaṃ sthāpayitavyeti || 2.183 ||

tataḥ pūrvoktenaiva vidhinā dhūpaṃ dahatā mahā­mudrāpañcaśikhāṃ {S48} baddhvā bhūyaś cāvāhanaṃ kuryāt | sarvabuddhānāṃ sarvapratyeka­buddhānām ārya­śrāvakamahā­bodhisattvānāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvasattvāṃś ca mañjuśriyaṃ kumara­bhūtaṃ ca pūrvoktena vidhinā • āhvayet āhvayet] em.; āhvānayet S || 2.184 ||

evaṃ puṣpadhūpagandhapradīpair nivedyāṃś ca pūrvanirdiṣṭenaiva karmaṇā nivedyaḥ | sarveṣāṃ sarvataḥ anupūrveṇaiva kuryāt | pradīpagrahaṇenaiva ghṛtadīpaṃ dadyāt | sarvebhya āryānāryebhyo nivedyagrahaṇena śālyodanaṃ dadhnopetam || 2.185 ||

madhu­pāyasa­viśeṣaviśeṣyoparacita­ghṛta­pakva­pūpān aśokavartīkhaṇḍakhādyakādyān sarvatathāgatebhyo sarvatathāgatebhyo] em.; sarvaṃ tathāgatebhyo S niryātayet | haviḥpūrṇa haviḥpūrṇa°] em. (supported by the Tib.); havi pūrṇa Sśrīveṣṭamadhuśirapayopakvabhakṣādyān sarvapratyeka­buddhāryaśrāvakamahā­bodhisattvānām °bodhisattvānām] em.; °bodhisattvān° S ārya­devatānāṃ ca niryātayet | evaṃ laḍḍukāgarbhoktārakaviśeṣān pūpopakāraṇān sarvadeva­bhūtagaṇān sarvasattvāṃś ca mantropetān vidhinā niryātayet || 2.186 ||

evaṃ sugandhapuṣpān jātītagaranāgapuṣpapuṃnāgaprabhṛti °prabhṛti°] em.; °prabhṛtiṃ Spūrvanirdiṣṭān sarvabuddhapratyeka­buddhāryaśrāvakamahā­bodhisattvebhya āryānāryebhyo niryātayet | viśeṣataḥ tathāgatakule jātī­kusumam | padmaṃ padmakule tathā | kuvalayaṃ kuliśapāṇe | anyamantrebhyo itaram | iti || 2.187 ||

karpūradhūpaṃ tathāgatakule | candanaṃ padmakule tathā | gugguluṃ guhyakendrasya vajriṇasyaiva śasyate | anyamantrebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ dhūpaṃ dadyād itaraṃ itaraṃ] em.; itara° S | ghṛtapradīpān āryebhyaḥ sarvebhyaś caiva dāpayet | anāryebhyo mantrebhyaḥ sugandhatailaṃ tu dāpayet || 2.188 ||

lg.l: anupūrveṇa vidhinā pūrvadṛṣṭena hetunā |
gandhaṃ yadvat gandhaṃ yadvat] conj. (seems to be supported by the Tib.); gandha + + t S tathaivoktaṃ sarvamantrebhyo nityaśaḥ nityaśaḥ] em.; nityaśa (unmetrical) S || 2.189 ||
avalokitena yat proktaṃ yat proktaṃ kuliśapāṇinā |
svakasvakeṣu tantreṣu mantracaryārthasādhane |
te 'py eha eha (BHS) = iha kalpe draṣṭavyāḥ anuvartyāś ca sarvadā || iti || 2.190 || {V34}

tei:div.p: tato maṇḍalācāryeṇa pūrvadṛṣṭena vidhinā • āvāhana­pūjana­dhūpanādinivedya­pradānānuvartana­kriyāṃ kṛtvā tato 'nusādhakena kuśalena tvaramāṇena sārvabhautikaṃ baliṃ nirāmiṣāṃ sarvataś ca paṭaha­śaṅkha­dhvani­nandīśabda­ghoṣa­nināditena dhūpapuṣpadīpamālābhī °mālābhī] em.; °mālabhi° S racitaḥ || 2.191 ||

caturdikṣu vidikṣu ca • {S49} ity ūrdhvam adhas tiryak sarvato bahir maṇḍalaṃ pradakṣiṇī + + baliṃ sarvabhautikāṃ kṣiptvā pradakṣiṇī + + baliṃ sarvabhautikāṃ kṣiptvā] conj.; pradakṣiṇī + + + + + rvabhautikāṃ kṣi + S snātvā maṇḍalācāryo snātvā maṇḍalācāryo] conj. (based on the Tib.); + + + + ryo S dadhimadhudhṛtāktānāṃ śālitandulāhūtīnām aṣṭasahasraṃ juhuyāt | ṣaḍakṣaramūlamantrahṛdayena juhvataḥ pūrvasthāpitakānāṃ °sthāpitakānāṃ] em.; °sthāpitakāṃ S maṇḍalānupraveśamahā­sattvānāṃ °mahā­sattvānāṃ] em.; °mahā­sattvāṃ S kṛtarakṣāvidhānānāṃ maṇḍalācāryaśiṣyatvābhyupagatānām utpāditabodhicittānām upoṣadhikānāṃ sarvabuddhabodhisattvātma °ātma°] em.; °ātmā° Sniryātitamūrtīnāṃ siddhyartha­sattvopabhoga­sādhāraṇa­bhūtānām anuttarabodhimaṇḍākramaṇakuśalānāṃ sarvajñajñānabuddhalipsānāṃ °lipsānāṃ] em.; °lipsakāmānāṃ S maṇḍaladarśanād eva mucyate sarvakilbiṣāt | ānantaryakāriṇo °kāriṇo] em. (supported by the Tib.); °kāriṇo S 'pi ye mucyante tatkṣaṇāj janā iti || 2.192 ||

tato maṇḍalācāryeṇa anāhatena vastreṇa tantroddhṛtenāpagatakeśena mūlamantrasaptābhimantritena sugandhacandanakuṅkumābhyaktena paṭena maṇḍalaṃ praveṣṭukāmānāṃ praveṣṭukāmānāṃ] em.; praveṣṭukānāṃ S mukhaṃ veṣṭayitvā prathamato bālaṣoḍaśaprabhṛti yāvat trīṇi varṣajanmikaṃ pañcacīrakopaśobhitam ekacīrakopaśobhitaṃ śikhopaśobhitaṃ aśiraskaṃ vā rājaputraṃ mūrdhābhiṣiktaṃ kṣatriyaputraṃ vā • anyaṃ vā mahotsāhamahā­rājyakāmaṃ vā praveśayet || 2.193 ||

dvitīyamaṇḍalasthitaṃ mukhaṃ veṣṭayitvā • utpalamudrāṃ baddhvā mañjuśriyaḥ kumara­bhūtasya mūlamantraṃ sakṛj japtvā kārāpayitvā sugandhapuṣpaṃ dattvā candanakuṅkumābhyāṃ miśraṃ sucaukṣābhyāṃ sucaukṣābhyāṃ] em.; sucaukṣābhyāṃ S hastābhyāṃ puṣpāṇi kṣipāpayitavyāḥ | yatrāsya puṣpam adhitiṣṭhati tam asya mantraṃ dadyāt || 2.194 ||

svamantreti kīrtyate | saivāsyānubaddhā janmaparamparāsu saivāsya kalyāṇamitro bodhimaṇḍakramaṇamahā­bodhi­sattvajñajñānaparipūraṇārtham abhinirharati | saivāsya sādhanīyam | mahā­bhogamahā­rājyamaheśākhyapudgalasamavadhānatā cāsya-m-abhinirharati | ihaiva janmani avicārataḥ sādhanīyaṃ sidhyate sarvakarmeṣu ca || 2.195 ||

evam anupūrvata ekaṃ prati tāvad yāvad aṣṭānāṃ nānyeṣām iti siddhikāmaiḥ | anyeṣāṃ yathepsataḥ pāpakṣapaṇārthaṃ samayamātraṃ syād iti | abhiṣekaṃ dadatā maṇḍalācāryeṇa • ādau tāvan maṇḍale bahir nātidūre nātyāsanne pūrvottare digbhāge bhūpradeśe adhiṣṭhāya mantrapūtaṃ kṛtvā mūlamantreṇa tataḥ rājyābhiṣekam iva manyamānam ātmānaṃ ekāntabuddhadharmasaṅghābhiprasannaṃ śrāddhaṃ mahotsāhinam avirahitabodhicittaṃ mahā­yānayāyinaṃ {S50} ratnatrayopakāriṇam avikalendriyam akutsitam ihaiva janmani mantrān sādhayitukāmaḥ °kāmaḥ] S (shouldn’t this be °kāmam?) | bhadrāśayaṃ mantracaryodyuktamānasaṃ kautukajātīyaṃ jijñāsanahetor api avikalpitamantrārthatadgatamānasaṃ ekaṃ prabhṛti yāvat pañce yāvat pañce] em. (on the authority on the Tib.); yāvatyathe S • abhiṣecyāḥ śeṣā varjyā abhiṣecyāḥ śeṣā varjyā] conj. (based on the Tib.); abhiṣecyā sevyā varjyā S iti | prājñā•amūḍhacaritā iti śeṣato 'bhiṣecyā nānyeṣām api || 2.196 ||

tataḥ sarvarājyābhiṣekam ivopakaraṇaṃ sambhṛtya ācāryo vā yena tuṣyeta | tataḥ vitatavitānocchritadhvajapatākaśvetacchatramūrdhni °mūrdhni] em.; °mūrdhani S dhāryamāṇaḥ sitacāmareṇa vījyamāno sitacāmareṇa vījyamāno] em.; sitacāmare nivījyamānaḥ S mahatā satkāreṇa nandīśabda­nirghoṣa­śaṅkha­bherī­mṛdaṅga­jayaśabdair maṅgalagāthābhiḥ praśastasvastikagāthābhiś ca jinabhāṣitair abhistūyamānaḥ | pradakṣiṇīkṛtya ca tan maṇḍalaṃ sarvabuddhabodhisattvān praṇamya ācāryaṃ śirasā praṇamya • {V35} evaṃ ca vaktavyam || 2.197 ||

u + + ṣyācārya sarvabuddhabodhi­sattvamantracaryānirhāraṃ samanupraveṣṭuṃ sarva­laukikātikrānta­rahasyavi­mokṣa­maṇḍalaṃ samanupraveṣṭuṃ sarva­dharmarājyasamanupraveśabuddhatvam adhigantuṃ saṃkṣepato vaktavyaṃ buddho bhūyām | iti || 2.198 ||

tataḥ kuśaviṇḍakopaviṣṭaḥ pūrvābhimukho maṃ + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + pañcaśikhāṃ baddhāpayitavyaḥ | tato †svesthitaṃ† mantraṃ yo yasya rocate bhūrjapatre gorocanayā likhitavyam | likhitvā candanakuṅkumābhyāṃ hastau mrakṣayitvā śarāvasampuṭaṃ ca | tatas taṃ bhūrjapatraṃ śarāvasampuṭābhyantarasthaṃ + + + + + + + + + + + bodhi­sattvasya pādamūle sthāpanīyam || 2.199 ||

tatas tatropaviṣṭena vidyāmūlamantro 'ṣṭaśatavārān mantro 'ṣṭaśatavārān] em.; mantrā aṣṭaśatavārān S uccārayitavyaḥ pūrvam eva tu tatas taṃ kuśaviṇḍakopaviṣṭam abhiṣecanīyam | bahir maṇḍale yaḥ sarvasattvasādhāraṇabhūtaṃ pūrṇakalaśaṃ pūrvasthāpitakaṃ dvārasamīpe taṃ gṛhītvā ācāryeṇa mūlamantraṃ paṭhatā mūrdhni mūrdhni] em.; mūrdhani S abhiṣektavyaḥ | śeṣā yatheṣṭam udakeneti || 2.200 ||

tatas taṃ śarāvasampuṭaṃ tasyaiva dātavyam | pradīpena ca pāṭhayitavyaḥ | yadi sā eva bhavati mantrā kramāt sidhyati yatnataḥ | atha anyo mantra paṭhanād eva siddhyati | atha mantrākṣarahīnātiriktā vā {S51} dattā bhavati prathamasādhana eva sidhyatītyavikalpataḥ sā eṣa pūrvalikhitā • ācāryeṇa | tribhiḥ sādhanaiḥ kurvan siddhyatītyayatnataḥ | evaṃ prathamataḥ vidyābhiṣekaṃ dadyāt || 2.201 ||

dvitīyamaṇḍalābhiṣekam | dvitīyamaṇḍale sarvadevānāṃ yat pratipāditakaṃ pūrṇakalaśaṃ tenābhiṣiñcen °bhiṣiñcen] em.; °bhyaṣiñcet S mūrdhni mūrdhni] em.; mūrdhani S | yathaiva vā pūrvakaṃ tenaiva vidhinā mucyate sarvakilviṣāt | anujñātaś ca bhavati sarvabuddhaiḥ sarvalaukikalokottarasamayamaṇḍalaṃ sarvamantramudrāsādhaneṣu ca | adhiṣṭhito adhiṣṭhito] em. (on the authority of the Tib. and TMK); avyaṣṭo S bhavati sarvabodhi­sattvaiḥ | iti • ācāryābhiṣekaṃ dadyāt || 2.202 ||

tṛtīyamaṇḍale sarvaśrāvakapratyeka­buddhebhyaḥ pūrṇakalaśaṃ niryātitakaṃ tenaiva vidhinā mūrdhny mūrdhny] em.; mūrdhany S abhiṣecayet | vaktavyam anujñātas tvaṃ sarvabuddhair bodhi­sattvaiś ca maharddhikaiḥ sarvalaukikalokottarāṇāṃ mantrāṇāṃ likhanapaṭhanamaṇḍalopadeśamantratantramudrācaryānirdeśaṃ °nirdeśaṃ] em.; °nirdeśa S svayaṃ carituṃ nirdeṣṭuṃ vā | ihaiva janmani paramparāsu ca yāvat paścimakaṃ niyataṃ buddhatvaṃ prāptavyam | iti || 2.203 ||

evaṃ jayavijayābhiṣeke 'pi pūrvanirdiṣṭena vidhinā bhagavato buddhaniryātitakapūrṇakalaśena bodhi­sattvaniryātitena °niryātitena] em.; °niryāti tena S ca pūrṇakalaśena tathaivābhiṣiñcet °bhiṣiñcet] em.; °bhyaṣicyat S | evaṃ ca vaktavyam anujñātas tvaṃ sarvabuddhair bhagavadbhir mahā­bodhi­sattvaiś ca śrāvakaiḥ || 2.204 ||

lg.l: adhṛṣyaḥ sarvabhūtānām ajitaḥ sarvadehinām |
vijayatvaṃ sarvamantrāṇāṃ sādhaya sādhaya] em.; sādhayas S tvaṃ yathepsataḥ || 2.205 ||
tato maṇḍalācāryeṇa ekaikasya yathepsataḥ |
pañcābhiṣekā dātavyā sarvebhyaḥ pañca eva tu || 2.206 || {V36}

tei:div.p: tatas tān tān] em.; tām (BHS) S anupūrveṇa maṇḍalaṃ praveśya sarvabuddhabodhisattvānāṃ niryātayitvā maṇḍalaṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya visarjayitavyāḥ visarjayitavyāḥ] em.; visarjayitavyaḥ S | tadaho pareṇa • anupūrveṇa śikṣayitavyā mantracaryāsu niyoktavyāḥ niyoktavyāḥ] em.; niyoktavyā S | tatkṣaṇād eva bhagavato mañjuśriyasya mahā­bodhi­sattvasya yaḥ pūrvaniryātitakaṃ pūrṇakalaśaṃ gṛhītvā teṣāṃ maṇḍalapraviṣṭānām udakaculukatrayaṃ pūrvābhimukhaṃ kṛtvā pāyayet | vaktavyāś ca || 2.207 ||

iyaṃ bho mahā­bodhi­sattvasya mañjuśriyaḥ kumara­bhūtasya {S52} samayarahasyaṃ mātikramiṣyatheti mā bahu • apuṇyaṃ prasaviṣyatheti | sarvamantrāś ca na pratikṣeptavyāḥ | sarvabuddhabodhisattvāś ca na visaṃvādanīyāḥ | gurur ārādhanīyaś ceti | anyathā samayātikramaḥ syāt | mantrāś ca siddhiṃ na gaccheyuḥ | bahu • apuṇyaṃ apuṇyaṃ] em. (on the authority of the Tib.); °puṇyaṃ S syād iti | evaṃ visarjayitavyāḥ || 2.208 ||

tato maṇḍalācāryeṇa bhūyo dadhimadhughṛtābhyaktāḥ śālitaṇḍulāhutayo 'ṣṭākṣarahṛdayena hotavyāḥ | tatotthāya maṇḍalamadhyaṃ praviśya pūrvanirdiṣṭaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūrvoktena vidhinā • arghyaṃ deyaṃ deyaṃ] em.; deyaḥ S sarvebhyo manasā cintayet | pūrvoktenaiva dhūpena sarvabuddhabodhisattvān pratyeka­buddhāryaśrāvakān sarvadeva­nāgayakṣagaruḍagandharvakiṃnaramahoragayakṣarākṣasapiśācabhūtayogina yogina seems to be a BHS form of yogin.siddhaṛṣayaḥ sarvasattvān saṃdhūpya puṣpair avakīrya candanakuṅkumodakenābhiṣiñcet °bhiṣiñcet] em.; °bhyaṣiñcet S | pūrvoktenaiva vidhinā visarjayet | manasā mokṣaḥ sarvebhya iti || 2.209 ||

tato maṇḍalācāryeṇa nivedyaṃ baliṃ cūrṇaṃ sarve nadyāṃ plāvayitavyāḥ | duḥkhitebhyo vā prāṇibhyo dātavyam | suparāmṛṣṭaṃ sukelāyitaṃ suśobhitaṃ pṛthivīpradeśaṃ kṛtvā gomayena leptavyaḥ | udakena vā plāvayitavyaṃ sucaukṣamṛttikayā vābhilimpya °bhilimpya] em.; °bhyalimpya S sikatayā sikatayā] em.; sikatāyā S vā | asyaiva kāryaṃ yatheṣṭato gantavyam | tair maṇḍalapraviṣṭair ātmanaḥ kṣīrodanāhāreṇa haviṣyāhāreṇa vā bhavitavyam | iti || 2.210 ||
bodhi­sattvapiṭakāvataṃsakān mahā­kalparājendrān mañjuśrīkumara­bhūtavikurvaṇād bodhi­sattvapaṭalavisarād dvitīyo maṇḍalavidhinirdeśaparivartaḥ samāpta iti ||

tei:div.head: Chapter A3
tei:div.p: atha tṛtīyaḥ parivartaḥ ||

atha khalu mañjuśrīḥ kumara­bhūtaḥ punar api taṃ śuddhāvāsabhavanam avalokya tān mahā­parṣanmaṇḍalasannipatitān sarvabuddhabodhisattvān praṇamya • ekākṣaraṃ paramaguhyaṃ sarvaviṣaghātasarvakarmikaṃ ca mantraṃ svamaṇḍalasādhanaupayikaṃ sarvakṣudrakarmeṣu copayojyaṃ bhāṣate sma | katamaṃ ca tat || 3.1 ||
namaḥ samanta­buddhānām | tadyathā jaḥ | eṣa sa mārṣāḥ sārvabhūtagaṇāś ca asyaiva mantram ekākṣarasya dvitīyaṃ maṇḍalavidhānaṃ saṃkṣepato yojyam || 3.2 ||

aṣṭahastaṃ caturhastaṃ vā bhūpradeśaṃ saṃśodhya pañcaraṅgikair eva cūrṇaiḥ svayaṃ likhitavyam | na paraiḥ | yatra vā tatra vā na cātra doṣaḥ | samaṃ caturasraṃ trimaṇḍalopaśobhitam | pañcaśikhāṃ mahā­mudrāṃ prathamaṃ ca tāval likhet | bhagavato mañjuśriyaḥ utpalamudrāṃ daṃṣṭrāmudrāṃ vaktramudrāṃ yaṣṭimudrāṃ ca | ete mudrā abhyantaramaṇḍalapūrvadigbhāge • ālikhitavyāḥ || 3.3 ||

tataḥ padma­vajra•utpala­dhvaja­patākacchatratoraṇaratha­kuñjara•aśvabalivarda-mahiṣasvastika­mayūra•ajameṣa­puruṣa­kumārarūpī bahir dvāramūle • ālikhitavyaḥ | yathānupūrvataḥ paṅktyāśritā ālekhyās trimaṇḍalāśritā evaṃ kāryāḥ syuḥ | iti || 3.4 ||

tato ekākṣareṇaiva mantreṇa pūrvadakṣiṇe digbhāge agnikāryaṃ kāryam | apāmārgasamidhānāṃ dadhimadhughṛtāktānām aṣṭaśataṃ hotavyam | tataḥ puṣpair arghyo deyaḥ | ekākṣareṇaiva mantreṇa balinivedyapradīpaṃ °pradīpaṃ] em.; °pradīpa S yathepsitaṃ dātavyaṃ dhūpaṃ vā | āhvānanavisarjanaṃ kuryāt | iti || 3.5 ||

tataḥ praveśayed | rājyakāmaṃ nagaramadhye ālikhet | bhogakāmaṃ vaṭavṛkṣasamīpe | putrakāmaṃ putrañjīvakavṛkṣasamīpe | anapatnīkaṃ hastyaśvakāmaṃ kuñjaraśālāyāṃ vājiśālāyāṃ vā | daṣṭakaṃ mahāhrade nāgāyatane vā | cāturthakanityajvarasarvajvareṣu ca ekaliṅge grāmadakṣiṇadiśe vā | rākṣasagṛhītaṃ śmaśāne śūnyagṛhe °gṛhe] em.; °grahe S vā | piśācagṛhītaṃ vibhītakavṛkṣasamīpe • eraṇḍavṛkṣasamīpe vā | mātarasarvagṛhīteṣu catuḥpatheṣu mṛtakasūtakagṛhasamīpe vā | brahmarākṣasagṛhītaṃ tālavṛkṣe śleṣmāntaka śleṣmāntaka°] em.; śleṣmātaka° Svṛkṣe vā | garadattakam ekākṣareṇaiva mantreṇaiva • udakaṃ saptābhimantritaṃ kṛtvā tatraiva maṇḍalamadhye pātayitavyaḥ | mucyate || 3.6 || {S54}

evaṃ striyāyāḥ puruṣasya vā yaśo'rthinaṃ ca catvare brahmasthale vā • ālikhitavyam | mṛtavatsāyāḥ saphale vṛkṣe kṣīravṛkṣe vā | śālidhānyapakvakedāramadhye anapatyāyā likhitavyam | trividharogasvīkṛtānya trividharogasvīkṛtānya °] em. (on the authority of the Tib.); vividharogastrīkṛtānya ° Sduṣṭataḥ pratarādiṣu | mahā­rogaspṛṣṭāsu rakṣoghnaṃ nadīpuline kūle vā | parvatāgre cābhilekhyaṃ sarvarogeṣu sarvataḥ | ḍākinīkṛtāny api brahmapālikāyāṃ (brahmavāṭikāyāṃ?) śūnyaveśmany °veśmany] em.; °veśma S ekāntasthāne ekāntasthāne] em.; ekāntasthāna S nimnapradeśe vā || 3.7 ||

evaṃ sarvakarmeṣu ardharātre madhyāhne vā sarvakālam abhilikhitavyam | tenaivaikākṣaramantreṇa puṣpair arghyaṃ dattvā visarjya ca maṇḍalam udakena plāvayitavyam | sarvaglānānāṃ mahatī rakṣā kṛtā bhavati || 3.8 ||

lg.l: mucyate sarvarogebhyo īpsitam arthaṃ ca sampadyante |
aputro labhate putraṃ durbhagaḥ subhago bhavet || 3.9 ||
daridro labhate arthān darśanād eva maṇḍalam |
striyasya puruṣasyāpi śrāddhasyāpi kalpataḥ |
yatheṣṭavividhākārān prāpnuyāt sampadāṃ sadā || 3.10 ||

tei:div.p: iti bodhi­sattvapaṭalavisarān °visarān] em.; °visarā S mañjuśrīkumara­bhūtamūlakalpāt tṛtīyo maṇḍalavidhānaparivartaḥ ||

tei:div.head: Chapter A4
tei:div.p: namo buddhāya sarvabuddhabodhisattvebhyaḥ ||
atha khalu mañjuśrīḥ sarvāvantaṃ śuddhāvāsabhavanam avalokya punar api tan mahā­parṣanmaṇḍalasannipātam avalokya śākyamuneś caraṇayor nipatya prahasitavadano bhūtvā bhagavantam etad avocat || 4.1 ||

tat sādhu bhagavān sarvasattvānāṃ hitāya mantra­caryā­sādhana­vidhānanirhāraniṣyanda­dharma­megha­pravarṣaṇa­yathepsita­phalaniṣpādana­paṭala­visarāt paṭalavisarāt] em. (on the authority of the Tib.); paṭalavisaraḥ S paṭavidhānam anuttarapuṇyaprasavaḥ samyaksambodhibīja °bīja°] em.; °bījam S•abhinirvartakaṃ sarvajñajñānāśeṣa•abhinirvartakam || 4.2 ||

saṃkṣepataḥ sarvāśāpāripūrakaṃ sarvamantraphalasamyaksamprayuktaṃ °samprayuktaṃ] em.; °samprayuktaḥ S saphalīkaraṇa•avandhyasādhitasādhakaṃ sarvabodhi­sattvacaryāpāripūrakaṃ mahā­bodhi­sattvasaṃnāhasaṃnaddhaṃ °sannaddhaṃ] em.; °sannaddhaḥ S sarva­māra­bala•abhibhavana­parāpṛṣṭhī­karaṇam | tad vadatu bhagavān asmākam anukampām upādāya sarvasattvānāṃ ca || 4.3 ||
evam ukte mañjuśriyā kumara­bhūtena • atha bhagavānś chākyamunir mañjuśriyaṃ kumara­bhūtam etad avocat |

sādhu sādhu mañjuśrīḥ yas tvaṃ bahujanahitāya pratipanno lokānukampāyai yas tvaṃ tathāgatam etam arthaṃ paripraṣṭavyaṃ manyase | tac chṛṇu sādhu ca suṣṭhu ca manasi kuru | bhāṣiṣye 'haṃ te tvadīyaṃ paṭavidhānavisara­sarva­sattva­caryāsādhanam anupraveśam anupūrvakaṃ anupūrvakaṃ] em.; anupūrvakaḥ S vakṣye 'haṃ pūrvanirdiṣṭaṃ sarvatathāgataiḥ | aham apy edānīṃ bhāṣiṣye || 4.4 ||

ādau tāvac chucau pṛthivīpradeśe rajovigate picuṃ gṛhya samayapraviṣṭaiḥ sattvais taṃ taṃ] em.; tat S picuṃ saṃśodhayitavyam | saṃśodhya ca • anena mantreṇa maṇḍalācāryeṇābhimantritavyam aṣṭaśatavārān || 4.5 ||

namaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisattvānām apratihatamatigatipraticāriṇām | namaḥ saṃśodhanaduḥkhapraśamanarājendrarājāya tathāgatāyārhate samyaksambuddhāya | tadyathā | oṁ śodhaya śodhaya sarvavighnaghātaka mahā­kāruṇika kumāra­rūpa­dhāriṇe | vikurva vikurva | samayam anusmara | tiṣṭha tiṣṭha | huṁ huṁ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā || 4.6 || {S56}

tato 'vidita 'vidita°] em. (based on the Tib. and other occurrences in the MMK); 'vitatha° Sgrāmyadharmakumārī brāhmaṇakulakṣatriyakulaprasūtāṃ °prasūtāṃ] em.; °prasūtaṃ S vaiśyakule prasūtāṃ °prasūtāṃ] em.; °prasūtaṃ S nātikṛṣṇavarṇayoni °varṇayoni°] em. (on the authority of the Tib.); °varṇayonivarṇayoni° Svarjitām avikalāṃ avikalāṃ] em.; avikalaṃ S sarvāṅgaśobhanāṃ mātāpitṛ•anuṣkṛtām upoṣadhaparigṛhītām utpāditabodhicittāṃ kāruṇikām avadātavarṇām anyavarṇavivarjitāṃ saṃkṣepataḥ strīlakṣaṇasupraśastacihnāṃ suśobhane suśobhane] em.; saśobhane S 'hani śuklapakṣe śuklaśubhagrahanirīkṣite vigatadhūma °dhūma°] em. (on the authority of the Tib.); °dhūpa° Snirhāravadalāpagate vigatavāte śucau pradeśe pūrvanirdiṣṭāṃ kumārīṃ snāpayitvā śucivastraprāvṛtena sunivastāṃ kṛtvā • anenaiva mantreṇa mahā­mudropetarakṣāṃ kṛtvā śvetacandanakuṅkumaṃ niṣprāṇakenodakenāloḍya tat pibantāṃ ca kanyāṃ tenaiva mantreṇa saṃśodhanenābhyukṣayet || 4.7 ||

caturdiśaṃ ca kṣipec chvetacandana °candana°] em.; °candanaṃ Skuṅkumodakam ity ūrdhvam adhaś ca vidikṣu | śvetacandanakuṅkumakarpūraṃ caikīkṛtya pūrvaṃ dāpayet svayaṃ vā dadyāt sādhakācārye sādhakācāryeṇa] conj.; sādhakācārye S vā | tad evaṃ vācā bhāṣitavyaṃ trīn vārān || 4.8 ||
adhitiṣṭhantu buddhā bhagavanta idaṃ paṭasūtraṃ daśabhūmipratiṣṭhitāś ca mahā­bodhisattvāḥ || 4.9 ||

tatas te buddhā bhagavantaḥ samanvāharanti | {V39} mahā­bodhisattvāś ca | dhūpaṃ dahatā tasmin samaye mayūra­krauñca­haṃsa­sārasa­cakra­vākavividhāḥ śubhaśakunayo °śakunayo] em.; °śakunayā S jalasthalacāriṇo 'ntarikṣe 'ntarikṣe] em.; 'ntarikṣī S gaccheyuḥ śubhaṃ vā kūjayeyuḥ | tat sādhakena jñātavyam | saphalaṃ me • etat karma | adhiṣṭhitaṃ me buddhair bhagavadbhir bhagavadbhir] em.; bhagavadbhi° S mahā­bodhi­sattvaiś ca me tat paṭasūtram | sujīvitaṃ me • iha me iha] em.; meha S janmani | avandhyā me mantrasiddhiḥ || 4.10 ||

paṭahabherīmṛdaṅgaśaṅkhavīṇā °vīṇā°] em.; °vīṇa° Sveṇupaṇavamuravaśabdaṃ vā bhaveyuḥ + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + evaṃ vadeyur akalpasmāt (akasmāt?) tasmin samaye |
jayasiddhisiddha | datta dinna gṛhṇa | śreyasaḥ saphalaka śakraprabhūta || 4.11 ||

evam ādayo anye vā śubhāñ śabdān pravyāharanti | ghaṇṭāniḥsvanaṃ vā bhaveyuḥ nandīśabdaṃ vā | tato vidyādhareṇa jñātavyam | buddhānāṃ bhagavatāṃ mahā­bodhisattvānāṃ cādhiṣṭhānam etat | nānyatra | avandhyasiddhiḥ | iti || 4.12 ||
atha te tasmin samaye krūraṃ pravyāharante
gṛhṇa khāda khādāpaya naṣṭa vinaṣṭa | kaṣṭaṃ kaṣṭaṃ] em. (on the authority of the Tib.); kaṣṭa S dūra sudūra nāstīti || 4.13 ||

evam ādayaḥ śabdā niścaranti | vānara­mahiṣa­kroṣṭuka­gardabha­mārjāra­kutsita­tiryagdvipada­catuḥpadānāṃ śabdā niścareyuḥ | tato sādhakena jñātavyaṃ nāsti me siddhir iti | iha janmani {S57} saṃhartavyaḥ | bhūyo vā pūrvasevāṃ kṛtvā prārabdhavyam evaṃ yāvat saptavārān | pañcānantaryakariṇasyāpi saptame karmaprayoge sidhyatīti || 4.14 ||

tataḥ sādhakena tāṃ kumārīṃ kṛtarakṣāṃ kṛtvā kuśaviṇḍakopaviṣṭakāṃ kārayet | pūrvābhimukhām uttarābhimukhāṃ vā saṃsthāpya ātmanaś ca haviṣyāhāraḥ tāṃ ca kanyāṃ haviṣyāhāraṃ bhojayet | pūrvam eva parikalpitaṃ kuśaviṇḍakaṃ tenaivaṃ vidhinā taṃ picuṃ kartāpayet || 4.15 ||

tat sūtraṃ sukartitaṃ śuklaṃ pūrvaśikṣāpitakanyayā saṃhṛtya • aṣṭa pañca trīṇi ekaṃ prabhṛti prabhṛti] em.; prabhṛtī S yāvat ṣoḍaśamātrān palān vā karṣān vā supraśastagaṇam etān kuryāt | madhyame • aṣṭamā†ṃgāthā† itare pañcaika vā kṣudrasādhyeṣu karmasu | yathāśaktitaḥ kuryāt sarvakarmiṣu mantravit || 4.16 ||

lg.l: tataḥ prabhṛti yat kiñcit pāpaṃ karma purākṛtam |
naśyate tatkṣaṇād eva sūtrārthaṃ ca taccetane taccetane] conj. (based on the Tib.); na cetane S || 4.17 ||
saṅgṛhyam idaṃ sūtraṃ śucau bhāṇḍe niveśayet |
nihitaṃ tu tato nihitaṃ tu tato] em. (based on the Tib.); na hi taṃtugato S kṛtvā dhūpayet karpūradhūpanaiḥ || 4.18 ||
āprāṇyāṅgasamutthaṃ vā kuṅkumacandanādibhiḥ |
ārcitaṃ sugandhapuṣpair mallikacampakādibhiḥ || 4.19 ||
śucau pradeśe saṃsthāpya kṛtarakṣāpithānitam |
mantravit sarvakarmajño kṛtajāpaḥ susamāhitaḥ || 4.20 ||
tantuvāyaṃ tato gatvā mūlyaṃ dattvā yathepsitam |
avyaṅgam akṛśaṃ caiva śukladharmasadāratam || 4.21 ||
avyādhyartam avṛddhaṃ ca kāsaśvāsāvinirmuktam |
kāsaśvāsavinirmuktam aṣaṇḍaṃ yonisatyajam || 4.22 || {V40}
anavadyam akubjaṃ caivāpaṅgupativarjitam |
samastalakṣaṇopetaṃ praśastaṃ cārudarśanam || 4.23 ||
śubhabuddhisamācāraṃ laukikīṃ vṛttim āśritam |
siddhikāmo 'tra taṃ yāced uttame paṭavāyane || 4.24 ||
praśastā śubhavarṇe vā buddhimanto suśikṣitaḥ |
atotkṛṣṭatamaiḥ In classical Sanskrit atotkṛṣṭatamaiḥ would be written as ata utkṛṣṭamaiḥ. śreṣṭhaiḥ paṭavāyanaśreyasaiḥ || 4.25 || {S58}
uttame uttamaṃ kuryān madhyame madhyasādhanam |
itaraiḥ kṣudrakarmāṇi nikṛṣṭāny eva sarvataḥ || 4.26 ||
yathāmūlyaṃ tato dattvā yathā vadati śilpinaḥ |
prathame vāksamutthāne śilpinasya sa mantravit || 4.27 ||
dadyāt paṇyaṃ tataḥ kṣipraṃ vīrakrayeti °krayeti seems to be a metrical contraction of °kraya iti. sa ucyate |
prārthanād eva caitasya paṇya paṇya] em. (on the authority of the Tib.); puṇya Sbhāvena jāpine || 4.28 ||
kṣiprasiddhikaro hy eṣa paṭaśreṣṭho niruttaraḥ |
sarvakarmakaro pūjyo divyamānuṣyasaukhyadaḥ |
śreyasaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ samyaksambuddhabhāṣitam || iti || 4.29 ||

tei:div.p: tato vidyādhareṇa tantuvāyasya poṣadhaṃ dattvā suśubhe suśubhe] em.; saśubhe S nakṣatre prātihārakapakṣe śukle 'hani śubhagrahanirīkṣite 'nye vā śuklapakṣe sukusumita­saha­kāramañjarīvarataru­puṣpāḍhyavasanta­samaye • ṛtuvare tasmin kāle tasmin samaye pūrvāhnodite savitari pūrvanirdiṣṭaṃ tantuvāyaṃ haviṣyāhāraṃ śuci­vastra­prāvṛta­baddhoṣṇīṣa­śiraskasusnātaṃ suviliptaṃ śvetacandanakuṅkumābhyām anyatareṇānuliptāṅgaṃ karpūravāsitavadanaṃ hṛṣṭamanasaṃ kṣutpipāsāpagataṃ kṛtvā sarvatra bhāṇḍaṃ rajjvādyupakaraṇāni ca mṛdgomayābhyāṃ prakṣālya pratyagrāṇi ca bhūyo bhūyo pañcagavyena prakṣālayet || 4.30 ||

tato niḥprāṇakenodakena prakṣālya śvetacandanakuṅkumābhyām abhiṣiñcet abhiṣiñcet] em.; abhyaṣiñcet S | śucau pṛthivīpradeśe apagatakolāhale vigatajanapade viviktāsane prasanne gupte puṣpārcite | tataḥ sādhakena saṃśodhana­mantreṇaivāṣṭa­śatābhimantritaṃ kṛtvā śvetasarṣapān caturdikṣu ity ūrdhvam adhaḥ vidikṣu ca kṣipet | tato tantuvāyaṃ sarṣapaiḥ saṃtāḍya mahā­mudrāṃ pañcaśikhāṃ baddhvā śikhābandhaṃ kurvīta | mahā­rakṣā kṛtā bhavati || 4.31 ||

yadi jyeṣṭhaṃ paṭaṃ bhavati caturhastavistīrṇam aṣṭahastasudīrgham | etat pramāṇaṃ hi tantuvāyopacitaṃ kuryāt | madhyamaṃ bhavati dvihastavistīrṇaṃ pañcahastadīrghatvam | kanyasaṃ sugatavitastipramāṇam °pramāṇam] em.; °pramāṇa S {S59} aṅguṣṭhahastadīrghatvam | tatra bhagavato buddhasya vitastir vitastir] em.; vitasti° S madhyadeśapuruṣapramāṇahastam ekam eṣā sugatasya vitastir iti kīrtyate | anena pramāṇena prāmāṇyam ākhyātam || 4.32 ||

lg.l: uttiṣṭha siddhir jyeṣṭhā tu kathitā lokapuṅgavaiḥ |
madhyame rājyakāmānām antardhāne pare munau || 4.33 || {V41}
mahā­bhogārthināṃ puṃsāṃ tridevāsurabhoginām |
kanyase siddhi-m-ākhyātā madhyame siddhir siddhir] em.; siddhi° S madhyamā || 4.34 ||
kṣudrakarmāṇi sidhyante kanyase tu paṭe sadā |
sarvakāryāṇi sidhyante sarvadravyāṇi vai sadā || 4.35 ||
paṭatraye 'pi nirdiṣṭā siddhiḥ śreyo'rthināṃ nṛṇām |
vidhibhraṣṭā na sidhyeyuḥ śakrasyāpi śacīpateḥ || 4.36 ||
sidhyante kṣipram evaṃ tu sarvakarmā na yatnataḥ |
vidhinā ca samāyuktā itasyāpi tṛjanminaḥ || 4.37 ||
eṣa mārgaḥ samākhyāto jinair jinavarātmajaiḥ |
śreyasaḥ sarvasattvānāṃ daridrānāthaduḥkhinām || 4.38 ||
bodhimārgo hy aśeṣas tu darśitas tattvadarśibhiḥ |
bodhihetur ayaṃ vartma mantramārgeṇa darśitaḥ || 4.39 ||
mantrāḥ sidhyanty ayatnena sarvalaukikamaṇḍalāḥ |
lokottarāś cāpi sidhyante maṇḍalā ye udāhṛtāḥ || 4.40 ||
bodhihetumatir yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ siddhiḥ sadā bhavet |
nānyeṣāṃ kathyate siddhir ahitā ye jage sadā || 4.41 ||
bodhāya prasthitāṃ BHS genitive plural. sattvāṃ sadā siddhir udāhṛtā |
mañjuśriyasya mahātmāno kumārasyeha viśeṣataḥ || 4.42 ||
kṣiprakāryānusādhyarthaṃ prāpnuyāt sakalād iha |
anupūrvaṃ tato śilpī paṭaṃ vāyeta yatnataḥ || 4.43 ||
divasaiḥ pañca-r-aṣṭābhiḥ ṣoḍaśādvicatuṣkayoḥ |
ahorātreṇa vai kṣipraṃ samāptiḥ paṭavāyane || 4.44 || {S60}
ahorātreṇa vai śreya•uttama uttama°] em.; uttamā Ssiddhilipsunām |
śaucācārasampanno śilpino nityādhiṣṭhitaḥ nityādhiṣṭhitaḥ] em.; nityadhiṣṭhitaḥ S || 4.45 ||
dūrād āvas tathā gatvā kuṭiprasrāvam utsṛjet |
sacelas tu tataḥ snātvā anyavāsān nivāsya ca || 4.46 ||
śuklāmbaradharaḥ sragmī • upaspṛśya punaḥ punaḥ |
śvetacandanaliptāṅgo hastau • udghṛṣya śilpinaḥ || 4.47 ||
bhūyo vayeta yatnena ślakṣṇaṃ sandhautaṃ sandhautaṃ] em.; sandhotaṃ S sadā |
evam ādyaiḥ prayogais tu anyair vā jinabhāṣitaiḥ || 4.48 || {V42}
vicāraśīlī yatnena paṭasyāśeṣavāyanā |
samāpte tu paṭe prokte pūrvakarmasu nirmite || 4.49 ||
pramāṇasthe • ahīne ca kuryād bhadre 'hani 'hani] em.; 'haniḥ S samam |
avatārayet tato tantrā śuklapakṣe suśobhane || 4.50 ||
parisphuṭaṃ tu paṭaṃ kṛtvā daśābaddhānuśobhanam |
veṇuyaṣṭyāvanaddhaṃ tu paṭaṃ gṛhya tato vrajet || 4.51 ||
śilpinaṃ svastyayitvā tu saṃvibhāgārthavistaraiḥ |
gatvā yatheṣṭato mantrī susamācārasuvratī || 4.52 ||
sugandhapuṣpair abhyarcya śucau deśe tu taṃ nyaset |
anenaiva tu mantreṇa kṛtarakṣāpithānitam || 4.53 ||
yena tat picukaṃ pūrvaṃ saṃśodhya bahudhā punaḥ |
tenaiva kārayed rakṣām ātmanaś ca paṭasya vai || 4.54 ||
mañjuśriyo mahā­vīro mantrarūpeṇa bhāṣitaḥ |
atītair bahubhir mantrair mayāpy etarhi punaḥ punaḥ || 4.55 ||
sa eva sarvamantrāṇāṃ viceruḥ mantrarūpiṇaḥ |
mahā­vīryo mahā­tejaḥ sarvamantrārthasādhakaḥ || 4.56 ||
karoti vividhākārān vividhākārān] em. (on the authority of the Tib.); trividhākārāṃ S vicitrā trāṇahetavaḥ |
jambudvīpagatāḥ sattvāḥ mūḍhācāracetanāḥ || 4.57 || {S61}
aśrāddhaviparītās °viparītās] em.; viparītas S tu mithyācārasalolupāḥ |
na śādhayanti mantrāṇi sarvadravyāṇi vai punaḥ || 4.58 ||
ata eva bhramante te saṃsārāndhāracārake |
yas tu śuddhamanaso nityaṃ śrāddho kautuko kautuko] em.; kotuka° S maṅgale sadā || 4.59 ||
autsuko sarvamantreṣu nityaṃ grahaṇadhāraṇe |
siddhikāmā mahātmāno mahotsāhā mahojasāḥ || 4.60 ||
teṣāṃ siddhyanty ayatnena mantrā ye jinabhāṣitāḥ |
aśrāddhānāṃ tu jantūnāṃ śuklo dharmo na rohate śuklo dharmo na rohate] em. (on the authority of the Tib.); śuklo dharmeṇa rohate S || 4.61 ||
bījam ūṣare kṣiptam aṅkuro 'phalo yathā |
śraddhā mūlaṃ sadā dharme • uktaṃ sarvārthadarśibhiḥ |
mantrasiddhiḥ sadā proktā teṣāṃ dharmārthaśīlinām || iti || 4.62 || {V43}

tei:div.p: tato sādhane śilpinaḥ suśikṣitacitrakaro vā • ātmano vā kuśalā lekhyā aśleṣakai raṅgaiḥ | sarvojjvalaṃ raṅgopetaṃ varṇakaṃ gṛhya pūrveṇaiva vidhinā yathā tantuvāya†yāyanen†aiva lakṣaṇasamanvāgatena citrakareṇa peyālaṃ vistareṇa kartavyaṃ yathā pūrvaṃ tantuvāyavidhis tenaiva tat paṭaṃ citrāpayitavyaṃ svayaṃ vā citritavyam || 4.63 ||

karpūrakuṅkumacandanādibhī °ādibhī] em.; °ādibhi° S raṅgaṃ vāsayitavyam | dhūpaṃ dahatā tenaiva mantreṇāṣṭaśatavāraṃ parijapya nāga­kesara­puṃnāgabakula­campaka­vārṣikā °vārṣikā°] em.; °vāpīka° Sdhānuṣkārikamālatīkusumādibhis taṃ paṭam abhyavakīrya pūrvābhimukhaḥ kuśaviṇḍakopaviṣṭaḥ svasthabuddhiḥ sarvabuddhabodhi­sattvagatacittaḥ sūkṣmavartipratigṛhītapāṇir anāyāsacittas taṃ paṭam ālikhet || 4.64 ||

ādau tāvac chākyamuniṃ tathāgatam ālikhet sarvākāravaropetaṃ dvātriṃśanmahā­puruṣalakṣaṇalakṣita•aśītyānuvyañjanopaśobhitaśarīraṃ ratnapadmopariniṣaṇṇaṃ samanta­jvālaṃ samanta­vyāmopaśobhitamūrtiṃ °paśobhitamūrtiṃ] em.; °paśobhitaṃ mūrtiṃ S dharmaṃ deśayamānaṃ prasannamūrtiṃ sarvākāravaropetam || 4.65 ||

madhyasthaṃ vaidūrya­nāla­padmam adhaś ca mahāsānaṃ mahāsānaṃ] em. (on the authority of the Tib.); mahāsāraṃ S dvau nāgarājānau taṃ padmanālaṃ dhārayamāṇau dhārayamāṇau] em.; dhārayayānau S tathāgatadṛṣṭayo dakṣiṇahastena {S62} namasyamānau śuklau sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitau manuṣyākārārddhasarpadehanandopanandau lekhanīyau | samantāc ca tat padmasaraṃ padma­pattra­puṣpa­kuḍmala­vikasita­jala­ja­prāṇibhiś ca śakunamīnādibhir vyāptam aśeṣavinyastasucirasuśobhanākāram abhilekhyam || 4.66 ||

yad bhagavato mūlapadmadaṇḍaṃ viṭapaṃ tatraiva vinisṛtāny anekāni padmapuṣpāny anupūrvonnatāni | vāmapārśve 'ṣṭau padmapuṣpāṇi | teṣu ca padmeṣu niṣaṇṇā niṣaṇṇā] em.; niṣaṇṇāni S aṣṭau mahā­bodhi­sattvavigrahā °vigrahā] em.; °vigrahām° S abhilekhyāḥ || 4.67 ||

prathamaṃ tāvad ārya­mañjuśrīr īṣat īṣat°] em.; iṣat° Spadmakiñjalkagauraḥ kuṅkumakanakavarṇo vā kumārākāro °ākāro] em.; °ākārā° S bāladārakarūpī pañcacīrakaśiraskaḥ kumārālaṅkārālaṅkṛto vāmahastanīloptalagṛhīto dakṣiṇahastena tathāgataṃ namasyamānaś cārumūrtis tathāgatagatadṛṣṭiḥ saumyākāra īṣatprahasitavadanaḥ samanta­jvālāvabaddha °baddha°] em.; °buddha° Smaṇḍalaparyeṣaḥ || 4.68 ||

aparasmin padme • ārya­candraprabhaḥ kumara­bhūtaḥ tathaivam abhilekhyaḥ | tṛtīye sudhanaś caturthe sarvanīvaraṇaḥ pañcame gaganagañjaḥ ṣaṣṭhe kṣitigarbhaḥ saptame 'nagho 'ṣṭame sulocana iti | ete sarve kumāradārakākārā ābhilekhyāḥ kumārālaṅkārabhūṣitāḥ || 4.69 ||

dakṣiṇapārśve bhagavata aṣṭau mahā­bodhisattvāḥ sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitā varjayitvā tu maitreyam | bhagavataḥ samīpe ārya­maitreyo brahmacāriveṣadhārī jaṭāmakuṭāvabaddhaśiraskaḥ kanakavarṇo raktakaṣāyadhārī raktapaṭāṃśukottarīyas tripuṇḍrakakṛtacihnaḥ kāyarūpī daṇḍakamaṇḍaluvāmavinyastapāṇiḥ kṛṣṇasāracarmavāmaskandhāvakṣipto °āvakṣipto] em.; °āvakṣipta° S dakṣiṇahastagṛhītākṣasūtras tathāgataṃ namasyamānas tannatadṛṣṭir dhyānālambanagatacittacaritaḥ || 4.70 ||
dvitīyasmin padme samanta­bhadraḥ priyaṅguvarṇaśyāmaḥ sarvālaṅkāraśarīro vāmahaste cintāmaṇiratnavinyasto dakṣiṇahaste śrīphalavinyastahastavaradaś cārurūpī tathaivam abhilikhitavyam || 4.71 ||

tṛtīye • āryāvalokiteśvaraḥ śaratkāṇḍagauraḥ sarvālaṅkārabhūṣito jaṭāmakuṭadhārī śvetayajñopavītaḥ | sarva­jña­śirasīkṛta•āryāmitābhada­śabala­jaṭāntopalagnopaviṣṭaṃ cārurūpaṃ vāmahastā vāmahastā°] conj. (based on the Tib.); cāmarahastā° Sravindavinyastaṃ dakṣiṇahastena varadaṃ dhyānālambanagatacittacaritaṃ samanta­dyotitaśarīram || 4.72 || {V44}
