sarvāṃ yakṣagaṇāṃ °gaṇāṃ] S; °gān A mantraḥ • yakṣīṇāṃ ca sa sarvataḥ || 51.73 ||
uvāca bodhisattvo °sattvo] S; °sattvā A vai yakṣasenāpatis tadā |
yakṣīṇāṃ paṭalaṃ vavre vavre] S; vate A sarvakarmopasaṃhitam |
sarvākarṣaṃ vaśaṃ caiva sarvaśalyānanuddharam || 51.74 ||
maithunārthī yadā mantrī rāgāndho vātha mūḍhadhīḥ |
na śakyaṃ pratipakṣeṇa sugatājñair nivāritum || 51.75 ||
anādim atisaṃsāre purābhyastaṃ suduḥkhitaiḥ |
duḥkhād duḥkhād] A; duḥkhā S duḥkhataraṃ teṣāṃ gatir uktā tathāgataiḥ || 51.76 ||
śobhanāṃ gatim {A16v} āpnoti brahmacārī jitendriyaḥ |
bhadraṃ śivaṃ ca nirdiṣṭam ante śāntim avāpnuyāt |
triyānasamatārūḍhaḥ • m-āpnuyānte sunirvṛtim || 51.77 ||
viparītāḥ kumati kumati°] A; kugati° Sgrastā ye ye] S; om. A rāgāndhā tapasvinām |
saṃsāragahane ghore bhramanti bhramanti] S; bhramati A gatipañcake || 51.78 ||
teṣāṃ duḥkhitānām duḥkhitānām] A; duḥkhitām (unmetrical) S arthe kāmabhogaṃ tu varṇyate |
te te] S; om. A nirvṛtā sarvapāpā sarvapāpā] em. (m.c.); sarvapāpā ta A p.c.; sarvapāpā tu S tridhā doṣanivartitāḥ nivartitāḥ] A; nivartitā S |
śāstur ājñāsamāviṣṭā mucyante sarvabandhanād bandhanād] A; bandhanā S || iti || 51.79 ||

tei:div.p: āryamañjuśriyamūlakalpād bodhi­sattvapiṭakāvataṃsakān mahāyānavaipulyasūtrād ekapañcāśo ekapañcāśo] em.; ekūnapañcāśatimaḥ S yamāntakakrodharājābhicārukaniyamo dvitīyaḥ paṭalavisaraḥ parisamāptaḥ || Correspondence with manuscript A ends here, to resume again in paragraph 52.14 of the next chapter.

tei:div.head: Chapter A52
tei:div.p: atha khalu śāntamatir bodhisattvo mahā­sattvas tasminn eva parṣatsannipāte sannipatitaḥ sanniṣaṇṇo 'bhūt | utthāyāsanāt sarvabuddhaṃ praṇamya parṣanmaṇḍalamadhye sthitvā bhagavantaṃ śākya­muniṃ triḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya caraṇayor nipatya sa yena vajrapāṇir mahāyakṣasenāpatis tena vyavalokya vācam udīrayati sma || 52.1 ||

atikrūras tvaṃ vajrapāṇe vajrapāṇe] em.; vajrapāṇeḥ S yas tvaṃ sarvasattvānāṃ sattvopaghātikaṃ kāmopasaṃhitaṃ ca mantratantrāṃ bhāṣayase | na khalu bho jinaputra bodhisattvānāṃ mahā­sattvānām eṣa dharmaḥ | mahākaruṇāprabhāvitā hi mahābodhisattvā bodhi­sattvacārikāṃ carante | sarvasattvānām arthāya hitādhyāśayena pratipannā bhavabandhanān na mucyante || 52.2 ||

na ca punar bho jinaputra | sattvopaghātikāṃ dharmadeśanāṃ tathāgatārhantaḥ samyaksambuddhāḥ sarvasattvān uddiśya bhāṣante | mahākaruṇāsamanvāgatatvāt sarvasattvānāṃ hitādhyāśayena pratipannā bhavanti || 52.3 ||
atha khalu vajrapāṇir bodhisattvo mahā­sattvaḥ śāntamatiṃ bodhi­sattvam āmantrayate sma |

evaṃ hi śāntamate bodhisattvena śikṣitavyam | evaṃ pratipattavyam | yathā tvaṃ vadasi yathā tvaṃ prakāśayasi tathā sarvabuddhāḥ • bodhisattvāś ca maharddhikās tathāhaṃ nirdekṣyāmi paramārthato || 52.4 ||

lg.l: bhūtakoṭiṃ samāśritya dharmakoṭiṃ tu mucyate |
acintyaṃ sattvakoṭiṃ vai paripākam acintitam || 52.5 ||
acintyā buddhadharmās tu caryā bodhi-m-acintikā |
vaineyasattvam āgamya • acintyaṃ caritaṃ hi taiḥ || 52.6 ||
caryā bodhisattvānām acintyā parikīrtitā |
sarvamantreṣu tantro 'yam acintya tatprabhāvataḥ || 52.7 ||
krodharājasya mantrasya yamāntasya mahātmanaḥ |
acintyam ṛddhiviṣayaṃ gatimāhātmyam acintyakam || 52.8 ||

tei:div.p: acintyā hi śāntamate bodhisattvānāṃ mahā­sattvānāṃ caryāniṣyandita °niṣyandita°] em.; °niṣpandita° Ssattvadhātunirhāram | evaṃ hi śāntamate bodhisattvena mantrajāpinā {S560} cittam utpādayitavyam | kāmam asya sattvasyārthāya bahv apuṇyaṃ prasunuyāt | mahānarakopapattiś ca | na tv evāyaṃ sattvo bahutaram apuṇyaskandhaṃ prasunuyāt | mā nāmāyaṃ sattvas trayāṇāṃ bodhīnām abhavyo bhavet || 52.9 ||

evaṃ hi śāntamate bodhisattvena mantrajāpinā cittam upasthāpya • upāyakauśalyaṃ cābhicārukaṃ ca karma prayoktavyam | sarvakarmiṣu ca nimittagrāhiṇā bhavitavyaṃ nākuśalagrāhiṇā | sattvavaineyam upādāyatā ca śikṣitavyaṃ karuṇāviṣṭena cetasā || 52.10 ||

api ca bho jinaputra dharmādharmaśubhāśubhaṃ kuśalākuśala­gati­māhātmya­sattvopāya­vinayanirahāratāṃ The form nirahāratāṃ is probably nirhāratāṃ with a svarabhakti breaking up the cluster rh. dharmadhātunirahāratāṃ ca pratipadyante buddhā bhagavantaḥ | sarva eva dharmadeśanāsattvopāyapācakāṃś °pācakāṃś] em. (on the authority of the Tib.); °pāyakāṃ S ca pratipadyante || 52.11 ||

atha śāntamatir bodhisattvo mahā­sattvo vajrapāṇiṃ yakṣasenāpatiṃ vyavalokya tūṣṇīmbhūtaḥ svake • āsane niṣaṇṇo 'bhūt | acintyā buddhadharmā iti manasikṛtya buddhaṃ bhagavantaṃ vyavalokayamānaḥ || 52.13 ||

p.note: Here resumes correspondence with manuscript A.

tei:div.p: atha vajrapāṇir guhyakādhipatiḥ sarvaṃ tat parṣanmaṇḍalam avalokya bhūyaḥ krodharājasya kalpaṃ bhāṣate sma | śṛṇvantu bhavanto devasaṅghāḥ • ye sattvadhātuniśritāś ca sarve bhūtagaṇāḥ || 52.14||

ādau tāvat kṛtarakṣas taṃ paṭaṃ krodharājasya parigṛhya viveke sthāne gatvā • ekaliṅge maheśvarasyāyatane taṃ liṅgaṃ viṣarudhirarājikākāñjikenābhyajya picumardapattrair arcayitvā mānuṣāntranāḍibhir °nāḍibhir] em.; °nāḍibhiḥ A; °nālibhi S ātmanā yajñopavītaṃ kṛtvā mānuṣaśirakapālena dakṣiṇahastena saprahāro bhūtvā vāmahastena tarjanyā liṅgaṃ tarjayamānaḥ paramakrodhābhibhūtaḥ • avamānita avamānita° S; apamānita° Aduṣṭarājānair mahāparibhavagatamānasaḥ • anyair vā dhūrtapuruṣair mahāpakṣair mahāpakṣair] em. (on the authority of the Tib.); mahāyakṣair S mahādhanair mahāpracaṇḍair mahānāyakaiś ca | dvāraṃ ca dvāraṃ] A; śuddhāraṃ S pithayitvā nagnako muktaśikho maheśvaraliṅgaṃ vāmapādenākramya krodhamantraṃ tāvaj japed {S561} yāvan maheśvaraliṅgo madhye sphuṭita iti || 52.15 ||

dvividalībhūtaṃ mahāṃś ca {A17r} hūṁ hūṁ°] A; huṅ° Skāraḥ śrūyate | tato na bhetavyam | tadaho tadaho] em.; tadahor A; tadeho S eva duṣṭarājñaḥ • anyo vā yaḥ kaścin mahāpakṣaḥ mahāpakṣaḥ] em. (on the authority of the Tib.); mahāyakṣaḥ S; mahāpuruṣaḥ A • aris tatkṣaṇād eva jvareṇa jvareṇa] S; mahājvareṇa A gṛhyate | amānuṣeṇa vā gṛhyate rākṣasādibhiḥ | tatraiva muhūrtaṃ japed yāvat kṣaṇād kṣaṇād] S; akṣṇād A eva śatror jīvitaṃ maraṇaparyavasānaṃ bhavati | yadi rātryantaṃ japet japet] A; jape S tatsarvakuṭumbo naśyati || 52.16 ||

aparam api karma bhavati | madhyāhne tathaiva maheśvarāyatanaṃ gatvā nimbapattrair abhyarcya mahāmāṃsadhūpaṃ dattvā mantraṃ japet | yāvac chatror bhavanam agninā dahyate śatroś ca mahājvarakampo bhavati | yadi jāpaṃ na tyajate kruddho vā dakṣiṇamūrtau dakṣiṇamūrtau] em.; dakṣiṇamūrttau A; dakṣiṇamūrtais S tiṣṭhate sa śatrur mriyate | gotrotsādo bhavati | atha pratyānayanaṃ pratyānayanaṃ] A; pratyāyanaṃ S karoti | bhūyo liṅgam udakena prakṣālya suśītalena kṣīreṇa snāpayet gavyena bhūyaḥ | svastho bhavati || 52.17 ||

aparam api karma bhavati | maheśvaraliṅgasya dakṣiṇāmūrtau madanakaṇṭakakaṣṭhair agniṃ prajvālya vaikaṅkatasamidhānāṃ viṣarudhirarājikābhyaktānām aṣṭasahasraṃ juhuyāt | sarve śatravo mahāvyādhinā gṛhyante | aśaktā bhavanti sarvakarmeṣu | dvitīye divase mahājvareṇa mahāśūlena vā gṛhyante vividhair vā rogair amānuṣair vā māraṇāntikaiḥ | tṛtīye divase tṛbhiḥ sandhyaiḥ sarveṇa sarvaṃ jīvitaṃ tyajante | pratyānayane pratyānayane] A; pratyāyane S kṣīraṃ juhuyāt | śāntir bhavati | sarvajanapadeṣu sarvaśatravaś ca svasthā bhavanti || 52.18 ||

evaṃ sarvadevānāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ yo yasya devatābhaktas tam ākramya karma karma] em.; karmma A; om. S kuryāt | tasya nakṣatramantrasaṃjñitāṃ saṃjñitāṃ] A; saṃjñatāṃ S pādenākramya vāmena karma kuryād varjayitvā {A17v} tu tāthāgatīṃ tāthāgatīṃ] A; tāthāgatiṃ S vidyām | sarveṣāṃ ca pādāṅguṣṭhamadhyataḥ °madhyataḥ] A; °ṃ vāmena S • gṛhītvā karma kuryān na cākrameṇāpi ca laṅghayet ca laṃghayet] A; calaṃyeyet S kadā | sarvalaukikamantrāś cākramya kuryāt || 52.19 ||

asiddha eva krodharājā jāpamātreṇaiva karmāṇi karoti | sarvamantrān sarvamantrān] em.; sarvamantrāṃ S; sarvamantrānāṃ A vināśayati sarvaśatrūṅ ghātayati sarvayantrān pātayati | saṃkṣepato yathā yathā prayujyate sarvalaukikalokottaramantravidhānenāpi tat sarvaṃ karoti | tat tat] A; om. S sarvaṃ sādhayati | jāpamātreṇa sarvāśāṃ pāripūrayati | paṭhitasiddha °siddha] A; °siddhā S eṣa krodharājā • uttamāṃ siddhim anuprayacchati | manasecchayā śatruṃ ghātayati | mahāśūlamudrayā saṃyuktaḥ sarvakarmāṇi karoti || 52.20 || {S562}

aparam api karma bhavati | madhyāhne śmaśānaṃ gatvā gatvā] A; om. S citāv ekarātroṣitaḥ kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ śmaśānakāṣṭhair agniṃ prajvālya viṣarudhirāktāṃ rudhirāktāṃ] S; rudhirāktānyaṃ A rājikāṃ juhuyāt | tato hāhākāraṃ kurvantaḥ sarvapretā āgacchanti | {V439} na bhetavyam | tato vaktavyaṃ śatruṃ me ghātayatheti ghātayatheti] A; ghātayeti S | evam astv iti kṛtvāntardhīyante | tato muhūrtamātreṇa yojanasahasram api gatvā śatruṃ ghātayanti kulān utsādayanti | evam ādīni karmāṇi kurvanti || 52.21 ||

aparam api karma bhavati | viveke śucau deśe śucivastraprāvṛtena śūnyagṛhaṃ praviśya karpāsāsthyāhutīnām karpāsāsthyāhutīnām S; karpāśāsthyāṃ hutīnāṃ A aṣṭasahasraṃ juhuyāt | tato taṃ bhasma • ubhābhyāṃ hastābhyāṃ gṛhya gṛhya] S; gṛhaṃ gṛhya A śucau vastrakhaṇḍe badhnīyāt badhnīyāt] em.; badhnīyā S, A | pṛthak pṛthak dvau poṭalikāṃ poṭalikāṃ] A; poṅgalikāṃ S kṛtvā śarāvasampuṭe sthāpya mahākṛtarakṣāś cātmano dravyaṃ ca gṛham apaviśya apaviśya] em.; apraviśya S mahāśmaśānaṃ mahāśmaśānaṃ] S; śmaśānaṃ A gatvā rātrau kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ vā citau sthitvā dakṣiṇābhimukhaḥ śarāvasampuṭaṃ gṛhītvā sthitako nagnako muktaśikhaḥ {A18r} sa kruddho nirbhayo bhūtvā vidyā daśasahasrāṇi japet | siddho bhavati tad bhasma || 52.22 ||

yadi kaścid amānuṣo amānuṣo] S; amānuṣo vā A dravyaṃ prārthayate tadā na tadā na] A; na S dātavyam | haṭhaṃ karoti krodharājaṃ smṛtyā smṛtyā] A; smṛtvā S | hūṁ hūṁ°] A; huṅ° Skāraḥ prayoktavyaḥ | tatkṣaṇād eva naśyate | sarvavighnānām eṣa eva vidhiḥ | vāmadakṣiṇakaragṛhītaṃ bhasmacihnaṃ kārayet || 52.23 ||

apramattena rakṣāṃ kārayitvā • āgantavyam prabhāte | sūryodaye snātvā snātvā] S; śrāvo A śucinā śucinā] S; om. A śucivastraprāvṛtena svagṛhaṃ praveṣṭavyam svasthāne svasthāne] em.; asthāne S; svacchānaṃ A vā yathābhimate gantavyam || 52.24 ||

tato yo dakṣiṇahastena gṛhītaṃ bhasma tena manuṣyādvipadacatuṣpadān sarvaprāṇibhūtān sa sa°] S; ta° Adevanāgayakṣān mūrdhnā tāḍayet | vaśā bhavanti | yad vāmena hastena gṛhītaṃ bhasma tena sarveṣāṃ manuṣyāmanuṣyāṇāṃ sarvāsāṃ strīṇāṃ mūrdhnā tāḍayet | vaśyā bhavanti || 52.25 ||

dakṣiṇena yad gṛhītaṃ bhasma tena manuṣyāṇāṃ nābhideśe tāḍayet | napuṃsakā bhavanti | aṅgajātadeśaṃ °deśaṃ] A; °deśena S vā vā] A; ca S cūrṇayed | asamartho bhavati grāmyadharmanisevane °nisevane] em.; °niṣedhane A; °niṣeviṇo S || 52.26 ||

yasyāṃ striyāyām abhirakto abhirakto] em. (on the authority of the Tib.); abhiśakto S, A bhavati tasyāṅgajāte guhyapradeśe bhasmanāvacūrṇayet | asamarthā sā asamarthā sā] S; asamartho A bhavati • anyapuruṣābhisevane °ābhisevane] em.; °ābhiṣevane A; °ātisevane S | naṣṭavraṇā bhavati bhavati] S; bhavanti A | yāvantaṃ tad eva puruṣaṃ prāpnuyāt punar eva tasyās tadvraṇamukhaṃ prādurbhavati | kāmamithyācāram {S563} aśaktā aśaktā] A; aśakto S nisevitum nisevitum] S; nisevayitum A || 52.27 ||

evaṃ puruṣasyāpi | puruṣendriyaṃ dakṣiṇahastaṃ bhasmanāvacūrṇayet | so 'pi • asamartho bhavati paradārābhigamane | parimlānam parimlānam] S; pasmimlānam A iva tiṣṭhate tasya tadaṅgajātam | yāvad dātur dātur] em.; dātu A; dātra° S vaśāt tasyaiva tat punaḥ prādurbhavati | striyasya vā puruṣaya vā yena vā punas tad bhasma punas tad bhasma] A; tad bhasma punar S dattaṃ bhavati tasya vaśena vartati vā vā] S; om. A na vartati vā yatheṣṭaṃ vā taṃ karoti || 52.28 ||

yadi balāt {A18v} kurvanti yeṣāṃ tu tad dattaṃ teṣāṃ guhyapradeśāni krimayaḥ prādurbhavante yair bhakṣyamānā bhakṣyamānā] A; bhakṣamānā S jīvitād vyaparopyante vyaparopyante] A; vyaparoṣyante S | māsābhyantareṇa pūtikā vā bhavanti durgandhakuṇapasadṛśāḥ mahāpradara °pradara°] A; °pratara° Srogādibhiḥ puruṣavyādhibhiḥ puruṣā gṛhyante | mahāśvethuś copajāyate | yena teṣāṃ tenaivābādhena tenaivābādhena] S; tenaiva vyādhinā A kālakriyā bhavati | aśaktā vā bhavanti pratisevituṃ dātārasyecchayā dātārasyecchayā] A; dāsasyecchayā S | yathābhirucitaṃ tat sarvaṃ kārayati kārayati] S; kārāpayati A spṛṣṭamātraḥ || 52.29 ||

atha śayanāsanādīnām astaraṇaprāvaraṇādīnāṃ vividhāni vālaṅkaraṇaviśeṣāṇi nānāvastrāṇi °vastrāṇi] S; °śastrāṇī A vā vāhanayānopānaha °pānaha°] S; °pānahasta° Acchatrādīnāṃ sarvāṇy upakaraṇaviśeṣāṇi bhojanapānabhakṣaṇādīnāṃ sarvāṇi śarīropayojyāni bhāṇḍopakaraṇāni puṣpa puṣpa°] A; puṣpan° Stāmbūlaphalagandhadhūpādīnāṃ sarveṣu tais taṃ bhasmanāvacūrṇayet | arīṇāṃ yūkamatkuṇa yūkamatkuṇa°] S; mūkasaṃkuṇa° Akrimibhiḥ samantāt tac samantāt tac°] A; samantāvac° Scharīram ākīrṇaṃ bhavati | bhakṣyate bhakṣyate] A; bhakṣate S ca | vividhaduḥkhavihato °duḥkhavihato] S; °duḥkhātihato A bhavati | saptarātreṇa mriyate | aśaktāḥ sarve vaidyāḥ sarvadevāś ca nivārayitum | aśaktāḥ sarvamantrāḥ • rakṣayitum | varjayitvā tu taṃ yena taṃ yena] A; tena S dattaṃ bhavati || 52.31 ||

atha pratyānayanaṃ pratyānayanaṃ] A; pratyāyanaṃ S bhavati | yaṣṭīmadhuṃ nīlotpalaṃ śvetacandanaṃ caikīkṛtya śītalenāmbhasā °āmbhasā] A; °āmbhasa S {A19r} pīṣayitvā taccharīraṃ mrakṣayet mrakṣayet] S; takṣayet A • mūrdhnā prabhṛti yāvat pādatalam ārya­mañjuśriyamūlamantraṃ japatā | svastho bhavati || 52.32 ||

aparam api karma bhavati | strīṇām anuvātaṃ gatvā yatrepsatā sarvaduṣṭaḍākinistrīṇāṃ garvitānāṃ ca prayoktavyaṃ nānyeṣām | tam enam anuvāte {S564} sthitvā bhasmam utsṛjet | manasā cintyayitvā sarvabhagastanāny apahṛtāni bhavanti | puruṣasyāpi puruṣendriyaṃ śmaśruromāṇi ca stanāni ca prādurbhavante | evaṃ vividhavicitrāṇy anekāni karmāṇi karoti pareṇa vā kārāpayati | yatra vā prītir utpadyate tena ca ca] A; vā S kārāpayati | striyā striyā] S; striyāyāṃ A vā puruṣeṇa vā || 52.33 ||

yatra vā cittasya nivṛttir nivṛttir] em.; nirvṛttir S utpadyate tasya tad bhasma bhasma] A; bhasmāṃ S dattvā yatheṣṭaṃ kārāpayati | prayogataś ca śikṣāpayet | evaṃ mahāvyādhibhir gṛhṇāpayati | manasā cintayitvā mūrdhni sparśanān mastakaśūlaḥ • mukhasparśanān mukhapākaḥ | evam anūpūrvyā yāvad dhṛdayaṃ hṛcchūlakukṣiśūlaṃ vā • upajāyate | evaṃ padbhyāṃ jaṅghābhiś cāsṛgudbhavai rogair duṣṭaśoṇitādiṣu rogair gṛhṇāpayati || 52.34 ||

saṃkṣepato mārayati śoṣayati pācayati • ākarṣayati vaśam ānayati vaśam ānayati] A; vaśayati S | yathā yathā prayujyate tathā tathā tat sarvaṃ karoti ca | upaghātikam ākarṣaṇa­vaśīkaraṇaṃ ca sudūre 'pi sthitaḥ karmāṇi karoti || 52.35 ||

sudurgaṃ kuḍyasamīpaṃ gatvā • anuvāte sthitvā tad eva bhasmotsṛjed ubhau pāṇigṛhītam | prākāraṃ pratolī•aṭṭālaṃś °aṭṭālaṃś] A; °aṭṭālāṃś S ca prapatante | tadādhyakṣaṃ bhavanaṃ ca mahāgnidāham upajāyate | senābhaṅgaṃ ca bhavati | mahopadravaiś copadruto bhavati | {A19v} sarvam avamucya prapalāyati vā grahaṇaṃ vādhigacchati || 52.36 ||

evaṃ parabale 'pi anuvāte bhasmam utsṛjet | mahābalasenāyā bhaṅgo bhavati | mahādāha mahādāha°] A; dāgha° Sjvareṇa vā gṛhyate | hastyaśvarathapatākādayaḥ °patākādayaḥ] S; °padātadayaḥ A senāpateś senāpateś] A; senāpatiś S ca bhaṅgam upajāyate | grahaṇaṃ vā • abhigacchati || 52.37 ||

evam anekaprakārāṇi anekaprakārāṇi] S; anekākārāṇi A yatheṣṭāni śatrunāśāya karmāṇi karoti | ātmano mahārakṣā ye ca svasenāyāṃ vā sakhāyānāṃ | atha pratyanayanaṃ pratyanayanaṃ] A; pratyayanaṃ S karoti sarvataḥ sarveṣām | paṭasyāgrataḥ kṣīrāhutisahasraṃ juhuyāt | svasthā bhavanti • adhṛṣyāś ca || 52.38 ||

lg.l: atha yakṣiṇīṃ sādhayitukāmaḥ |
naṭī naṭṭā naṭṭā] em.; naṭā A; naṭa S tathā bhaṭṭā bhaṭṭā] A; bhaṭṭa S revatī cāpi viśrutā |
tamasundarī tamasundarī] em.; tamasuṃdarī A; tamasurī S thālokā thālokā] A; tha lokā S mekhalā cāpi sumekhalā |
ity etā aṣṭa yakṣiṇyaḥ sarvakāmaprasādhikāḥ || 52.39 || {S565} {V441}

tei:div.p: naṭikāyā mantraḥ | oṁ naṭi mahānaṭi • āgaccha • āgaccha divyarūpiṇi svāhā | asyopacāraḥ | phalake paṭṭake vā • abhilikhya māṃsāhāreṇa vā kṣīrāhāreṇa vā kṣīrāhāreṇa vā] S; om. A vidyā • aṣṭasahasraṃ japtavyā | ālekhyā ca sarvālaṅkārabhūṣaṇī śyāmāvadātā śyāmāvadātā] S; śyāmā vaṭa° A vṛkṣāśritā ekavastrā muktakeśā saṃraktanayanā īṣismitamukhā sādhakaṃ tarjāyamānā dakṣiṇahastena vāmena pāṇinā vṛkṣaśākhām avalagnā sarvāṅgaśobhanā vicitrapaṭṭanivastā || 52.40 ||

tasyaiva krodharājasya paṭasyā paṭasyā] S; om. Agrataḥ • unmanā • uttarāmukhaṃ unmanā uttarāmukhaṃ] S; udamukhā uttarābhimukhaṃ A sthitvā palāśakāṣṭhair agniṃ prajvālya gugguluguṭikānāṃ dadhimadhughṛtāktānām aṣṭasahasraṃ juhuyāt trisandhyaṃ yāvat sapta divasāni | tataḥ saptame divase • udārāṃ baliṃ kṛtvā kṛtvā] S; om. A ghṛtapradīpāṃś ca prajvālya mantraṃ japatā tāvat tiṣṭhed yāvad ardharātram | {A20r} tataḥ sā yakṣiṇī svayam eva mahāvabhāsaṃ kṛtvā svarūpeṇāgacchati || 52.41 ||

āgatā ca bravīti | kiṃ mayā kartavyam iti | tataḥ sādhakena vaktavyam | bhāryā me bhavasva • iti | evam astv iti kṛtvāntardhīyate | tataḥ prabhṛti bhāryā bhavati | sarvakāmadā svabhavanaṃ nayati | rasāyanaṃ prayacchate yat pītvā divyarūpī bhavati mahāyakṣapratispardhī | yadi nāgacchati dvitīye vāre krodharājasahitaṃ japet | niyatam āgacchati | na ced ucchuṣyaṃ mriyate || 52.42 ||
naṭṭāyā mantraḥ | oṁ naṭṭe śuklāmbaramālyadhāriṇi maithunapriye svāhā | etasyā eṣa eva vidhiḥ || 52.43 ||

bhaṭṭāyā mantraḥ | oṁ bhaṭṭe bhaṭṭe] S; naṭe A bhaṭṭe • ālokini kiṃ cirāyasi | ehy ehi | āgaccha • āgaccha āgaccha āgaccha] em.; āgacchāgaccha S, A | mama kāryaṃ kuru svāhā | eṣā vināpi paṭena sidhyate | śiraḥsthāne maṇḍalakaṃ kṛtvā gugguludhūpaṃ dahatā vidyām aṣṭasahasraṃ japet | mauninā • ekākinā śucinā dvāraṃ pidhāya māsena rātrau niyatam niyatam] em.; niyatām S; niyam A āgacchati || 52.44 ||
revatyā mantraḥ | namaḥ sarvayakṣīṇām | oṁ rakte raktāvabhāse raktānulepane svāhā |

lg.l: revatyā yakṣiṇī śreṣṭhā lalantyā maithunapriyā |
īṣid raktena vastreṇa vastreṇa] (corroborated by the Tib.) S; vaktreṇa A nīlakuñcitamūrdhajā || 52.46 ||
sarvāṅgaśobhanā {A20v} yakṣī kāmabhogaratā sadā |
kāmadā bhogadā nityaṃ varadāṃ tām abhinirdiśet || 52.47 ||

tei:div.p: pūrvavat paṭam abhilikhya • etasyā ayaṃ viśeṣaḥ | raktapaṭṭanivastā raktapaṭṭāṃśukottarīyā raktāvabhāsā ca varṇataḥ || 52.48 ||
mekhalāyāḥ • mantraḥ | oṁ mekhale mahāyakṣiṇi mama kāryaṃ sampādaya svāhā || 52.49 ||
sumekhalāyā mantraḥ | oṁ mekhale sumekhale mahāyakṣiṇi sarvārthasādhani hūṁ hūṁ] em. (on the authority of the Tib.); oṁ S; om A | samayam anusmara svāhā || 52.50 || {V442}
ālokinyā mantraḥ | oṁ lokini oṁ lokini] S; ālokini A lokavati svāhā | eteṣām eta eva vidhiḥ || 52.51 ||

tamasundaryāyā mantraḥ | oṁ ghuṇu guhyake ghuṇu ghuṇu guhye guhye] S; guhyake A • ehy ehi guhyake svāhā | asyopacāraḥ | na • etāyā paṭavidhāno 'sti | ādau tāvac chucinā śucivastraprāvṛtena °prāvṛtena] S; °prāvṛte A pūrṇamāsyāṃ vivikte sthāne dvāraṃ pidhāyitvā • andhakāre • ālokavarjite vidyāṃ daśasahasrāṇi japet | pūrvasevā kṛtā bhavati || 52.52 ||

tataḥ sādhanam ārabhet | pūrṇamāsyād ārabhya yāvad aparā pūrṇamāsī • atrāntare karma bhavati | rātrau śayanakāle śayyām ārūḍhaḥ pracchanne gupte pradeśe • ekākinā dvāraṃ pidhayitvā • andhakāre lokavarjite andhakāre lokavarjite] A; om. S saṅkucitakarṇikāṃ °karṇikāṃ] S; °karṇikaṃ A vānapuṣpaṃ °puṣpaṃ] S; °puṣpakaṃ A ca kaṭutailena miśrayitvā hastau pādau prakṣālayitvā prakṣālayitvā] S; mrakṣayitvā A dakṣiṇaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ] S; om. A bāhum aṣṭaśatābhimantritaṃ kṛtvā svapet svapet] S; vandhayet A maunī maunī] A; monī S | evaṃ pratyāhaṃ yāvat paurṇamāsyāt | tato 'rdharātre niyatam āgacchati || 52.53 ||

āgatā ca na mantrāpayitavyā | tūṣṇībhāvena kāmayitavyā kāmayitavyā] S; kāmayitvāḥ A | ṣaḍbhiḥ māsaiḥ yadā mantrāpayati tadā mantrayitavyam | tataḥ prabhṛti siddhā bhavati | bhāryā bhavati sarvakāmadā | divyaṃ cāsya {A21r} sukhasaṃsparśam | adarśanenaiva adarśanenaiva] S; adarśanaiva A sarvakāryāṇi sampādayati | {S567} rasarasāyanāni samprayacchati || 52.54 ||

pṛṣṭham āropya sumerum api nayati | rātrau jambūdvīpaṃ bhrāmayati | yojanaśatasthitam api śatruṃ ghātayate | yathājñaptā tat sarvaṃ sampādayati | varjayitvā parastriyābhigamanam | sarveṣām ayaṃ vidhāna | parastrīṃ nābhigacchet | tenaiva saha saṃvaset | yadi gacchen maraṇonmattiṃ vā prayacchante || 52.55 ||

eṣā • andhārasundarī nāma yakṣiṇī | anekayakṣīśatasahasraparivṛtā | dine dine • ekaikāṃ yakṣaceṭīṃ yakṣaceṭīṃ] A; yakṣiṇīṃ kṣaviṭiṃ S preṣayati siddhā satī sarvasādhakānām | anekamantri °mantri°] em. (on the authority of the Tib.); °mantra° Sparivārā °parivārā] A; °parivārāṃ S ca sarvayakṣīṇāṃ ca maharddhikā tamāvṛtā | sarvāsām sarvāsām] A; sarveṣām S eṣa • eva vidhiḥ | kiṃ tarhi teṣāṃ darśanaṃ bhavati | etasyā darśanaṃ na bhavati || 52.56 ||

lg.l: andhāravāsinī nāma yakṣīṇāṃ maharddhikā |
guhāvāsinī naravīrā naravīrā] S; naraṃdhīrā A kumārī lokaviśrutā || 52.57 ||
vadhū vadhū°] A; madhu° Syakṣī manojñā ca saptamā surasundarī |
ity etāḥ sapta yakṣiṇyaḥ sattvānugraha sattvānugraha°] S; sarvānugraha° Akārikāḥ || 52.58 ||
paryaṭanti imaṃ lokaṃ kṛtsnāṃ caiva medinīm |
īṣitkṣaṇamātreṇa • utpatanti surālayam || 52.59 ||
saṅgrāmaṃ devadaityānāṃ yudhyante ca maharddhikāḥ |
dharmiṣṭhā karuṇāviṣṭāḥ sattvakāmāḥ suvatsalāḥ || 52.60 ||
sattvānāṃ hitakāmyarthaṃ paryaṭanti mahītale |
na tāsāṃ kiñcid duḥsādhyaṃ sarvakarmakarāḥ śubhāḥ |
sattvānām upabhogārthaṃ bodhisattvena bhāṣitā || 52.61 ||

tei:div.p: guhāvāsinyā guhāvāsinyā] em.; guhavāsinyā A; guhyavāsinyā S mantraḥ | oṁ guhile guhāmati guhāmati] em.; guhamati S, A guhāvāsini guhāvāsini] em.; guhavāsini A; guhavāsi S • ānaya bhagavati mayāntikaṃ samayam anusmara svāhā | khadirakāṣṭhair agniṃ prajvālya priyaṅgupuṣpāṇāṃ ghṛtāktānām aṣṭasahasraṃ juhuyāt trisandhyaṃ māsam ekam | pūrvasevā {A21v} kṛtā bhavati || 52.62 ||

tatrasthā divyarūpiṇī sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitā • ekākinī yakṣiṇī guhāvāsinī guhāvāsinī] em.; guhavāsinī S, A nāma likhāpayitavyā paṭṭavastranivastā paṭṭāṃśukottarīyā kanakavarṇā vicitracārurūpiṇī °rūpiṇī] A; °rūpī S | taṃ tādṛśaṃ paṭam abhilekhya śucau pradeśe śucinā kṣīrāhāreṇa vidyāṃ daśasahasrāṇi japet | mahāpūjāṃ kṛtvā yathāśaktito vā °śaktito vā] S; °śakti A | tato japānte mahāvabhāsaṃ kṛtvā divyarūpiṇī °rūpiṇī] A; °rūpī S yakṣiṇī svayam evāgacchati || 52.64 ||

āgatāyā jātī­kusumaiḥ śveta­candanodakavyatimiśrair argho deyaḥ | tataḥ sā bravīti | vatsa kiṃ kartavyam | vaktavyam | mātā me bhavasveti | evam astv iti evam astv iti] A; om. S kṛtvāntardhīyate | na ca tatra cittaṃ dūṣayitavyam | nāpi kāmopasaṃhitaṃ prārthayitavyam | āryā sā maharddhikā ca | kāmaṃ kāmaṃ] A; kāma S prārthayati na sidhyate | tataḥ prabhṛti mātṛvat sarvakāryāṇi karoti || 52.65 ||

aṣṭaśataparivārasya bhaktācchādaṃ prayacchate | viṣamasthasya trāyate | mahāvanya mahāvanya°] S; mahāraṇya° Aparvatasyoparisthitasyāpi sarvakāryāṇi sampādayati | kāmitaṃ ca bhojanam anuprayacchate | rasarasāyanādīn sarvam anuprayacchati | yatheṣṭaṃ cānuvartate | kuṭikuṭādīm °kuṭādīm] S; °kuṭāgārādīnām A abhinirmiṇoti | suvarṇasahasram anuprayacchati dine dine | sarvaṃ vyayīkartavyaṃ {A22r} tadaha eva | yadi na karoti cchinno bhavati | sarveṇa na sarvaṃ na sarvaṃ] A (corroborated by the Tib.); sarvaṃ S bhavati || 52.66 ||

aparam api karma asyā | asyaiva paṭasyāgrataḥ khadirakāṣṭhair agniṃ prajvālya vigatārcidhūmavigatair aṅgāraiḥ | dakṣiṇahastatale manaḥśilayā manaḥśilayā] em.; manacchilayā S; manacchilāyā A pratikṛtim abhilikhya nāma ca puruṣasya striyā vā striyā vā] em.; striyāyā A; striyā S vāmahastatale tatraivāṅgārarāśau tāpayet mantraṃ japatā | yojanaśatād °śatād] S (corroborated by the Tib.); °sahasrasthitam A apy apy] A; api striyam S ānayati | yad ucyate tat sarvaṃ kārayati | rātrau • etat karma na divā || 52.67 ||

naravīrāyā mantraḥ | oṁ naravīre svāhā | tathaiva • etasyā paṭam abhilikhya varjayitvā guhālayam | aśokavṛkṣāśritā likhāpayitavyā | etasyā ayaṃ viśeṣaḥ | sarvaṃ tathaiva karma yathā guhāvāsinyāḥ | ayaṃ ca vaktavyā | bhaginī me bhavasveti bhaginī me bhavasveti] conj.; bha+i++ ++ ++ śveti A; bhaginyāsveti S || 52.68 ||

etasyāparo 'sti karma | candragrahe suvarṇagairikāṃ bhūrjapattreṇa veṣṭayitvā mukhe prakṣipya tāvaj japed yāvac candro mukta iti | tataḥ suvarṇagairikayā yasyā nāma likhati striyasya vā • āyojanaśatāsthitām apy āyojanaśatāsthitām apy] A; āyojanaśatāsthitāpy S {S569} ānayati | prabhāte tatraiva nayati | bhaginīvat bhaginīvat] A; bhaginīva S kāryāṇi karoti | āpatsu ca ca] A; om. S mahārakṣāṃ karoti | sarvāṇy eva striyāṃ jāpamātreṇa vaśīkaroti | naravīrāyā eṣa vidhiḥ || 52.69 ||

yakṣakumārikāyā yakṣakumārikāyā] S; yakṣakumāryāyā A mantraḥ | oṁ yakṣakumārike svāhā | asyā ayam asyā ayam] S; asyām A upacāraḥ | gorocanena bhūrjapattre likhāpayitavyā | kumārī • ardhabarbarāśirā sarvālaṅkārabhūṣitā • ekavastrā | dakṣiṇahastena bījapūrṇāvasaktaphalā vāmahastenāśokavṛkṣaśākhāvalagnā || 52.70 || {A22v}

tādṛśaṃ bhūrjapattraṃ śirāsthāne • upari upari] S; upa° A sthāpayitavyam | guhye pradeśe • ekākinā ca svaptavyam | śvetacandanena ca maṇḍalakaṃ kṛtvā trisandhyaṃ jātī­kusumair abhyavakīrya gugguludhūpaṃ dahatā vidyām aṣṭasahasraṃ japed yāvan māsam ekam || 52.71 ||

tato pūrṇamāsyāṃ jātī­kusumair mahatīṃ pūjāṃ kārayitvā ghṛtapradīpāṃś ca ca] S; om. A nivedyāṃś ca dattvā kuśaviṇḍakopaviṣṭena rātrau tāvaj japed yāvat svarūpeṇaiva kumārī pañcaśataparivārā vaiśravaṇasya vaiśravaṇasya] S; vaiśramasya A duhitṛ duhitṛ] S; duhiṭṭe A • āgacchati | sarvaṃ taṃ diśābhāgam avalokayitvā svarūpeṇāntarikṣe tiṣṭhati | sā evam āha | kiṃ {V444} mayā kartavyam | tataḥ sādhakena vaktavyam | trayāṇāṃ vārāṇām anyatamam ekaṃ varaṃ prārthayitavyā | mātṛtve bhaginītve bhāryātve ca || 52.72 ||

yadi mātā bhavati na cittaṃ dūṣayitavyam | dūṣayato vināśam upajāyate | mātṛvad vartayitavyā | sā ca mātā pañcaśataparivārasya parivārasya] S; parivārā tasya A bhaktācchādanam alaṅkaraṇaviśeṣāṇi ca sarvatra cintitamātreṇaiva sarvaṃ sarvaṃ] A; om. S sampādayati | dine dine dīnārasahasraṃ dadāti | atraiva jambūdvīpe vicarataḥ sarvaṃ sampādayati || 52.73 ||

bhaginī bhavati tadā yojanaśatād api strīyam ānayati | tatraiva nayate | bhaginīvat sarvakāryāṇi sampādayati | atha bhāryā bhavati svabhavanaṃ nayate | divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ jīvati | yadā mriyate tadā • āḍhyakulopapattiḥ | sarvājñāṃ bhāryeva sampādayati || 52.74 ||

vadhūyakṣiṇyā mantraḥ | oṁ niḥ | eṣā vadhūyakṣiṇī | asyām upacāraḥ | śvetacandanena dakṣiṇāṃ {A23r} bāhum upalipya vāmataḥ kuṅkumena sahasrābhimantritaṃ kṛtvā rātrau • ekākinā mauninā pracchanne pradeśe dvāraṃ pidhāya pañcāṣṭau vibhītakaphalāni tilataile prakṣipya pacet || 52.75 ||

taṃ tailaṃ {S570} gṛhītvā vibhītakaphalāṃ °phalāṃ] S; °phalānāṃ A parityajya nave bhāṇḍe sauvarṇe rājate tāmre mṛnmaye vā sthāpya pādānte śayyāyāṃ sthāpayitavyaṃ sthāpayitavyaṃ] em.; sthāpayitavya A; om. S sahasrābhimantritaṃ kṛtvā • anenaiva mantreṇa • ekākṣarayakṣiṇyā andhakāre vivikte śayane puṣpābhikīrṇe svaptavyam || 52.76 ||

āgatya cāmānuṣī cāmānuṣī] em.; cāmānuṣīṃ S, A • pādau mrakṣayati | divyasukhasaṃsparśa °sukhasaṃsparśa°] A; °sukhaṃ sparśa° Skomalahastatalā yasya sparśanād eva divyaṃ sukhasaṃsparśanidrām upajāyate | yena sūryodaye 'pi rātryante duḥkhena pratibudhyate | pratibuddho 'pi pratibuddho 'pi] A; pratibuddhāpi S san tad eva eva] S; eva japitavyam | sahasrābhimantritaṃ A cintayet | na ca kāmayitavyā nāpi mantrāpayitavyā | ṣaḍbhir māsaiḥ siddhā bhavati || 52.77 ||

tataḥ sā divyarūpī • abhinavavadhv iva hṛṣāyamānā °vadhv iva hṛṣāyamānā] em.; °vadhv īva hṛṣāyamānā A; °badhvā vayātsamānā S paricārikaiḥ parivāritā pradīpahastā svaprabhodyotitālokā śayanāsanaparigṛhītā vicitrābharaṇojjvalā • āgatya ca mantrāpayate | kāmabhogopakaraṇaparigṛhītā • āgatya ca sādhakaṃ kaṇṭhe pariṣvajate | || 52.78 ||

tataḥ prabhṛti • iṣṭabhāryeva-m-anuvartate | āgatā ca kāmayitavyā rātrau paricarya prabhāte 'ntardhīyate | śayyāyāṃ muktāhāraṃ tyajya suvarṇasahasramūlyaṃ {A23v} dine dine parityajya gacchati ca ca] S; cāgacchati ca A | sarvaṃ niravaśeṣaṃ vyayīkartavyam | yadi kiñcit sthāpayati bhūyo na bhavati | na kasyacit kathitavyam | yadi kathayati bhūyo nāgacchati | anarthaṃ vā kurute māraṇāntam | paramaguhyakā hy ete paramagopyā na dvitīyasattvam ārocanaṃ kṣamante || 52.79 ||

mātā­pitṛsuhṛtsvāmibāndhavānām api nārocayitavyam | antaśaḥ paśor api paśor api] A; paśusyāpi S tiryaggatānāṃ prāṇināṃ nāropayitavyam nāropayitavyam] S; rocayitavyā A | paramaguhyam etat | sarvaguhyakānāṃ sarvayakṣiṇīnāṃ ca • eṣa eva vidhānaḥ vidhānaḥ] A; vidhānā S | siddhā api • asiddhā bhavanti yady ārocayate | anyastrīmaithunābhigamanaṃ °maithunābhigamanaṃ] S; °maithuno pi gamaṃ A ca bhāryāyā bhāryāyā] S; bhāryāya A ca ca] S; om. A varjayet sadā || 52.80 ||

tataḥ karmam ārabhet | mahāvasāṃ saṅgṛhya śmaśānacoṭakena °coṭakena] A; °voṭakena S vartiṃ kṛtvā dvāraṃ pidhayitvā pradīpaṃ prajvālayet | sadaśaṃ ca vastraṃ keśāpagataṃ bahir dvāre dvāre] A; °dvāra S sthāpayet pratyagram | {S571} rātrau sā nagnikāgatya taṃ vastraṃ nivāsya praviśate mānuṣastrīrūpiṇī bhūtvā | tataḥ sādhakaḥ tayā tayā] A; tena S sārdhaṃ ramate yāvat pradīpaṃ jvalate || 52.82 ||

nirvṛte pradīpe 'ntardhīyate | tasmin {V445} vastre suvarṇam ekaṃ baddhvā vastraṃ parityajya śayyāyām apakramati apakramati] S; apakrāmati A | atha sādhakas tāṃ haste gṛhṇāti | aṅguleyikaikam aṅguleyikaikam] em.; aṅguleyikaikā S; aṅguledikaikā A avamuñcyāpakramate avamuñcyāpakramate] em.; ca muṃcyāpakramate A; °āvamuñcyāvakramate S | atha kaṇṭhe kaṇṭhe] A; kaṇṭhā S divyamuktāhārām | atha bāhau bāhau] em.; vāhau A; bāhāt S kaṭakam | kaṭyāṃ mekhalām | padbhyāṃ nūpuram | śīrṣe maṇim | evam anyatarānyataraṃ divyam ābharaṇam ekaṃ {A24r} yatra yatra gṛhyate tatra tatrānuprayacchati || 52.83 ||

avandhyaṃ avandhyaṃ] A; avadhyāṃ S gacchati cāgacchati ca | evaṃ pratyahaṃ niravaśeṣaṃ vyayīkartavyam | evaṃ yāvad ṣadbhir yāvad ṣadbhir] A; yāvadbhir S māsair mantrāpayati tadā mantrayitavyam | bhāryā bhavati | nityasthā rasāyanaṃ prayacchati yaṃ yaṃ] S; jaṃ A pītvā dīrghakālaṃ jīvati | manasā dhyātvā khadirakīlakaṃ bhūmau nikhānayet | divyaṃ vimānam upapadyate | uddhṛte 'ntardhīyate || 52.84 ||

asyā asyā] A; asyāyā S mantraḥ dvitīyam asti | oṁ mahānagni nagnije nagnije] S; nagnike A svāhā | tenaiva dīpaṃ prajvālya • anena mantreṇāṣṭaśatābhimantritaṃ kṛtvā kārayet | niyatam āgacchati | kīlakaṃ cābhimantrya nikhānayet | uddhṛte dīpe nirvṛte cāntardhānam | kīlakaṃ mānuṣavasātailaṃ mānuṣavasātailaṃ] A; mānuṣaṃ vasākīlaṃ S ca gośṛṅge gośṛṅge] em.; gośṛṃge A; so śṛṅge S gavalamahiṣaśṛṅge vā śmaśāne cailavartiṃ ca cailavartiṃ ca] em.; cailavarttiñ ca A; cailavartinā S voḍhavyaṃ deśāntare | yatreṣṭaṃ tatra dadāti svayaṃ vā karoti | na ca mantrā dātavyā | atha dadāti chinnavidyo bhavati || 52.85 ||

yasya dadāti tasyaiva tat sampadyate | yatra vābhirucitaṃ yatra vā vā] S; om. A sthāne gupte karoti eṣā siddhir avandhyā bhavati avandhyā bhavati] (corroborated by the Tib.) A; āvartya nāpagacchati S | anyān anyān] em. (undoing the BHS sandhi); anyāṃ S, A vā ramāpayate kintu taiḥ sārdhaṃ na mantrayati | anyastrīdarśanābhirucitaṃ manasepsitaṃ tadānurūpī tasyopasaṅkramate °kramate] A; °kramato S hy apūrvasya sādhakavaśād iti || 52.86 ||

lg.l: ity etāḥ {A24v} sapta yakṣiṇyo vajrapāṇisamājñayā |
paryaṭanti mahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ trailokyaṃ ca surāsuram || 52.88 ||
vicaceruḥ vicaceruḥ] A; viceruḥ S kṛpālubhyo martyānāṃ maithunapriyāḥ |
ke cid āryās ke cid āryās] A; ke 'pi dāryās S tathā bālā mūḍhāś cāparayakṣikāḥ || 52.89 ||
paryaṭanti tathā rātrau siṃhakāpy siṃhakāpy] A; siṃhakāmy° S aparā hitā |
bālānāṃ jīvanāśāya lolupā māṃsabhojikā || 52.90 ||
tathā rudhiragandhena jambūdvīpaṃ hi-m-āgatāḥ |
prāṇāparodhikā yakṣī nityaṃ sā sā] S; māṃsa° (unmetrical) A śoṇitapriyā || 52.91 ||
paryaṭanti gṛhāṃ sarvām arakṣāṃ mṛtasūtakām arakṣāṃ mṛtasūtakām] A; ārakṣāmṛtakasūtakām (unmetrical) S |
teṣāṃ nigraham ity uktaḥ samayo 'yaṃ samprakāśitaḥ || 52.92 ||
yathā saṅgraharāgaṃ ca nibandhyaṃ ceha bāliśām |
tathā sarvam idaṃ proktaṃ sattvānāṃ hitakāraṇāt °kāraṇām] em.; °kāraṇāṃ A; °kāraṇāt A || 52.93 || {V446}
maithunārthī yadā yadā] A; yathā S mantrī rāgāndho mūḍhacetasaḥ |
mantrair ākṛṣya bhuñjīta yakṣīṃ yakṣīṃ] S; yathā A vā • atha rākṣasī |
nāgī ca-m-atha gandharvīṃ gandharvīṃ] A; gandharvī S daityayoṣim atha kinnarīm || 52.94 ||
pātālabhavanaṃ ramyam asurāṇāṃ purottamam |
praviśet tatra mantrajñaḥ • yatra strīṇām asaṅkhyakam |
tatra gatvā vaset kalpaṃ mantrajño mantrajāpinaḥ || 52.95 ||
maitreyo nāma sambuddhaḥ • yadā buddho bhaviṣyati |
tadāsau śroṣyati saddharmaṃ śrutvā mukto bhaviṣyati || 52.96 ||
surakanyāsurīṃ caiva vidyādharavarāṅganām |
mantrair ākṛṣya bhuñjīta divyasaukhyaratiṃ tadā || 52.97 ||
jambūdvīpaṃ gato mantrī tatraivānayate °ānayate] S; °ānayet (unmetrical) A sadā |
śucisthāne tadā tadā] S; tathā A gupte śaucācārarataḥ sadā || 52.98 ||
mūḍhānām uttamā siddhiḥ kadācit teṣu na teṣu na] A; tena S jāyate |
vinmūtram aśucisthānaṃ sadā durgandhipūtikam || 52.99 || {S573}
vyādhiduḥkhaṃ tathā śokaṃ maraṇāntaṃ duḥkhabhājanam |
viyogaṃ ratisampṛktaṃ viyogaṃ ratisampṛktaṃ] S; viyogaratisaṃyuktaṃ A na spṛśen mānuṣīṃ striyām || 52.100 ||
anityaduḥkhaṃ tathā śūnyaṃ riktaṃ śūnyaṃ riktaṃ] A; śūnyariktas S {A25r} tuccham aśāśvatam |
bālam ullāpanaṃ cāpi saṅkalpajanitodbhavet || 52.101 ||
na gacchet kāmato mantrī sarvakāmām anādijām |
teṣāṃ viratim ity ukto vimuktis teṣu siddhitām || 52.102 ||
sidhyante tasya mantrā vai ye viraktā tu kāmataḥ |
vinmūtrarudhirāsiktām amṛtapṛktāṃ amṛtapṛktāṃ] A; lac. S caiva pūjitām || 52.103 ||
jarāmṛtyusuśokāṃ ca na spṛśen mānuṣīṃ tanum |
na bhajen bhajen] em.; bhejen S; bhaṃjen A maithunaṃ tatra mohāndhāṃ mohāndhāṃ] em.; mohāndhā S; mohād vā A rāgacetasām cetasām] S; cetasā A |
na siddhir labhyate labhyate] A; labhyane S mantrī mantrī] A; mantrāṃ S teṣu sevī sadāśucī sadāśucī] S; sadāśucīm A || 52.104 ||
mantrajño mantrajāpī ca saprajño 'tha jitendriyaḥ |
śaucācārarato dhīraḥ sarvamantre °mantre] A; °mantro S 'pi hi sadā || 52.105 ||
padmoccā pramodā pramodā] A; samodā S ca • ajitā cāpi jayā sadā |
śyāmāvatī śyāmāvatī] A; śyāmāvarta S tathā yakṣī • ity etā yakṣimaharddhikā || 52.106 ||

tei:div.p: padmoccāyā mantraḥ | oṁ padmocce svāhā | asyāḥ kalpaḥ | gaṅgākūle samudrātaṭe vā • udyānapuṣpavāṭikāyāṃ madhye • uḍayaṃ uḍayaṃ] S; udayaṃ A kṛtvā śucitaram ātmanā ca śucir bhūtvā śilāpaṭṭakākāraṃ °paṭṭakākāraṃ] S; °paṭakākāraṃ A mṛṇmaye kṛtvā tatraiva rātrau dvāraṃ pidhayitvā sarvakāmabhogyāny °bhogyāny] A; °bhogyādy° S upakaraṇāni saṃhṛtya saṃhṛtya] A; upahṛtya S tatraivātmasamīpe yakṣiṇyāḥ yakṣiṇyāḥ] em.; yakṣiṇyā A; yakṣiṇyāṃ S {V447} śayyāṃ kalpayet | tato vidyāṃ daśa sahasrāṇi japet || 52.107 ||

evaṃ yāvan māsābhyantareṇa niyatam āgacchatīti | āgatā ca kāmopabhogyā °bhogyā] S; °bhogyo A bhavati bhāryā | divyaṃ ca muktāhāraṃ śayyāyāṃ śayyāyāṃ] A; śayyāṃ S parityajya prabhāte gacchati | evaṃ yāvad yāvad] S; yāvadbhir A dine dine ṣaḍbhir māsair nityasthā bhavati | tan muktāhāraṃ na grahetavyam | yadi gṛhṇāti tanmātra evam upapadyate | dīnāralakṣamūlyaṃ tat • hāraṃ tat hāraṃ S; muktāhāraṃ A maṇi maṇi°] S; mahāmaṇi° Aratnopaśobhitam || 52.108 ||

ṣaḍbhir māsair atikrāntair nityasthā bhavati bhāryā sarvakāmapradā °pradā] A; °dā S | yathārūpam {A25v} abhilaṣitaṃ {S574} tathārūpaṃ kṛtvā • upatiṣṭhate | yathābhirucitam ātmānam abhinirmiṇoti sādhakasyecchayā | sarveṣāṃ yakṣīṇām ayaṃ vidhānaḥ • yathā nirdiṣṭānām atra • anyatra || 52.109 ||
jayāyā jayāyā] A; jayāya S mantraḥ | oṁ jaye sujaye jayamati jayamati] A; jāpayati S sarvakāryāṇi kuru me svāhā |

lg.l: kanakābhā citrāṅgī nīlakuñcitamūrdhajā |
sarvāṅgaśobhanā devī saumyā saumyā] A; bhomya S ca subhagā śubhā || 52.110 ||
priyaṃvadā pramadā śreṣṭhā surūpā cārudarśanā |
praśastākārataḥ °taḥ] A; °ruḥ S śukraḥ sarvalokasupūjitā |
īṣidraktena vastreṇa jayāṃ tām abhinirdiśet || 52.111 ||

tei:div.p: asyāḥ kalpaḥ | ādau lakṣam ekaṃ japet | pūrvasevā kṛtā bhavati | tato mahāraṇyaṃ praviśya phalāhāras tāvaj japed yāvat svarūpeṇopatiṣṭhate | āgatā ca bravīti | kiṃ karomīti | yadi mātā bhavati mātṛvat sarvāśāṃ paripūrayate °pūrayate] S; °pūjaya** A | rājyaṃ dadāti | mahādhanapatiṃ karoti | dīrghāyuṣkatām adhitiṣṭhate || 52.112 ||

atha bhaginī yathepsitaṃ strīm ānayati yojanasahasrasthitām api | dīnāralakṣaṃ dine dine dadāti | sa ca vyayīkartavyaḥ | atha bhāryā bhavati | svabhavanaṃ nayate | divyavimānābhirūḍhas °ābhirūḍhas] em.; °ābhirūḍho S; °ābhirūḍhās A tayā sārdhaṃ ramate dīrghakālam | triṃśad triṃśad] S; tri° A varṣasahasrāṇi yatheṣṭaṃ vicarate | mahāyakṣapratirūpo bhavati || 52.113 ||

pramodāyā mantra | oṁ ṣṭhrīḥ • hrīḥ ṣṭhrīḥ hrīḥ] A; ṣṭhrīḥ hrīṃḥ S; hri ṣtrī D • mahānagni hūṃ phaṭ svāhā | asyāḥ kalpaḥ | ardharātre • aparimāṇo jāpaḥ kartavyaḥ | bhūyo nidrāṃ na na] conj. (based on the Tib.); om. S, A gacchet | māsābhyantareṇa niyatam āgacchati | bhāryā bhavati sarvakāmadā | dine dine pañcaviṃśati dīnārām anuprayacchati • ātmanā ca sambhogam sambhogaṃ] A; saṅkośaṃ S | dīrghakālaṃ ca jīvāpayati || 52.114 ||

evam aparimāṇāni yakṣiṇīśatasahasrāṇi bhavanti | evaṃ piśācyaḥ piśācyaḥ] em.; piśācyaḥ(?) A; piśācāḥ S maharddhikāḥ maharddhikāḥ] A; piśācamaharddhikāḥ S • nāgakanyāḥ • asurakanyāḥ • apsarāḥ surayoṣid surayoṣid] S; yoṣitaṃ A daityakanyā | evaṃ vidyādharīṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ sarvataḥ • mānuṣīṇām amānuṣīṇāṃ {S575} ca mantrāṇi bhavanti • {A26r} asaṅkhyeyāni | tathaiva yakṣāṇāṃ devānāṃ devānāṃ] S; devātānāṃ A nāgānām ṛṣīṇāṃ gandharvāṇām asurāṇāṃ pretānāṃ rākṣasānāṃ ca | mahābrahmaṇaḥ maheśvarasya viṣṇor viṣṇor] em.; viṣṇoḥ A; mahāviṣṇoḥ S mātarāṇām aindrāṇī aindrāṇī°] em.; aindrāṇi° S; aindrāpaṇī Acāmuṇḍīvārāhīpramukhānāṃ mantrāṇi bhavanti | pṛthak pṛthak sarve ca samaye • ākṛṣṭāḥ • iha krodharājena yamāntakena • ānītā grastā samaye sthāpitā mañjughoṣasyopanāmitā °opanāmitā] S; °opanāminā A anuparivārā anupūrvasthitā paricārikā || 52.115 ||

evaṃ yā api yā api] A; yāpi S tāś catuḥkumāryo mahāyakṣiṇyo bhrātus tumburusametā divyarūpiṇyaḥ • ambu ambu°] S; aṣṭa° Arāśisamāśritā nauyānasamārūḍhāḥ sarvalokasupūjitāḥ sattvānugrahakārikāḥ | teṣām apy eṣa eva eṣa eva] S; evaṃ A vidhiḥ | yad uta || 52.117 ||

lg.l: paṭabhittiphalake samotkīrṇā samotkīrṇā] em.; samotkīrṇṇa A; samākīrṇo S likhitāpi vā |
nauyānasamārūḍhā bhrātur jyeṣṭhānuneyikā || 52.118 ||
ambudhe • antargatā antargatā] S; turgatā A kanyā catur eva samānugā |
teṣāṃ pracchannataḥ sthāpya krodhaṃ jāpya samārabhet jāpya samārabhet] S; jāpam ārabhet (unmetrical) A || 52.119 ||
calaḥ kampas tathā svedaḥ • jāyate teṣu jāyate teṣu] A; jāyateṣu ca S sarvataḥ |
tataḥ siddhā iti jñātvā mantrajāpī japaṃ tyajet || 52.120 ||
svarūpeṇaiva rātryante kathayanti śubhāśubham |
sarvartha sarvartha°] A; sarvathā Ssādhakā te vai bhavante ha sajāpine sajāpine] S; jāpine (unmetrical) A || 52.121 ||
sarvaṃ kurvanti • ājñaptāḥ krodha-m-ākṛṣṭamūrchitāḥ |
somādyair grahavarair nityaṃ ṛṣibhiḥ • rākṣasais tathā || 52.122 ||
piśācair garuḍaiś cāpi supūjitās te maharddhikāḥ |
maheśvarādyais tathābhūtaiḥ pūjitā te maharddhikāḥ || 52.123 ||
etaiś ca bhāṣitā kalpā mantratantrāḥ savistarāḥ |
te tu sarve prayoktavyāḥ sakalpāḥ kalpavistarāḥ |
sarve te krodharājasya {A26v} vaśe tiṣṭhanty ayatnataḥ || 52.124 ||
yāvanti kecin mantrā vai • ucchuṣyā kaśmalodbhavāḥ | {S576}
sarve te krodharājasya niyuktā te prakāśitā || 52.125 |||
āryā ye ca mantrā vai viśiṣṭā sarvatogatāḥ |
utkṛṣṭāḥ pravarā hy agrāḥ • bhāṣitā jinavarais tathā |
tathā mantradhare mantrā mayā caiva caiva] S; vaiva A prabhāṣitā || 52.126 ||
ye cānye mantramukhyās tu kuleṣv eva hi pañcasu |
bhāṣitā jinaputrais tu laukikāś cāpi maharddhikā || 52.127 ||
sarvāṃs tān samākṛṣya krodharājo maharddhikaḥ |
sarveṣāṃ mantratantrās tu °tantrās tu] A; °tantrāstra° S nibaddhās te • iha śāsane || 52.128 ||
yo yeṣāṃ vidhir vidhir] S; vivar° A ākhyātas tenaivāyaṃ niyojitaḥ |
krodharājā yamāntas yamāntas] S; yamāntakas (unmetrical) A tu • utkṛṣṭaḥ sarvakarmikaḥ || 52.129 ||
tārāṃ ca ca] S; om. (unmetrical) A bhṛkuṭīṃ caiva tathā paṇḍaravāsinīm |
mahāśvetāṃ tathā vidyāṃ māmakyāṃ kuliśodbhavām || 52.130 || {V449}
uṣṇīṣaprabhavāṃ °prabhavāṃ] A; °prabhāṃ (unmetrical) S sarvāṃ sarvāṃ] A; sarva° S locanāṃ caiva devatām |
sarvāṃ tathāgatīṃ vidyāṃ mañjughoṣaṃ ca dhīmatam || 52.131 ||
mahā­sthāmaṃ samantaṃ ca tathā padma­dharaṃ padma­dharaṃ] A; padmavaraṃ S prabhum |
mayāpi mayāpi] A; yayāpi S loke loke] S; loka A yakṣeśaṃ bodhi­sattvaṃ maharddhikam || 52.132 ||
yad uktaṃ yad uktaṃ] S; ma**kt* A jinaputraṃ tu sarvāṅgaṃ lokaviśrutam |
vajrasenaṃ suṣeṇaṃ ca matsutāṃ cāpi dhīmatām || 52.133 ||
mayā mayā] S; mayā hi (unmetrical) A ye bhāṣitā mantrā nāvajñāṃ kārayej japī |
te te] S; om. (unmetrical) A sarvāṃ pūjayen nityam alaṅghyās teṣu bhāṣitā || 52.134 ||
na japī yojayet tatra krodharājaṃ supūjitam |
vidyācchedaṃ na kurvīta teṣu mantreṣu sarvadā || 52.135 ||
sarvāṃś caiva yathākarmāṃ laukikāṃ mantradevatām |
umāśaṅkarabrahmādyāṃ hariṃś cāpi supūjitam |
yathā tantreṣu mantrāṇāṃ sarveṣv eva tathā kṛtā || 52.136 ||
sarvaṃ ca ca] S; om. (unmetrical) A sarvato mantrāṃ sarvaṃ caiva samārabhet | {S577}
sarvamantrapravṛttis tu dṛśyate krodhasambhavā After this line, manuscript A adds sarvamantrapravṛttis tu for the second time. || 52.137 ||
eṣa mantro mahākrodhaḥ yamānto nāma nāmataḥ |
ākṛṣya ghātayet kṣipraṃ yamasyāpi mahātmane || 52.138 ||
vaivasvataṃ kṛtāntaṃ vai śakraś cāpi śakraś cāpi] S; śakrasyāpi A mahātmanaḥ | {A27r}
eṣa mantro mahāmantraḥ kathito mañjubhāṇinā |
sarvakarmakaraḥ krūraḥ sarvamantraprasādhakaḥ || 52.140 ||
ity evam uktvā tataḥ śrīmān vajrapāṇir maharddhikaḥ |
praṇamya buddhaṃ mahāvīraṃ śākyasiṃhaṃ narottamam |
mantracakrāśrito mantracakrāśrito] A; mantraṃ ca kāśrito S vajrī mantraṃ bhāṣe maharddhikam || 52.141 ||
śṛṇvantu sarve sattvā vai sarvabhūtagaṇāḥ śubhāḥ |
sarvamantra °mantra°] A; °maitra° Sgaṇādhyakṣā bhāṣe 'haṃ mantram uttamam || 52.142 ||
bhāṣitaṃ bodhisattvena mañjughoṣeṇa dhīmatā |
durdāntadamakaṃ ghoraṃ sarvaduṣṭanivāraṇam || 52.143 ||
vineyārthaṃ tu sattvānāṃ bodhisattvena bhāṣitam |
ahaṃ ca bhāṣaye bhāṣaye] A; bhāṣahe S hy atra parṣanmadhye sudāruṇam || 52.144 ||

tei:div.p: namaḥ samanta­buddhānām abhāva­svabhāva­samudgatānām | namaḥ pratyeka­buddhāryaśrāvakāṇām | namo bodhisattvānāṃ daśabhūmipratiṣṭhiteśvarāṇāṃ bodhisattvānāṃ mahā­sattvānām | tadyathā || 52.145 ||

oṁ kha kha {V450} khāhi khāhi duṣṭasattvadamaka • asimusalapāśaparaśu °pāśaparaśu°] S; °paraśupāśa° Ahasta caturbhuja caturmukha ṣaṭcaraṇa gaccha gaccha mahāvighnaghātaka vikṛtānana sarvabhūtabhayaṅkara aṭṭahāsanādine vyāghracarmanivasana kuru kuru sarvakarmāṃ cchinda cchinda sarvamantrāṃ bhinda bhinda paramudrām bhinda bhinda paramudrām] em.; bhiṃda bhinda paramudrāṃ A; om. S ākarṣāya • ākarṣaya sarvabhūtāṃ sarvabhūtāṃ] S; sarvabhūtānāṃ A nirmatha nirmatha sarvaduṣṭāṃ praveśaya praveśaya maṇḍalamadhye vaivasvatajīvitāntakara kuru kuru mama kāryaṃ daha daha paca paca mā vilamba mā vilamba samayam anusmara hūṃ hūṃ phaṭ phaṭ sphoṭaya sphoṭaya sarvāśāpāripūraka he bhagavaṃ kiṃ cirāyasi mama sarvārthaṃ sarvārthaṃ] S; sarvārthān A sādhaya svāhā || 52.146 || {S578}

eṣa sa mārṣāḥ sarvadevagaṇāḥ • yamāntako nāma krodharājā yamarājānam apy ānayati ghātayati śoṣayati pācayati damayati | evaṃ sarvamantrāṃ {A27v} sarvadevāṃ sarvamantrāṃ sarvadevāṃ] S; sarvamantrānāṃ sarvadevānāṃ A kiṃ punar mānuṣaṃ prati duḥkhitam | daśabhūmipratiṣṭhitām api bodhisattvān ānayati | kiṃ punar laukikāṃ mantrām || 52.147 ||

evam aparimitabalaparākramo 'yaṃ krodharājā | evaṃ sarvamantratantrabhāṣiteṣv api sarvakarmāṇi kurute sarvamantrāṇām | yathā yathā prayujyate tathā tathā karoti paṭhitasiddhaḥ | eṣa krodharājā yamāntako nāma parisamāpta iti || 52.148 ||

āryamañjuśrīmūlakalpād bodhi­sattvapiṭakāvataṃsakān °piṭakāvataṃsakān] S; °piṭakān A mahāyānavaipulyasūtrād dvipañcāśo dvipañcāśo] em.; pañcāśatimaḥ S yamāntakakrodharājāsarvavidhiniyamas tṛtīyaḥ paṭalavisaraḥ parisamāpta iti | Here ends correspondence with manuscript A. namo buddhāya | samāptaṃ ca yamāntakasya krodharājasya kalpam iti ||

tei:div.head: Chapter A53
tei:div.p: atha khalu bhaga­vāñ śākya­munis tasmāt samādher vyutthāya mahāsāgaropamāyāṃ parṣanmaṇḍalaṃ dharmaṃ deśayamānaḥ sarvasattvānāṃ sarvabhūtagaṇānām agrataḥ sanniṣaṇṇās tatra vajrapāṇipramukhānām anekabodhisattvā °bodhisattvā°] Y; °bodhi­sattva° Ssṅkhyeyasahasrāṃ śāriputrapramukhām anekāsaṅkheyārhatsahasrāṃ vaiśravaṇapramukhām asaṅkhyeyārcacāturmahārājikadeva­putrāṃ śakrapramukhāṃ trāyastriṃśām asaṅkhyeyadeva­putrāṃ suyāmasantuṣita­nirmāṇarati­paranirmita­vaśavarti­brahmakāyika­brahmapurohita­mahābrahma­parīttābhāpramāṇābhāsvarair yāvat puṇyaprasavā bṛhatphalāvṛhā °āvṛhā°] em.; °ātṛhā° Stapākaniṣṭhā devān āmantrayate sma || 53.1 ||
śṛṇvantu bhavanto devasaṅghāḥ sarva bodhisattvāryaśrāvakāḥ

lg.l: anityāḥ sarvasaṃskārā utpādavyayadharmiṇaḥ |
utpadya hi nirudhyante teṣāṃ vyupaśamaḥ sukham || 53.2 ||
avidyāprabhavāḥ °prabhavāḥ] Y; °prabhāvāḥ S sarve • utpadyante sahetukāḥ |
sahetuṃ duḥkhamūlaṃ tu skandhā hy uktāḥ samodayāḥ || 53.3 ||
teṣāṃ nirodhinī vidyā sukhahetusukhakriyām |
duḥkhaprahāṇam ity uktaṃ saṃkṣepeṇa nivāraṇā || 53.4 ||
tad eva trividhaṃ yānaṃ nirdiṣṭaṃ ca mayā • iha |
anityaduḥkhānātmāno °duḥkhānātmāno] em.; °duḥkhamānātmāno (unmetrical) S kṣaṇikaṃ sarvasaṃskṛtam || 53.5 ||
śūnyaṃ sadā sarvadā sarvaṃ nirdiṣṭaṃ bhavabandhanam |
tadvirāgā tridhā yānti ye sattvā gotranisṛtā || 53.6 ||
bodhisattvās tadā buddhā pratyekāṃ bodhiniśritām |
tathāpare hy arahanto arahanto] em.; aharahanno (unmetrical) S vītarāgā maharddhikā || 53.7 ||
śrāvakīṃ bodhinisṛtya tridhā śāntigatā hi te |
eṣa dharmo samāsena nirdiṣṭo me śubhāśubham || 53.8 ||
aśubhaṃ varjayen nityaṃ sarvadā śubham ācaret |
ahiṃsāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ yathā dharmo prakāśitaḥ || 53.9 ||
eka eva bhaven mārga dharmāṇāṃ gatipañcake |
anāsravaś ca yo dharmo bhūtakoṭisamāśritaḥ || 53.10 || {S580}
sa eṣa kathito mārgaḥ • ādibuddhaiḥ purātanaiḥ |
mayāpi kathitaṃ sarvaṃ śāntanirvāṇagāminam || 53.11 ||
dharmakoṭiṃ samāśritya bhūtakoṭiṃ tu labhyate |
akoṭī sarva­dharmāṇāṃ bhūtakoṭim udāhṛtā || 53.12 ||
eṣa dharmaḥ samāsena dvividhaiva prakāśitam |
śṛṇvantu sarve devā vai bodhisattvā maharddhikāḥ || 53.13 || {V452}
arhantaḥ śrāvakā mahyaṃ nirvāṇaṃ me yadā bhuvi |
abhūt sālavane madhye himavatkukṣisambhave || 53.14 ||
nadyāṃ hiraṇyavatyāyāṃ mallānām upavartane upavartane] Y; upavartate S |
yamakasālakavane madhye nirvāṇaṃ me bhaviṣyati || 53.15 ||
pāvāsaṃjñe pāvāsaṃjñe] Y; yāvat saṃjñī S tathā nagare caitye makuṭabandhane °bandhane] Y; °vardhane S |
nadītīre sadā ramye nirvāṇaṃ me tadā bhuvi || 53.16 ||
sarve vai bodhisattvās tu śrāvakāś ca maharddhikāḥ |
devā nāgā tathā yakṣā lokapālā maharddhikā || 53.17 ||
śakrabrahmasuyāmāś ca • akaniṣṭhādyās tathāpare |
sarveṣāṃ sannipātā vai tasmin sthāne bhaviṣyati || 53.18 ||
yamakasālakavane tatra mallānām upavartane upavartane] Y; upadartate S |
gaṅgāyām uttare tīre mahī mahī° Y; mahā° Snadyās tathāpare || 53.19 ||
himādrer dakṣiṇe bhāge • abhūt sālavane vane |
apaścimā apaścimā] em. (cf. verse 53.25 below); apaścime S me tathā tathā] S; tadā Y śayyā tasmin sthāne bhaviṣyati || 53.20 ||
nadyā tīre tadā tadā] em. (on the authority of the Tib.); tathā S ramye hiraṇyākhye śubhe taṭe |
sarvadevasaṅghādyāṃ sannipāto bhaviṣyati || 53.21 ||
manujair nṛpavaraiḥ sarvair manuṣyāmanuṣyasambhavaiḥ |
sarvabhūtais tathā martyair martyair] em.; martyai S bāliśābāliśais tadā || 53.22 ||
mahotsavamahotsāhaṃ tasmin sthāne samāgamam |
kṛtam atra mahaṃ kṛtam atra mahaṃ] em. (on the authority of the Tib.); kṛtamantram ahaṃ S divyaṃ maccharīre tu sāmiṣe || 53.23 || {S581}
nirāmiṣaṃ tu tadā sthāpya śāntim āpnoti nirvṛtim |
dharmakoṭiṃ parityajya bhūtakoṭiṃ tu saṃviśet || 53.24 ||
apaścimā me tadā tadā] Y; tathā S jātir nagare kapilavāstuke |
śākyānāṃ ca kule mukhye jāto 'haṃ bhavacārake || 53.25 ||
tato 'haṃ tyajya duḥkhātmyaṃ niryāto 'haṃ gṛhāt tathā |
bahutīrthāṃ tathā sevya na ca prāpto 'mṛtaḥ 'mṛtaḥ] em.; mṛtaḥ S punaḥ || 53.26 ||
duḥkaraṃ ca mayā cīrṇaṃ kāyaṃ santāpya taś cainam |
ṣaḍābdam uṣitaḥ bhraṣṭadehaṃ vāpi viśuṣkataḥ || 53.27 ||
na ca kiñcin mayā labdhaṃ yena jñānam avāvṛtam avāvṛtam] S; apāvṛtam Y |
tatotthāya mayā tatra • āhāraṃ kṛtha śubhodanam || 53.28 ||
devatāsūcitaṃ mārgaṃ gato 'haṃ tatra bhūtalam |
nadyā nairañjanātīre vṛkṣarāje suśobhane || 53.29 || {V453}
nānāpuṣpasamākīrṇe tatheraṇye 'tha bhūtale |
mahāvanaphalopete nānāvṛkṣasamudbhave || 53.30 ||
mahānadī pariveṣṭyānte tarumūle tato hy aham |
yo svakaṃ dṛṣṭamātraṃ tu bhūbhāgaṃ dhṛtiṃ saṃlabhe dhṛtiṃ saṃlabhe] em.; dhṛtisaṃlabhe S || 53.31 ||
tathaivāhaṃ taṃ taruṃ dṛṣṭvā parṇaśākhopaśobhitam |
mahāvṛkṣaṃ mahācchāyaṃ mūlagūḍhopaśobhitam || 53.32 ||
aśvatthe 'śvatthatāṃ gacchet tarumūle niṣadya vai |
dhṛtiṃ tatrābhivindāmi dhyānaṃ cāpi samādhikam |
prāptaṃ tatra • anāśāṃ vai rātryante jāti-r-antakam || 53.33 ||
māreṇa bahudhā vighnā anekākārasuyojitāḥ |
bhagnasainyaparāvṛtya gato 'sau svabhavanaṃ punaḥ || 53.34 ||
tadarthe mantratantrā vai bhāṣitā bahudhā punaḥ |
anekākāraprayogāś ca dhyānā jñānāś ca bhāṣitāḥ || 53.35 ||
tridhā yānaṃ punas tatra caritaṃ sarvasevitam | {S582}
pratipakṣā hi doṣāṇāṃ tridhā caiva prakāśitaḥ || 53.36 ||
tatotthāya punar gatvā urubilvāṃ urubilvāṃ] Y; burubilvāṃ S śubhodakām |
snātvāmbhase tatra • ṛṣiṃ parivrajya parivrajya] em. (on the authority of the Tib.); pravrajya (unmetrical) S saśiṣyakām || 53.37 ||
sattvārthaṃ bahudhā kṛtvā prakrānto 'haṃ tataḥ punaḥ |
punaḥ kāśipurīṃ °purīṃ] em.; °purī° S ramyām anupūrvyā samāviśet || 53.38 ||
tatra sthāne tu gatvā vai purā purā°] Y; parā Sbuddhā maharddhikāḥ |
tatrāhaṃ sthito deśe jane kāśijane svayam || 53.39 ||
pravartya cakraṃ sāddharmyaṃ sāddharmyaṃ°] em.; saddharmya° Y; sādharmya° Sśāntiṃ nirvāṇakārakam |
sasurāsuralokānāṃ gatiṃ pañcāsuniśritām °niśritām] em.; °nisṛtām S |
sarvabhūtasukhārthāya tatra dharma prakāśitaḥ || 53.40 ||
ādibuddhaiḥ purā tatra dharmacakraṃ pravartitam |
mayāpi deśitas deśitas] em.; deśitaḥ Y; diśi (unmetrical) S tatra dharmacakro hy anuttaraḥ || 53.41 ||
bhavamuktisukhārthāya sattvadoṣanivāraṇā |
pravartya cakraṃ brāhmyaṃ brāhmyaṃ] Y; brāhmāṃ S vai kṣemaṃ śāntaparāyaṇam || 53.42 ||
bhavamārgavināśārthaṃ catuḥsatyasamādhijam |
āryāṣṭāṅgikaṃ mārgaṃ caturbrāhmavibhūṣitam || 53.43 ||
sapratītyasamutpādaṃ dvādaśākārakāritam |
avidyānirodhasaṃyuktaṃ vidyāmutpādanemijam || 53.44 || {V454}
bhrāmitā koṭitathyaṃ vai bhūtakoṭisukoṭijam |
anulomavilomābhyāṃ gatimāhātmanemijam || 53.45 ||
sampradeśaśivaṃ cakraṃ bahusattvā vimokṣa ca |
vimuñcya kāśipurīṃ ramyāṃ śrāvastyāhaṃ tadā game || 53.46 ||
tīrthikānāṃ tathāvarjya °varjya] em.; °varjyā S prātihāryair prātihāryair] S; prātihārya Y vikurvaṇaiḥ vikurvaṇaiḥ] Y; vikurvataiḥ S |
śaṅkaśye tathā kṛtvā • ṛddhir janapade tadā || 53.47 ||
bahutīrthāyatanasthānāṃ °āyatanasthānāṃ] Y; °āyatanāṃ sthānāṃ S sampratoṣya tadā punaḥ |
agnibhāṇḍe jane kṛtvā devāvataraṇaṃ śubham || 53.48 || {S583}
trāyastriṃśeṣu deveṣu śakraṃ śakraṃ] Y; śakra S saṃyojya dharmatām |
akaniṣṭhādyāṃ tathā devāṃ brahmādīśapurandarām brahmādīn sapurandarām] Y; brahmādīśapurandarām S || 53.49 ||
savaiśravaṇayakṣendrāṃ caturmahārājakāyikām |
sadāmattān °mattān] em.; mattān Y; mattā° S karoṭapāṇīṃś °karoṭapāṇīṃś] Y; °karopamāṇāś S ca trivīṇāṃ māladhāriṇām || 53.50 ||
devāṃ yakṣa yakṣa°] Y; yaṇa° Sgaṇāṃ sarvāṃ bhaumāṃ divyāntarīkṣakām |
āryāṃ yakṣa yakṣa°] Y; yatha° Sgaṇādhyakṣāṃ sarvāṃś caiva surāsurām || 53.51 ||
kṛtvā dharmaphale yuktān yuktān] em.; yuktāṃ S nirvāṇānugasatridhān °tridhān] em.; °trivām S; °trayān Y |
śreyasaiva tadā yojya yojya] Y; yojyā S bahuprāṇān bahuprāṇān] em. (on the authority of the Tib.); bahuprāṇām° S acittakān || 53.52 ||
asaṅkhyā gaṇanā teṣāṃ saṃsārāntād anantakān anantakān] em.; anantakām S |
bahusattvān tadā bahusattvān tadā] Y; bahu sarvaṃ sadā S satye bhūtārthe sanniyojya vai |
ihāham āgatas tatra śuddhāvāsopari sthitaḥ || 53.54 ||
pravartya mantrasaddharmaṃ °dharmaṃ] em.; °dharma° S tridhāyānasamānugam |
sattvānāṃ vinayam āgamya kalparājam idaṃ punaḥ |
prakāśya prakāśya] Y; prakāśye S bahudhā loke mañjughoṣasya dattavān || 53.55 ||
nirvṛte tu mayā loke śūnyībhūte mahītale |

ārakṣaṇārthaṃ saddharmāṃ jinendrāṇāṃ parinirvṛtau parinirvṛtau] Y; parinirvṛtā S |
satatā rakṣaṇā nityaṃ mañjughoṣo bhaviṣyati || 53.57 ||
mantraprabhāvanārthaṃ tu kathitaṃ kalpavistaram |

kariṣyanti na sandehaḥ • tasmiṃ kāle mamāntike || 53.64 ||

bodhisattvās tu sarve vai daśabhūmisamāśritā || 53.66 ||

dharmaṃ dideśitavān buddhaḥ sāmprate 'tha mahītale |
saivādya munivaraḥ °varaḥ] Y; °varāḥ S śreṣṭhaḥ saptamo ṛṣipuṅgavaḥ |

dhyānaṃ vimokṣa saṃśās tu saṃśāstu] Y; saṃsestu S śāntanirvāṇamārgam °mārgam] Y; °mārge S
niṣeptuṃ vā bhūtato muniḥ || 53.76 ||

ākrandam atulaṃ kṛtvā sapraṇāmā tatasthire || 53.78 ||
cukucuś ciram utkrośya cukucuś ciram utkrośya] em.; cukujuḥ ciram(?) utkośya Y; cukūcu viraḥ mutkośya S sāśrukaṇṭhā sagadgadā |
saśokācittamanaso brahmādyāḥ sasurāsurāḥ || 53.79 ||

tei:div.p: peyālaṃ vistareṇa kartavyaṃ sarveṣāṃ nṛpatīnāṃ karma || 53.920 ||
svakaṃ jātakaṃ mahāparinirvāṇasūtraṃ mañjuśriyasya kumārasya muniśreṣṭha

mantratantrābhiyogena kathitaṃ bodhinimnagam |

tei:div.p: āryamañjuśriyamūlakalpād bodhi­sattvapiṭakāvatasaṃkān mahāyānavaipulyasūtrāt paṭalavisarāt tripañcāśa tripañcāśa°] em.; ekapañcāśa° S.rājavyākaraṇaparivartaḥ parisamāpta iti There is no chapter break at this point in the Tibetan text. ||

tei:div.head: Chapter A54
tei:div.p: atha bhagavān śākya­muniḥ punar api śuddhāvāsabhavanam avalokya mañjuśriyaṃ kumara­bhūtam āmantrayate sma || 54.1 ||

ayaṃ mañjuśrīḥ • dharma­paryāyaḥ • asmin sthāne pracariṣyati tatrāhaṃ tatrāhaṃ] em.; tatrāha S svayam evaṃ veditavyaḥ | sarvabodhi­sattvagaṇaparivṛtaḥ śrāvakasaṅghapuraskṛtaḥ sarvadeva­nāgayakṣagaruḍagandharvakinnaramahoragasiddhavidyādhara °vidyādhara°] em.; °vidyādharaḥ Smānuṣāmānuṣaiḥ parivṛto vihare 'haṃ veditavyaḥ | tathāgato 'tra rakṣāvaraṇaguptaye tiṣṭhatīti || 54.2 ||

daśānuśaṃsā mañjuśrīḥ kumāra veditavyāḥ veditavyāḥ] em.; veditavyaḥ S • yatra sthāne sthāne] em.; sthāno S 'yaṃ dharmakośas tathāgatānāṃ pustakagato vā lekhayiṣyati lekhayiṣyati] em.; likhyati S vācayiṣyati dhārayiṣyati satkṛtya manasikṛtya vividhaiś cāmaracūrṇa °cūrṇa°] em. (on the authority of the Tib.); °pūrṇa°cchatradhvaja­patākāghaṇṭābhir vādyamālyavilepanair dhūpagandhaiś ca sugandhibhiḥ pūjayiṣyati mānayiṣyati satkariṣyaty ekāgramanaso vā cittaṃ dhatse | katame daśa || 54.3 ||

na cāsya paracakrabhayaṃ °bhayaṃ] em.; °bhaya S durbhikṣo vā | na cāsya cāsya] em.; yāsya S tatra mahāmāryopadravaṃ bhavati • amānuṣabhayo vā | na cāsyāgnibhayaṃ bhavati sarvapratyarthikabhayo vā | na cāsya tatrānāvṛṣṭibhayaṃ bhavati • ativṛṣṭibhayo vā | na cāsya tatra mahāvātamaṇḍalībhayaṃ bhavati sarvakravyādabhayo vā | na cāsya śakrabhayaṃ bhavati sarvadhūrtataskarabhayo vā | na cāsya mṛtyubhayaṃ bhavati yamarājopanītabhayaṃ vā | na cāsyāsurabhayaṃ vā bhavati sarvadeva­nāgayakṣagandharvāsurabhayo vā | na cāsya mantrabhayaṃ bhavati sarvagaraviṣabhayaṃ vā | na cāsya rogabhayaṃ bhavati jvarātīsārajīrṇāṅgapratyaṅgabhayo vā | ime daśānuśaṃsā veditavyā yatrāyaṃ mahākalpavisare dharmakośas tathāgatānāṃ pustakagato tiṣṭheta | likhanavācanapūjanadhāraṇasvādhyāyānāṃ vā kurmaḥ || 54.4 ||

guhyatamo 'yaṃ dharmakośas tathāgatānāṃ mantrānuvartanatayā punar eṣāṃ sarvataḥ | ācāryasamayānupraviṣṭānām asamayajñānāṃ na prakāśitavyaḥ | yat kāraṇam | rahasyam etat | guhyavacanam etat | sarvajñavacanam etat | mā haiva sattvā pratikṣepsyante • avajñasyanti || 54.5 ||

na pūjayiṣyanti na satkariṣyanti mahad apuṇyaṃ prasaviṣyante | guhyanivaraṇa­sattvopaghātana­nṛpati­sūcana•āyuḥpramāṇopaghātopasargika­kriyāṃ kariṣyantīti na pareṣām {S658} ārocayitavyaṃ ca | samaya­rahasya­guhya­mantra­caryānupraviṣṭānāṃ sattvānāṃ tathāgataśāsanaśikṣāyāṃ °śikṣāyāṃ] em.; °śikṣāyā S suśikṣitānāṃ suvyavasthitānāṃ dharmārthakovidām āyatana­dhātu­samayānupraveśa­dharma­sthitānāṃ satyasandhānāṃ dṛḍhavratam anvāgatānāṃ sattvacaryāmārgānupraviṣṭakāruṇikānām eteṣāṃ sattvānām ārocayitavyam na pareṣām | iti || 54.6 ||

atha khalu mañjuśrīḥ kumara­bhūto bodhisattvotthāyāsanād ekāṃśam uttarāsaṅgaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya kṛtakaratalāñjalipuṭo bhagavantam etad avocat | ko nāmāyaṃ bhagavan dharma­paryāyaḥ | kathaṃ cainaṃ dhārayāmy aham | bhagavān āha || 54.7 ||

sarvabodhi­sattvavisphūrjanabodhi­sattvapiṭaka ity api dhāraya | āścaryādbhutadharmopadeśaparivarta ity api dhāraya | sarvamantrakośacaryānupraviṣṭabodhi­sattvanirdeśa ity api dhāraya | mahāyānavaipulyanirdeśādbhuta ity api dhāraya |
āryamañjuśriyamūlakalpa ity api dhāraya |
sarva­dharmārthapūraṇanirdeśa ity api dhāraya | iti || 54.8 ||

idaṃ sūtraṃ dhāraṇāt puṇyam puṇyam] em.; puṇya S anuśaṃsā syād ime tathā |
na cāsya sarvakāye vai na viṣaṃ na hutāśanam || 54.15 || {S659}

tena corarākṣasā ........... || 54.16 ||

dhārayed vāpi pūjayed vā vā] em. (on the authority of the Tib.); vā na (unmetrical) S punaḥ punaḥ vividhā || 54.17 ||

patitaḥ saṃsāraduḥkhe 'smin gatiṃ pañcakayojitam |

pratyekabodhibuddhatvaṃ śrāvakatvaṃ ca naiṣṭhikam |
idaṃ sūtraṃ vācayitvā labhate buddhavartitām || 54.21 ||
gaṅgāsitatāprakhyānām anantyaṃ jinavarās tathā |

yāvanti kecil loke 'smin kṣetrakoṭi-m-acintakāḥ |

vividhā • annapānaiś ca glānapratyayabheṣajaiḥ |

tat puṇyaṃ prāpnuyāj prāpnuyāj] em.; prāpnuyā S jantur dhāraṇād vācanād idam || 54.26 ||
pratyeka­buddhā ye buddhā ye] em.; buddhaje S loke śrāvakā sumaharddhikaḥ |

tatpramāṇād bhavet sarve teṣāṃ pūjāṃ tathaiva ca |
tat puṇyaṃ prāpnuyān martya yasya pustakaṃ pustakaṃ] em.; pustaka S gataṃ kare || 54.28 || {S660}

na śakyaṃ kalpakoṭyais te ratnair ratnair] em.; ratnai S jinavaraiḥ sadā |
pūjayel pūjayel] em.; pūjaye S lokanāthānāṃ dharmakośa imaṃ varam || 54.31 ||
cintāmaṇi ca ratnārtham imaṃ dharmavaraṃ bhavet |

yo 'smān kalpavarān kalpavarān] conj.; kalvavarā S hy ekaṃ mantraṃ dhārayen dhārayen] em.; dhāraye S nṛpa |

vividhā bhogacaryā vā prāpnuyān prāpnuyān] em.; prāpnuyāṃ S nṛpavaro parām |
na cāsya hanyate śastrair na viṣaiḥ sthāvarajaṅgamaiḥ || 54.37 ||
paravidyā °vidyā°] em.; °vidya° Skṛtaiś cāpi mantraṃ vetāḍasādhanam |

na hutāśanabhayaṃ tasya nā vairagrahāparaiḥ |

rājā ca kṛtaṃ yo kṛtaṃ yo] em.; kṛtayā S mūrdhnāṃ saṅgrāme samupasthite || 54.40 ||
chatraṃ śirasi-m-āvedya namaskuryāt punaḥ punaḥ |
na tasya dasyavo hanyur nānāśastrasamudyatām || 54.41 || {S661} {V518}
hastiskandhasamārūḍhaṃ kumārākārasambhavam |
mayūrāsanasustaṃ saṅgrāme • avatārayet || 54.42 ||
dṛṣṭvā taṃ vidviṣaḥ sarve nivarteyus nivarteyus] em.; nivartanteyuste (unmetrical) S pare janāḥ |
bālarūpaṃ tathā divyakumārālaṅkārabhūṣitam || 54.43 ||
sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ vāpi-r-āgatya dhvajayūpakam °yūpakam] em. (on the authority of the Tib.); °pūjitam S |
āropya dhvajapatākeṣu sunyastaṃ susamāhitam || 54.44 ||
saṅgrāmaṃ ripusaṅkīrṇaṃ nānāśāstrasamudyatam |
yudhi prāptaṃ samastaṃ vai tasmin kāle 'vatārayet || 54.45 ||
naśyante dṛṣṭamātraṃ vai muhyante vā samantataḥ |
mānuṣāmānuṣāś cāpi nṛpāś cāpi sureśvarāḥ || 54.46 ||
siddhavidyādharāś cāpi mantratantrasamāśritāḥ |
rākṣasā sattvavanto 'pi kaṭapūtanāmātarā || 54.47 ||
kravyādā vividhāś cāpi yakṣakūṣmāṇḍapūtanā |
na śakyante dṛṣṭamātraṃ vai dhvajam ucchritasaṃsthitam || 54.48 ||
kumāraṃ viśvakarmāṇam anekākārarūpiṇam |
mañjughoṣaṃ mahātmānaṃ daśabhūmyādhipatiṃ patim || 54.49 ||
mahārājā kṣatriyo loke bhūpālo bhūnivāsinaḥ |
utpādya saugatīṃ śraddhāṃ śraddhāṃ] em. (on the authority of the Tib.); śuddhāṃ S karuṇāviṣṭamānasām |
prakramuḥ sandhikāmo vai kriyām etām ihoditām || 54.51 ||
nirdiṣṭaṃ pravacane hy etā dharmadhātugatair jinaiḥ |
kalpaṃ prayogaṃ mantrāṇāṃ tantrayuktimabhūtale || 54.52 ||
asaṅkhyair jinavaraiḥ pūrvaṃ dharmadhātusamāśritaiḥ |
kathitaṃ dharmakośaṃ tu mānuṣā tu bhūtale || 54.53 ||
devāsure purā yuddhe vartamāne bhayāvahe |
tadā puro hy āsīt hatasainyo 'tha vidviṣaiḥ || 54.54 || {S662}
ekākinas tadāsattvo tadāsattvo] em.; tadā sattvā S virathaś caiva mahītale |
muniśreṣṭhe tadā pṛcchet kāśyapaṃ taṃ jinottamam || 54.55 ||
kiṃ kartavyam iti vākyam ājahāra śacīpatiḥ |
nirjito 'surair ghorair aham atra samāśritaḥ || 54.56 ||
evam uktvā uktvā] em.; uktaḥ S maghavān śatakratur divaukasaḥ |
praṇamya śirasā mūrdhni pādayor munivare tadā || 54.57 || {V519}
niṣaseduḥ niṣaseduḥ] em.; niṣasedu S purā hy āsīt kauśiko 'tha sahasradṛk |
evam ukto muniśreṣṭhaḥ kāśyapo brāhmaṇa abhūt || 54.58 ||
ājahāra tadā vāṇiṃ kalaviṅkarutasvanām |
pūrvaṃ jinavarair gītaṃ kumāro viśvasambhavaḥ || 54.59 ||
mañjuśrī mahātmāsau durlabho lakṣa-m-ūrjitaḥ |
bhūtakoṭisamākhyāto gambhīrārthadeśikaḥ || 54.60 ||
niḥprapañcaṃ nirākāraṃ niḥsvabhāvam anālayam |
dharmādideśa sattvebhyas tat smariṣva sureśvaraḥ || 54.61 ||
tatas tena tena] em.; te nu S smartaḥ sa sa] em.; se S smṛtas smṛtas] em.; smṛta S tattvagato tataḥ |
āgatas tatkṣaṇāt tatra kumāro viśvarūpiṇaḥ |
yatra sau bhagavān tasthuḥ maghavāṃś caiva sureśvara || 54.62 ||
āgatā bhāṣate mantrāṃ vanditvā jinavaraṃ tadā |
praṇamya jinavarāṃ sarvāṃ kāśyapaṃ ca mahādyutim |
imā mantrām abhāṣeta labdhvānujñāṃ mune tadā || 54.63 ||

tei:div.p: namaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisattvebhyo 'pratihataśāsanebhyaḥ | oṁ hana hana sarvabhayān sādayotsādaya sarvabhayān sādayotsādaya] S; sarvabhayotsādaya Tib. trāsaya moṭaya chinda bhinda jvala jvala huṁ huṁ phaṭ phaṭ svāhā || 54.64 ||

atha śakro devānām indraḥ vigatabhayaromakarṣaḥ • āścaryādbhutaprāptaḥ • utphullanayanaḥ • utthāyāsanād bhagavataḥ pādayor nipatya triḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya ca mañjuśriyaṃ kumara­bhūtaṃ sammukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā tāni ca mantrapadāṃ gṛhya manasīkṛtya ca punar eva syandanam adhiruhya yena te 'surāḥ prādravitaḥ | sarve 'surā yena pātālaṃ mahāsamudrāśrayādharapuraṃ svakaṃ tenābhimukhāḥ prayayuḥ | hatavidhvastamānasaḥ sainya­bhayākulita­vihvala­niṣaṇṇa­vadana­darpaḥ vigataśastrā dṛṣṭā taṃ sureśvaraṃ jvalantam iva pāvakaṃ nirvartya svālayaṃ gatā abhūt || 54.66 ||

atha śakro devānām indro devān trāyastriṃśān āmantrayate sma | mā bhaiṣṭata mārṣā mā bhaiṣṭata | buddhānubhāvena vayam asurān nirjitavantaḥ | gacchāmaḥ svapuram | āgacchantu bhavantaḥ krīḍatha ramatha paricārayatha svaṃ svaṃ bhavanavaraṃ gatvā svālayaṃ ca | itas te devā hṛṣṭamanasaḥ punar eva nivartya svālayaṃ gatāḥ || 54.67 ||

atha śakrasya devānām indrasyaitad abhavat | yanv ahaṃ taṃ kumārarūpiṇaṃ bimbākāraṃ kṛtvā dhvajāgre sthāpayeyaṃ tato me nāsurabhayaṃ bhaved iti | atha śakro devānām indro mahatā maṇiratnaṃ maṇiratnaṃ] em.; maṇiratna S dyotigarbhaprabhodyotanaṃ nāma gṛhītvā kumārākārapratibimbaṃ kārayitvā • upari prāsādasya mūrdhani {V520} sudharmāyāṃ deva­sabhāyāṃ sudarśanasya mahānagarasya madhye taṃ dhvajocchritasuvinyastaṃ kṛtvā sthāpayām āsa || 54.68 ||

tatas te asurā prahrādavemacitriprabhṛtayaḥ pātālaṃ nordhvagacchanti °gacchanti] em.; °gacchati S na ca tān devān abhidravante na ca śekuḥ • ṛddhivikurvāṇaṃ raṇābhimukhaṃ vā gantum | evam anekāni varṣakoṭinayutaśatasahasrāṇi mānuṣikayā gaṇanayā | na cāsurabhayaṃ syād iti || 54.69 ||

evam idam aparimita­guṇānuśaṃsaṃ saṅkīrtitam āyurārogya­vardhanaṃ buddhair bhaga­vadbhir bodhi­sattvair mahā­sattvaiḥ kathitaṃ purā | evam idam aparimitānuśaṃsaguṇavistaram anantāparyantaṃ purād iti || 54.70 ||

aparimāṇaṃ cāpuṇyaprasavanaṃ cāpuṇyaprasavanaṃ] em.; yā puṇyaprasavanaṃ S mahā­narakopapattitiryak­preta­yama­loka­janma­kutsanatām upaiti yo • imaṃ dharma­paryāyam apavadate vikalpeta vākramati grastacitto vāvavadeyur na buddhavacaneti {S664} vāvadeyuḥ na mantrā na cauṣadhayo bodhisattvānāṃ pi teṣāṃ māhātmyavistaram ṛddhivikurvaṇaṃ vā nāpi vikalpavistaram anāryair bhāṣitam iti kṛtvā • utsṛjya tyajante • avagacchanti na śaknuvanti vā śrotum | tasmāt sthānād apakramante mahān teṣām apuṇyaṃ bhaviṣyatīty āha || 54.71 ||

mañjughoṣasuvinyastaṃ samyac samyac] em.; sampac° S chrīmatipūjitam |

yo hīmaṃ hīmaṃ] em.; hīhimaṃ (unmetrical) S sūtravaraṃ mukhyaṃ dharmakośaṃ jinorjitam |
